```go
	return sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary, replicaTables()...)
}

func replicaQuery(sess chsession.Session, typ sqlmeta.StatementType, sql string, tables []sqlmeta.AccessedTable) *plugin.QueryContext {
	return &plugin.QueryContext{
		Session:        sess,
		OriginalSQL:    sql,
		Query:          &chproto.Query{Body: sql},
		StatementType:  typ,
		AccessedTables: tables,
		TableSnapshot:  replicaSnapshot(),
	}
}

func replicaErr(id string, owner uint64) outcome {
	return outcome{392, fmt.Sprintf("storage_integrity: table %s is served read-only from a copy of indexer %d's published data; write through its owner", id, owner)}
}

// TestDecide_ReplicaRows is the Replica row of the spec 2026-09-24 §7.2 matrix
// that spec 2026-10-14 §11 adds: reads and metadata pass, every write, DDL and
// data-carrying creation is refused 392 naming the owner (indexer 0 is a valid
// owner), and an unreadable materialized-view header keeps its own refusal.
func TestDecide_ReplicaRows(t *testing.T) {
	replica := sitable.Table{ID: "db2.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: sitable.CopyTable("db2.a", 4), ReplicaOf: 0}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		class class
		sev   severity
		want  outcome
	}{
		{"none", classNone, allow, ok},
		{"read", classRead, allow, ok},
		{"metadata", classMetadata, allow, ok},
		{"write", classWrite, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"create", classCreate, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"create with data", classCreateData, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"drop", classDrop, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"other DDL", classOtherDDL, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"view target", classViewTarget, nonRetryable, replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"unreadable", classUnreadable, nonRetryable, unreadableErr},
	} {
		sev, err := decide(replica, tc.class)
		if sev != tc.sev {
			t.Errorf("%s: severity %d, want %d", tc.name, sev, tc.sev)
		}
		check(t, tc.name, err, tc.want)
	}

	// The same rows end to end, by statement type. INSERT ... SELECT from a
	// copy into an ordinary table is a read of the copy.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		typ    sqlmeta.StatementType
		sql    string
		tables []sqlmeta.AccessedTable
		want   outcome
	}{
		{"select", sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), ok},
		{"join of two copies", sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a JOIN db3.c USING (k)", accessed("db2.a", "db3.c"), ok},
		{"describe", sqlmeta.StatementTypeDescribe, "DESCRIBE TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), ok},
		{"show create", sqlmeta.StatementTypeShowCreateTable, "SHOW CREATE TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), ok},
		{"exists", sqlmeta.StatementTypeExistsTable, "EXISTS TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), ok},
		{"insert select into an ordinary table", sqlmeta.StatementTypeInsert, "INSERT INTO db1.o SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db1.o", "db2.a"), ok},
		{"insert", sqlmeta.StatementTypeInsert, "INSERT INTO db2.a FORMAT Native", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"insert select into a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeInsert, "INSERT INTO db3.c SELECT * FROM db1.o", accessed("db3.c", "db1.o"), replicaErr("db3.c", 3)},
		{"update", sqlmeta.StatementTypeUpdate, "ALTER TABLE db2.a UPDATE x = 1 WHERE 1", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"delete", sqlmeta.StatementTypeDelete, "DELETE FROM db2.a WHERE 1", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"truncate", sqlmeta.StatementTypeTruncateTable, "TRUNCATE TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"create same name", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateTable, "CREATE TABLE db2.a (a UInt8) ENGINE = Memory", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"create as select", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateTable, "CREATE TABLE db2.a ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT 1 AS a", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"create as select from a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateTable, "CREATE TABLE db1.o ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db1.o", "db2.a"), ok},
		{"drop", sqlmeta.StatementTypeDropTable, "DROP TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"alter", sqlmeta.StatementTypeAlterTable, "ALTER TABLE db2.a ADD COLUMN b UInt8", accessed("db2.a"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"rename", sqlmeta.StatementTypeRenameTable, "RENAME TABLE db2.a TO db2.z", accessed("db2.a", "db2.z"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"materialized view to a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateMaterializedView, "CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW db1.mv TO db2.a AS SELECT a FROM db1.o", accessed("db1.mv", "db2.a", "db1.o"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"materialized view named like a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateMaterializedView, "CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW db2.a ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT a FROM db1.o", accessed("db2.a", "db1.o"), replicaErr("db2.a", 0)},
		{"materialized view reading a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateMaterializedView, "CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW db1.mv TO db1.o AS SELECT a FROM db2.a", accessed("db1.mv", "db1.o", "db2.a"), ok},
		{"view over a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeCreateView, "CREATE VIEW db1.v AS SELECT a FROM db2.a", accessed("db1.v", "db2.a"), ok},
		{"a copy and a pending table", sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a JOIN db1.p USING (k)", accessed("db2.a", "db1.p"), pendingErr("db1.p")},
	} {
		check(t, tc.name, (&Plugin{}).OnQuery(context.Background(), replicaQuery(newSession(t, 40), tc.typ, tc.sql, tc.tables)), tc.want)
	}
}

// TestOnQuery_ReplicaReadBeginsAndCompletesAnInFlightRead is clarification
// K44 of Plan S3-C4: an allowed query that touches a Replica table counts one
// in-flight read per database from OnQuery until OnQueryComplete, through the
// chain as Relay drives it. A refused query, or one that touches no Replica
// table, counts nothing, and two sessions count separately.
func TestOnQuery_ReplicaReadBeginsAndCompletesAnInFlightRead(t *testing.T) {
	reads := sitable.NewReplicaReads()
	gate := &Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads, TableState: replicaState()}
	chain := &plugin.PluginChain{
		QueryPlugins:         []plugin.QueryPlugin{gate},
		QueryCompletePlugins: []plugin.QueryCompletePlugin{gate},
		ClosePlugins:         []plugin.ClosePlugin{gate},
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	sess := newSession(t, 41)
	if err := chain.OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a JOIN db2.b USING (k) JOIN db3.c USING (k) JOIN db1.o USING (k)", accessed("db2.a", "db2.b", "db3.c", "db1.o"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a join of copies must be allowed: %v", err)
	}
	if got := reads.Counts(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, map[string]int{"db2": 1, "db3": 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("in flight = %v, want one read of db2 and one of db3", got)
	}
	other := newSession(t, 42)
	if err := chain.OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(other, sqlmeta.StatementTypeDescribe, "DESCRIBE TABLE db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("DESCRIBE of a copy must be allowed: %v", err)
	}
	if reads.InFlight("db2") != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("db2 in flight = %d, want 2 (two sessions)", reads.InFlight("db2"))
	}
	chain.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)
	chain.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess) // a second complete ends nothing more
	if got := reads.Counts(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, map[string]int{"db2": 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("after the join completed in flight = %v, want the DESCRIBE's db2 only", got)
	}
	chain.OnQueryComplete(ctx, other)

	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		typ    sqlmeta.StatementType
		sql    string
		tables []sqlmeta.AccessedTable
	}{
		{"no copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db1.o", accessed("db1.o")},
		{"write to a copy", sqlmeta.StatementTypeInsert, "INSERT INTO db2.a FORMAT Native", accessed("db2.a")},
		{"copy refused by another table", sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a JOIN db1.p USING (k)", accessed("db2.a", "db1.p")},
	} {
		_ = chain.OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(sess, tc.typ, tc.sql, tc.tables))
		if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: in flight = %v, want nothing counted", tc.name, got)
		}
		chain.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)
	}

	// A lost complete never leaves a database counted: the session's next
	// counted read ends the end it still holds.
	if err := chain.OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db3.c", accessed("db3.c"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := chain.OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := reads.Counts(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, map[string]int{"db2": 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("after a lost complete in flight = %v, want only the session's current read of db2", got)
	}
	chain.OnClose(sess)
	if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after close in flight = %v, want empty", got)
	}

	// Without a counter the gate decides exactly as before and counts nothing.
	if err := (&Plugin{}).OnQuery(ctx, replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a read of a copy without a counter: %v", err)
	}
	(&Plugin{}).OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)
	(&Plugin{}).OnClose(sess)
}

// TestOnClose_EndsAnInFlightReplicaRead: a client that disconnects mid-query
// never reaches OnQueryComplete, so the session's close ends its read, and a
// late complete after the close changes nothing.
func TestOnClose_EndsAnInFlightReplicaRead(t *testing.T) {
	reads := sitable.NewReplicaReads()
	gate := &Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads, TableState: replicaState()}
	sess := newSession(t, 43)
	if err := gate.OnQuery(context.Background(), replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db3.c", accessed("db3.c"))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if reads.InFlight("db3") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("db3 in flight = %d, want 1", reads.InFlight("db3"))
	}
	(&plugin.PluginChain{ClosePlugins: []plugin.ClosePlugin{gate}}).OnClose(sess)
	if reads.InFlight("db3") != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after close db3 in flight = %d, want 0", reads.InFlight("db3"))
	}
	gate.OnQueryComplete(context.Background(), sess)
	gate.OnClose(sess)
	if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("in flight = %v, want empty", got)
	}
}

// TestOnQuery_OperatorSessionsAreNotCounted: maintenance and platform-operator
// sessions return before the matrix, and peer-trusted and origin-side
// forwarding sessions skip the gate in the chain, so none of them counts a
// read of a copy.
func TestOnQuery_OperatorSessionsAreNotCounted(t *testing.T) {
	reads := sitable.NewReplicaReads()
	gate := &Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads, TableState: replicaState()}
	chain := &plugin.PluginChain{
		QueryPlugins:         []plugin.QueryPlugin{gate},
		QueryCompletePlugins: []plugin.QueryCompletePlugin{gate},
	}
	for i, setup := range []func(chsession.Session){
		func(s chsession.Session) { s.State().SetMaintenance(true) },
		func(s chsession.Session) { s.State().SetPlatformOperator(true) },
		func(s chsession.Session) { s.State().SetPeerTrust("10.0.0.7:9001") },
		func(s chsession.Session) { s.State().SetForwarding(true) },
	} {
		sess := newSession(t, int64(44+i))
		setup(sess)
		if err := chain.OnQuery(context.Background(), replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("session %d: %v", i, err)
		}
		if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("session %d: in flight = %v, want nothing counted", i, got)
		}
		chain.OnQueryComplete(context.Background(), sess)
	}
}

// TestOnQuery_AReplicaReadPlannedBeforeServingEndedIsRefused is clarification
// K44 of Plan S3-C4 with a rewriter blocked across the host's two lease
// polls: the query took its Replica snapshot in rewrite and waited there
// while the host published a snapshot without db2's Replica entries and then
// found no read of db2 in flight, so it released db2's lease and the member
// may install. When the query reaches the gate it is refused with the
// retryable 733 before anything reaches ClickHouse, and it is not left
// counted. A copy re-served under another name, a table served by another
// owner and a gate without a table state refuse the same way; a query planned
// on the current snapshot is admitted.
func TestOnQuery_AReplicaReadPlannedBeforeServingEndedIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	state := replicaState()
	reads := sitable.NewReplicaReads()
	gate := &Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads, TableState: state}
	sess := newSession(t, 48)
	stale := replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a JOIN db3.c USING (k)", accessed("db2.a", "db3.c"))
	stale.TableSnapshot = state.Current()
	// The host's first poll publishes a snapshot without db2's entries; its
	// next poll finds no read of db2 in flight and releases the lease.
	state.Set(replicaTables()[0], replicaTables()[3])
	if n := reads.InFlight("db2"); n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("db2 in flight = %d before the blocked query resumed", n)
	}
	refused := outcome{733, "storage_integrity: table db2.a is no longer served from the copy this query was planned against; retry the query (retryable)"}
	check(t, "stale snapshot", gate.OnQuery(ctx, stale), refused)
	if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("in flight = %v after the refusal, want nothing counted", got)
	}
	gate.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)

	// A query planned on the current snapshot reads db3.c.
	fresh := replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db3.c", accessed("db3.c"))
	fresh.TableSnapshot = state.Current()
	if err := gate.OnQuery(ctx, fresh); err != nil || reads.InFlight("db3") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("OnQuery = %v, db3 in flight %d; want an admitted, counted read", err, reads.InFlight("db3"))
	}
	gate.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)

	// db2 is served again, from another incarnation's copy, or by another
	// owner: the old plan names neither.
	planned := replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))
	for name, a := range map[string]sitable.Table{
		"another copy":  {ID: "db2.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: sitable.CopyTable("db2.a", 5), ReplicaOf: 0},
		"another owner": {ID: "db2.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: sitable.CopyTable("db2.a", 4), ReplicaOf: 2},
	} {
		state.Set(a, replicaTables()[3])
		check(t, name, gate.OnQuery(ctx, planned), refused)
		if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: in flight = %v, want nothing counted", name, got)
		}
		gate.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)
	}
	check(t, "no table state", (&Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads}).OnQuery(ctx, planned), refused)
	if got := reads.Counts(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("without a table state in flight = %v, want nothing counted", got)
	}
}

// TestReplicaReadAdmissionNeverOverlapsARelease is clarification K44 under
// concurrency: sessions plan against the current snapshot, yield, and then
// reach the gate, while a host publishes a snapshot without db2's Replica
// entries, waits until no read of db2 is in flight and releases the lease.
// No read planned on a snapshot that serves db2 is admitted after that
// release (a read planned later finds db2 Ordinary, which the rewriter sends
// to its owner); run it with -race.
func TestReplicaReadAdmissionNeverOverlapsARelease(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	for round := range 50 {
		state := replicaState()
		reads := sitable.NewReplicaReads()
		gate := &Plugin{ReplicaReads: reads, TableState: state}
		var released atomic.Bool
		var late atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for i := range 8 {
			sess := newSession(t, int64(1000+round*8+i))
			wg.Go(func() {
				for range 20 {
					qctx := replicaQuery(sess, sqlmeta.StatementTypeSelect, "SELECT * FROM db2.a", accessed("db2.a"))
					qctx.TableSnapshot = state.Current()
					fromCopy := qctx.TableSnapshot.Lookup("db2", "a").Status == sitable.Replica
					runtime.Gosched()
					if gate.OnQuery(ctx, qctx) == nil && fromCopy {
						if released.Load() {
							late.Add(1)
						}
						runtime.Gosched()
					}
					gate.OnQueryComplete(ctx, sess)
				}
			})
		}
		runtime.Gosched()
		state.Set(replicaTables()[0], replicaTables()[3])
		for reads.InFlight("db2") != 0 {
			runtime.Gosched()
		}
		released.Store(true)
		wg.Wait()
		if n := late.Load(); n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("round %d: %d reads of db2 admitted after the host released its lease", round, n)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// Plugin is the server-mode table-state QueryPlugin. It is registered only
// when storage_integrity.enabled.
type Plugin struct {
	// ReplicaReads, when set, counts every allowed query that accesses a
	// Replica table, once per database, from OnQuery until OnQueryComplete or
	// OnClose (spec 2026-10-14 §11): the host releases a database's serving
	// lease only once none is in flight. build.go then also registers the
	// plugin as a QueryCompletePlugin and a ClosePlugin. Nil counts nothing.
	ReplicaReads *sitable.ReplicaReads
	// TableState is the port rewrite took the query's snapshot from. With
	// ReplicaReads, a read is admitted only once it is counted and
	// TableState.Current() still serves every Replica table it accesses from
	// the copy the query was planned against (clarification K44); without a
	// TableState no replica read is admitted.
	TableState sitable.TableState

	// replicaReadEnds maps sess.ID() (int64) to the end of the session's
	// in-flight replica read. A session runs one query at a time.
	replicaReadEnds sync.Map
}
```

```go
// OnQuery refuses the statement when any accessed table refuses it. When
// several do, an unknown table wins over a non-retryable refusal, which wins
// over a retryable one; ties keep the first accessed table. With ReplicaReads
// set, an allowed statement that accesses a Replica table begins one
// in-flight read of each such database, which OnQueryComplete or OnClose
// ends, and is admitted only while the current snapshot still serves its
// Replica tables from the copies it was planned against (733 otherwise).
//
// A missing snapshot fails closed. The plugin is registered only when storage
// integrity is enabled, and rewrite, which runs first under the same chain
// filters, attaches a snapshot to every query it sees (maintenance and
// platform-operator sessions included), so nil can only mean a wiring defect.
```

replace the tail of `OnQuery` (`:85-95`, from `sessionDB :=` through the closing brace) with:

```go
	sessionDB := qctx.Session.State().LogicalDatabaseName()
	var worst severity
	var worstErr error
	var served []servedAccess
	for _, a := range accessesOf(qctx, sessionDB) {
		t := qctx.TableSnapshot.Lookup(a.database, a.table)
		sev, err := decide(t, a.class)
		if sev > worst {
			worst, worstErr = sev, err
		}
		if t.Status == sitable.Replica {
			served = append(served, servedAccess{database: a.database, table: a.table, planned: t})
		}
	}
	if worstErr == nil && len(served) > 0 && p.ReplicaReads != nil {
		return p.beginReplicaRead(qctx.Session, served)
	}
	return worstErr

// servedAccess is one accessed table that the query's snapshot answers
// Replica, as that snapshot answers it.
type servedAccess struct {
	database, table string
	planned         sitable.Table
}

// beginReplicaRead counts the session's query as one in-flight read of each
// replica-served database it accesses, then admits it only if the current
// snapshot still serves every such table from the copy and owner the query
// was planned against (clarification K44). rewrite took the query's snapshot
// before this count, so a query that waited there while the host published a
// snapshot without the database, found no read in flight and released the
// lease could otherwise read the copy during its member's install. Counting
// first and checking the current snapshot second closes that gap: the host
// reads InFlight only after it published the snapshot that drops the
// database, so either it sees this read counted and waits, or this check sees
// that snapshot and refuses, retryably, before anything reaches ClickHouse.
// A refused read is uncounted at once. An end the session still holds is
// ended first, so a lost complete never leaves a database counted.
func (p *Plugin) beginReplicaRead(sess chsession.Session, served []servedAccess) error {
	databases := make([]string, 0, len(served))
	for _, s := range served {
		databases = append(databases, s.database)
	}
	slices.Sort(databases)
	end := p.ReplicaReads.Begin(slices.Compact(databases))
	if previous, loaded := p.replicaReadEnds.Swap(sess.ID(), end); loaded {
		previous.(func())()
	}
	var current sitable.Snapshot
	if p.TableState != nil {
		current = p.TableState.Current()
	}
	for _, s := range served {
		if current == nil || !sameCopy(current.Lookup(s.database, s.table), s.planned) {
			p.endReplicaRead(sess)
			return refuse(CodeRetryable, "storage_integrity: table %s is no longer served from the copy this query was planned against; retry the query (retryable)", s.planned.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// sameCopy reports whether now answers a table Replica from the same copy
// and owner as planned.
func sameCopy(now, planned sitable.Table) bool {
	return now.Status == sitable.Replica && now.ID == planned.ID && now.CopyTable == planned.CopyTable && now.ReplicaOf == planned.ReplicaOf
}

// endReplicaRead ends the session's in-flight replica read, if any.
func (p *Plugin) endReplicaRead(sess chsession.Session) {
	if sess == nil {
		return
	}
	if end, ok := p.replicaReadEnds.LoadAndDelete(sess.ID()); ok {
		end.(func())()
	}
}

// OnQueryComplete ends the in-flight replica read OnQuery began for the
// session's query. Calling it again, or for a query that read no copy, does
// nothing.
func (p *Plugin) OnQueryComplete(_ context.Context, sess chsession.Session) {
	p.endReplicaRead(sess)
}

// OnClose ends any replica read still in flight when the session closes: a
// client that disconnects mid-query never reaches OnQueryComplete.
func (p *Plugin) OnClose(sess chsession.Session) {
	p.endReplicaRead(sess)
}
```

```bash

git -C "$W" commit -m "feat(sitablestate): Replica rows and the in-flight replica-read count

A Replica table is another SI indexer's published data served from a
member copy (spec 2026-10-14 §11), so the gate answers its reads and
metadata and refuses every write, same-name CREATE, data-carrying
creation, DROP, ALTER, RENAME and materialized-view target with 392
naming the owner. Before, decide fell through to allow for a status
it did not name.

With a ReplicaReads counter, every allowed query that accesses a
Replica table counts one read per database from OnQuery until
OnQueryComplete or OnClose (clarification K44), so the host releases a
serving lease only once no query still reads the copy. A counted read
is admitted only while the current snapshot of the gate's TableState
still serves its Replica tables from the copies the query was planned
against; otherwise it is uncounted and refused with the retryable 733.
rewrite takes the query's snapshot before this count, so without the
check a query that waited in rewrite across the host's release could
read a copy its member is installing. The plugin is then also a
complete and close plugin; without a counter it decides and counts
exactly as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
```

```go
// resolveStorageIntegrityTableState selects the table-set source (spec
// 2026-09-24 §6.1). It returns (nil, nil, nil) when storage integrity is
// disabled. When enabled exactly one source is required: the configured
// storage_integrity.tables (served by sitable.Static, returned as the second
// value) or the host-injected Options.StorageIntegrityTableState.
// Options.StorageIntegrityReplicaReads requires the injected state, the only
// one that answers Replica (spec 2026-10-14 §11).
func resolveStorageIntegrityTableState(opts Options, reg registry.Registry) (sitable.TableState, *sitable.Static, error) {
	cfg := opts.Config
	injected := opts.StorageIntegrityTableState
	if isNilInterface(injected) {
		injected = nil
	}
	if opts.StorageIntegrityReplicaReads != nil && injected == nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("Options.StorageIntegrityReplicaReads requires Options.StorageIntegrityTableState")
	}
```

## Task 43: housegate — replica-served routing, reads from the copy and the computed-argument peer guard (S3-C4)

Spec §11 (Routing, Read modes; Host status: writes and DDL refused), §14 bullet 1 as revisited for `hg_replica` (K48), the housegate items of §15 and §17, contract §29.2, clarifications K46 and K48. Task 42 gave HouseGate the status `sitable.Replica`, `Snapshot.Served()`, `sitable.ServedDatabases` and the `sitablestate` Replica rows, but nothing routes a session to a copy yet. `forward.Plugin` pivots every hello and `USE` of a peer owner's database to that owner (`pkg/plugins/forward/forward.go:111-114`, `:229-245`), and `buildStorageIntegrityArgs` lists only Active tables (`pkg/rewriter/storage_integrity.go:184-194`), so a Replica table would resolve through its database's remote mapping to the quarantined or unreachable owner. And `sireserved`'s peer rules refuse only a literal mention of a reserved name (`pkg/plugins/sireserved/plugin.go:108-131`), so once `si_gateway` holds `SELECT ON hg_replica.*` (Task 47) a peer loopback could read every owner's copies through `merge(concat('hg_', 'replica'), '.*')`. This task:

- gives `forward.Plugin` a table-state port: a hello or standalone `USE` of a replica-served database stays local (a forwarded session returns home through the existing `rebindToLocal`), the session is marked, and once the database is no longer served every other statement on the marked session gets the retryable 733 reconnect refusal;
- lists every Replica table in the rewrite with `SafeTable` = `UnsafeTable` = `hg_replica.<CopyTable>`, keeps the database's remote mapping (its ordinary tables still go to the owner) except for the standalone `USE` that `forward` kept local, refuses `unsafe_latest` of a copy right after the first pass, and maps the copy name back in the scrubber;
- adds the computed-argument rule to `sireserved`'s peer rules (`PeerCarrierArgumentViolation`, reason `computed_carrier_argument`) and corrects the internal-listen warning, which said such names were not refused;

Notes:
- **Measured engine behaviour (2026-10-16).** Measured in a scratch export of housegate `origin/main` `862a7a8` with stubs of S3-C1's `sitable.CopyTable` and Task 42's names (contract §16, §29.1) and the code of this task. The engines are the native rewriter-go that housegate pins (`go.mod:108`, `github.com/housegate/rewriter-go v0.17.0`, FFI library v0.17.0 as `ci.yml:111` fetches it) and `rewriter-grpc` v0.17.0 at the devnet2 pin `us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/housegate-rewriter:0.17.0@sha256:b3b227fa4a28bd9dcd5d3d6aa172890ff66d7bf60e1c7039428efe4dabebb50a` (production `origin/main` `206c42357`, `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml:40`). With `rrdb` remote-mapped to its owner, both engines render `SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a` as `SELECT count() FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (_hg_row_id) FROM hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3) AS "rrdb.a"` (the gRPC engine quotes the alias with backticks) and `SELECT count() FROM rrdb.o`, an ordinary table of the same database, as `SELECT count() FROM remote('localhost:9000', 'phys', 'rrdb.o', '__route__|owner.internal:9001|', '') AS "rrdb.o"`. SI tables resolve before remote mapping in both: rewriter-go v0.17.0 (`24b54fb`) `internal/nameresolve/resolve.go:281-284` (`LookupStorageIntegrity`, "consulted BEFORE the ordinary dynamic resolution", the same lines in v0.18.0 `1a140d8`) and rewriter v0.17.0 (`b56ae37`) `src/handlers/select.cc:97`, `:204` (`lookupStorageIntegrity`).
- **Both engines refuse a `USE` of a remote-mapped database** (`rewriter rejected SQL (code=UnsupportedStatement): USE target 'rrdb' is mapped to a remote upstream via dynamic_args.logical_database_to_remote_upstream_index; USE has no remote analog`). Keeping the `USE` local in `forward` is therefore not enough. `localizeReplicaServedUse` (`pkg/rewriter`) drops the database from `logical_database_to_remote_upstream_index` for that one statement, when the statement is a standalone `USE` (the same `sicore.ParseUseDatabase` that `forward.matchUse` uses) of a database the query's snapshot serves. A `USE` names no table, so no read loses its remote mapping, and every later statement rebuilds the mapping from scratch (`buildRemoteUpstreams` returns fresh maps per call). With it both engines answer `USE rrdb` as `USE phys` with `database_rewrites {rrdb: phys}`, which `maybeUpdateLogicalDatabase` records. This name is not in contract §29.2 and is recorded in Appendix B.
- **Writes and DDL of a Replica table never reach `sitablestate` with the pinned engines.** Both refuse every write and DDL of such a table first, with 403 `rewriter rejected SQL (code=UnsupportedStatement): …` (measured through the whole server chain on the native engine, Step 18, and at the rewriter seam on both engines). On the native engine INSERT (INSERT … SELECT included) and `DROP TABLE` into the remote-mapped database get `insert target maps to a remote upstream; remote() can only appear as a SELECT-side table function` (`drop_table target …` for the drop), and ALTER, DELETE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE, RENAME, `CREATE TABLE`, `CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT` and `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW … TO` get `storage-integrity table rrdb.a accepts writes only through the signed statement lane`. The gRPC engine refuses the same statements, an INSERT with `INSERT target's logical resolves to a remote upstream (via dynamic_args.logical_database_to_remote_upstream_index); remote() can only appear as a SELECT-side table function`, a `DROP TABLE` with `DROP TABLE target's logical resolves to a remote upstream …`, an INSERT … SELECT from `rrdb.b` with `storage-integrity table rrdb.b accepts writes only through the signed statement lane`, and the rest with the native engine's signed-lane text. The 392 naming the owner (Task 42's Replica row) is the second layer, pinned by `TestDecide_ReplicaRows`. `TestReplicaReads_WritesAndDDLAreRefusedNamingTheOwner` therefore accepts the engine's 403 or that 392, requires the copy and the catalog unchanged, and logs each refusal for the PR record (Appendix B; reported against the wording of contract §29.1 and Review Focus 4).
- **Plugin order is unchanged.** The query chain (`build.go:707-1001`) runs auth → usage → `sireserved` → `sipeerguard` → `tablerefguard` → `querysettings` → (concurrency, lthash) → `forward` (`:850`) → rewrite (`:873`) → `sitablestate` (`:879`). The hello chain (`:1018-1030`) runs `routeplugin.Stripper` → `credential` → `forward` → `sessionstate` → rewrite. A session kept local therefore runs `sessionstate` (`LogicalDatabase = <db>`) and rewrite's `OnHello` (`hello.Database = rewriter.physical_database`) exactly as a local session does. A client that names a copy directly is refused by `tablerefguard` before `forward` (measured: `table-reference guard: reserved_name: reserved database hg_replica is not addressable; the rewriter applies the same policy`).
- **The mark** (`SessionState.ReplicaServedDatabase`) follows the concurrency invariant of `IsForwarding`: the hello and query hooks write it through `SetReplicaServedDatabase` on the relay's client-to-upstream goroutine and read it there, and `Snapshot()` copies it under the lock. It is assigned after the snapshot literal, so the literal's alignment, which Task 44's `ReplicaFailoverEligible` also touches, does not move.
- **Peer-trusted sessions behave exactly as today** (Review Focus 3). `OnHello` keeps its early return. In `OnQuery`, a session forwarded from a peer (`IsPeerTrusted && IsForwardedFromPeer`, which the chain lets through) keeps today's `USE` pivots and is never refused, because its entry proxy made the routing decision; plain peer loopbacks never reach `forward.OnQuery` (`RunOnPeerTrust() == false`).
- **The 733 keeps the connection.** A plugin refusal ends the query and the relay keeps reading (`pkg/proxy/relay.go:1045-1052`), so the client gets the 733 on every statement until it reconnects (a fresh hello pivots to the owner) or issues a `USE` elsewhere; when serving resumes, the marked session reads again. A `USE` of a database hosted elsewhere and not served clears the mark whether or not it pivots (the session may already be routed to that peer), and so does a `USE` of a database this proxy hosts.
- **Snapshots.** `forward` reads `TableState.Current()`, and rewrite takes the query's own snapshot afterwards (`pkg/plugins/rewrite/rewriter.go:143-151`). If serving ends between the two, a statement passes `forward` and its table then answers Ordinary, so the rewriter sends it to the owner through `remote()`, and a quarantined owner refuses it with its 392 (spec 2026-10-10 C13). No read is ever answered from a copy that the query's snapshot does not serve.
- **`unsafe_latest`.** Spec §11's "before the engine runs" is read as contract §29.2 fixes it: the refusal needs the accessed tables, which only the engine's first pass reports, and that pass only classifies, so the refusal comes before anything reaches ClickHouse. With `SafeTable` = `UnsafeTable` = the copy, an engine's `unsafe_latest` rendering (`hg_safe ∪ hg_unsafe` minus promoted parts) would read the copy twice. `requireNoReplicaUnderUnsafeLatest` runs on the first pass's accessed ids, before `requireActiveAccessedIDs` (which would otherwise refuse with its generic `not an Active storage-integrity table` text) and before the promotion port; the first pass never reaches ClickHouse. On a host without a promotion port, `buildStorageIntegrityArgs` already refuses `unsafe_latest` with its `unavailable on this housegate` text, before the engine runs.
- **The K48 rule.** It applies on peer-trusted, non-forwarded sessions, after S3-A's scan, placeholder and reserved-name rules. A bare or backquoted `IsObjectCarrierName` callable followed by `(` must take only arguments that are each exactly one token: a string literal (heredocs included) or an unsigned decimal integer (a word of ASCII digits only). Anything else is refused 392, naming the callable as written: a call, an operator, a cast, a parenthesised literal, a signed number, a decimal, an empty argument, a call that never closes, and every identifier, bare (`1d` included), backquoted, double-quoted or qualified (`` phys.`db1.u` ``, `d.1`). An identifier is refused because ClickHouse's analyzer resolves an identifier argument of a table function through the statement's aliases before it takes it as a name: measured on ClickHouse 26.3.51.7 (`clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3`), `WITH concat('hg_', 'replica') AS d SELECT * FROM merge(d, '.*')`, the same with `` `d` ``, `"d"` or `1d`, `SELECT *, concat('hg_', 'replica') AS d FROM merge(d, '.*')`, an inline `(concat('hg_', 'replica') AS d)` in `WHERE`, an enclosing query's `WITH`, `WITH concat('hg_', 'replica') AS phys … remote('127.0.0.1:9000', phys, 'secret')` and `WITH tuple(concat('hg_', 'replica'), 'secret') AS d … remote('127.0.0.1:9000', d.1, d.2)` each read the row of `hg_replica.secret`, while `AS 1` is a syntax error, so a digits-only word is always a number. A lexical guard cannot tell which identifiers an alias shadows, so it admits none; no legitimate leg needs one. Arguments are never evaluated: the rule is "no computed argument", not a proof that a computed one is safe (constant folding). S3-A's `peerLegForms`, and the legs ClickHouse pushes into a peer leg (`remote('127.0.0.1:9000', 'phys_pr', 'prdb.l', 'housegate_test', '[HIDDEN]')`, measured by S3-A's `TestPeerReservedGuard_MeasuredRemoteSecondaryQueriesPass`), carry literal arguments only and still pass. Operator sessions keep refusing every carrier by name, and ordinary and forwarded sessions are unchanged (the engines refuse `merge(concat('hg_', 'replica'), '.*')` there, pinned by the parity tests).
- **The internal-listen warning** (`build.go:170`) said the guard does not refuse names "built by computed table-function arguments". That is no longer true for object carriers, so the text and its test change. The network rule it states stays.

```go
// --------------------------------------------------------------------
// Replica-served routing (spec 2026-10-14 §11)
// --------------------------------------------------------------------

// replicaServedState is a table state serving rrdb (owned by indexer 200)
// from a member's copy on this host.
func replicaServedState() *sitable.Fake {
	return sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary, sitable.Table{
		ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__a__i3", ReplicaOf: 200,
	})
}

// replicaRouting is a host (indexer 100) whose table state serves rrdb, owned
// by indexer 200, plus a database other on indexer 200 that is not served and
// a local database local_db. Every dial is recorded.
func replicaRouting(t *testing.T, state sitable.TableState) (*Plugin, *[]string, *[]*chproto.ClientHello) {
	t.Helper()
	ns := newFakeNS(t).
		WithDatabase("rrdb", 200).
		WithDatabase("other", 200).
		WithDatabase("local_db", 100).
		WithIndexer(100, "self", 9000).
		WithIndexer(200, "owner.internal", 9001)
	p := newTestForwardPlugin(t, ns, 100)
	p.TableState = state
	p.PhysicalDatabase = "phys"
	var dials []string
	var localHellos []*chproto.ClientHello
	p.dialPeer = func(_ context.Context, addr string) (*chproto.Codec, error) {
		dials = append(dials, addr)
		c, _ := pipedCodec(t)
		return c, nil
	}
	p.rebindFn = func(_ context.Context, _ chsession.Session, _ *chproto.Codec, _ *chproto.ClientHello) error {
		return nil
	}
	p.LocalDialer = func(_ context.Context) (*chproto.Codec, error) {
		dials = append(dials, "local")
		c, _ := pipedCodec(t)
		return c, nil
	}
	p.localRebindFn = func(_ context.Context, sess chsession.Session, _ *chproto.Codec, hello *chproto.ClientHello) error {
		localHellos = append(localHellos, hello)
		sess.State().SetForwarding(false)
		sess.State().SetRouteTarget("")
		return nil
	}
	return p, &dials, &localHellos
}

func queryOn(sess chsession.Session, sql string) *plugin.QueryContext {
	return &plugin.QueryContext{Session: sess, OriginalSQL: sql}
}

const servingEndedMessage = "storage_integrity: database rrdb is no longer served from a copy on this host; reconnect to reach its owner (retryable)"

// TestForward_ReplicaServedHelloStaysLocal: a hello of a database the host
// serves from its member's copy is not pivoted to the owner; the session is
// marked. A database of the same owner that is not served still pivots.
func TestForward_ReplicaServedHelloStaysLocal(t *testing.T) {
	p, dials, _ := replicaRouting(t, replicaServedState())

	sess := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), sess, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "rrdb"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnHello(rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	snap := sess.State().Snapshot()
	if len(*dials) != 0 || snap.IsForwarding || snap.RouteTarget != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v forwarding=%v route=%q, want the session kept local", *dials, snap.IsForwarding, snap.RouteTarget)
	}
	if snap.ReplicaServedDatabase != "rrdb" {
		t.Fatalf("ReplicaServedDatabase = %q, want rrdb", snap.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}

	other := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), other, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "other"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnHello(other): %v", err)
	}
	if got := other.State().Snapshot(); strings.Join(*dials, ",") != "owner.internal:9001" || !got.IsForwarding || got.ReplicaServedDatabase != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v forwarding=%v mark=%q, want a database that is not served pivoted to its owner unmarked", *dials, got.IsForwarding, got.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}
}

// TestForward_USEOfAReplicaServedDatabaseStaysLocal: on a local session, USE of
// a served database dials nothing and marks the session; the USE itself then
// runs locally (rewrite maps it to the physical database).
func TestForward_USEOfAReplicaServedDatabaseStaysLocal(t *testing.T) {
	p, dials, _ := replicaRouting(t, replicaServedState())
	sess := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, "USE rrdb")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnQuery(USE rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	snap := sess.State().Snapshot()
	if len(*dials) != 0 || snap.IsForwarding || snap.ReplicaServedDatabase != "rrdb" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v forwarding=%v mark=%q, want no dial and the session marked rrdb", *dials, snap.IsForwarding, snap.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}
}

// TestForward_USEOfAReplicaServedDatabaseRebindsAForwardedSessionToLocal: a
// session forwarded to a peer comes back to the local ClickHouse through the
// existing return-home pivot (physical database, mapped credentials) and is
// marked.
func TestForward_USEOfAReplicaServedDatabaseRebindsAForwardedSessionToLocal(t *testing.T) {
	p, dials, localHellos := replicaRouting(t, replicaServedState())
	sess := newTestSession(t)
	sess.State().SetForwarding(true)
	sess.State().SetRouteTarget("owner.internal:9001")
	sess.State().MappedUser = "ch_admin"
	sess.State().MappedPassword = "ch_secret"
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, "USE rrdb")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnQuery(USE rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	if strings.Join(*dials, ",") != "local" || len(*localHellos) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v local rebinds=%d, want one rebind to the local ClickHouse", *dials, len(*localHellos))
	}
	if hello := (*localHellos)[0]; hello.Database != "phys" || hello.User != "ch_admin" || hello.Password != "ch_secret" {
		t.Fatalf("local hello = %+v, want the physical database and the mapped credentials", hello)
	}
	snap := sess.State().Snapshot()
	if snap.IsForwarding || snap.RouteTarget != "" || snap.ReplicaServedDatabase != "rrdb" {
		t.Fatalf("forwarding=%v route=%q mark=%q, want a local session marked rrdb", snap.IsForwarding, snap.RouteTarget, snap.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}
}

// TestForward_ServingEndedIsARetryableRefusal: while the database is served, a
// marked session's statements pass; once the snapshot stops serving it, every
// statement but a USE is refused with the retryable 733 asking the client to
// reconnect.
func TestForward_ServingEndedIsARetryableRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	state := replicaServedState()
	p, _, _ := replicaRouting(t, state)
	sess := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), sess, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "rrdb"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnHello(rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, "SELECT count() FROM a")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a read while rrdb is served: %v", err)
	}
	state.Set() // the member revoked the lease: rrdb is no longer served
	for _, sql := range []string{"SELECT count() FROM a", "SELECT 1", "INSERT INTO a VALUES (1)", "SHOW TABLES"} {
		err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, sql))
		var ce *chproto.ClientError
		if !errors.As(err, &ce) || ce.Code != chproto.CodeTableIsBeingRestarted || ce.Message != servingEndedMessage {
			t.Fatalf("OnQuery(%q) = %v, want 733 %q", sql, err, servingEndedMessage)
		}
	}
	state.Set(sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__a__i4", ReplicaOf: 200})
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, "SELECT count() FROM a")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a read once rrdb is served again: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestForward_UseElsewhereClearsTheReplicaMark: a USE of a database hosted
// elsewhere and not served (pivoted to, or already the session's route
// target), or a USE of a local database, clears the mark, so the end of
// serving no longer refuses that session.
func TestForward_UseElsewhereClearsTheReplicaMark(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, use, route, dials string
	}{
		{name: "pivot to the owner", use: "USE other", dials: "owner.internal:9001"},
		{name: "already routed to the owner", use: "USE other", route: "owner.internal:9001", dials: ""},
		{name: "local database", use: "USE local_db", dials: ""},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			state := replicaServedState()
			p, dials, _ := replicaRouting(t, state)
			sess := newTestSession(t)
			if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), sess, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "rrdb"}); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("OnHello(rrdb): %v", err)
			}
			if tc.route != "" {
				sess.State().SetRouteTarget(tc.route)
			}
			if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, tc.use)); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("OnQuery(%s): %v", tc.use, err)
			}
			if got := sess.State().Snapshot().ReplicaServedDatabase; got != "" || strings.Join(*dials, ",") != tc.dials {
				t.Fatalf("mark=%q dials=%v, want the mark cleared and dials %q", got, *dials, tc.dials)
			}
			state.Set()
			if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(sess, "SELECT 1")); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("an unmarked session must not be refused when serving ends: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestForward_WithoutTableStateBehavesAsToday: with no table state the plugin
// pivots a hello and a USE of a remote database exactly as before replica
// reads, marks nothing, and never refuses a statement.
func TestForward_WithoutTableStateBehavesAsToday(t *testing.T) {
	p, dials, _ := replicaRouting(t, nil)
	sess := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), sess, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "rrdb"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnHello(rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	snap := sess.State().Snapshot()
	if strings.Join(*dials, ",") != "owner.internal:9001" || !snap.IsForwarding || snap.ReplicaServedDatabase != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v forwarding=%v mark=%q, want today's hello pivot", *dials, snap.IsForwarding, snap.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}
	local := newTestSession(t)
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(local, "USE rrdb")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnQuery(USE rrdb): %v", err)
	}
	if strings.Join(*dials, ",") != "owner.internal:9001,owner.internal:9001" || local.State().Snapshot().ReplicaServedDatabase != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v, want today's USE pivot and no mark", *dials)
	}
	marked := newTestSession(t)
	marked.State().SetReplicaServedDatabase("rrdb")
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(marked, "SELECT 1")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("without a table state nothing is refused: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestForward_PeerTrustedSessionsIgnoreReplicaServing: a peer-trusted hello
// keeps its early return, and a session forwarded from a peer keeps today's
// USE pivot and is never refused: the entry proxy made the routing decision.
func TestForward_PeerTrustedSessionsIgnoreReplicaServing(t *testing.T) {
	state := replicaServedState()
	p, dials, _ := replicaRouting(t, state)

	loopback := newTestSession(t)
	loopback.State().SetPeerTrust("10.0.0.7:9000")
	if err := p.OnHello(context.Background(), loopback, &chproto.ClientHello{Database: "rrdb"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnHello on a peer-trusted session: %v", err)
	}
	if got := loopback.State().Snapshot(); len(*dials) != 0 || got.IsForwarding || got.ReplicaServedDatabase != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v forwarding=%v mark=%q, want the peer-trusted hello untouched", *dials, got.IsForwarding, got.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}

	forwarded := newTestSession(t)
	forwarded.State().SetPeerTrustForwarded("10.0.0.7:9000", true)
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(forwarded, "USE rrdb")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OnQuery(USE rrdb) on a forwarded-from-peer session: %v", err)
	}
	if got := forwarded.State().Snapshot(); strings.Join(*dials, ",") != "owner.internal:9001" || got.ReplicaServedDatabase != "" {
		t.Fatalf("dials=%v mark=%q, want today's pivot to the owner and no mark", *dials, got.ReplicaServedDatabase)
	}
	forwarded.State().SetReplicaServedDatabase("rrdb")
	state.Set()
	if err := p.OnQuery(context.Background(), queryOn(forwarded, "SELECT 1")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a peer-trusted session is never refused by the replica rule: %v", err)
	}
}
```

```go
// TestBuildServer_ForwardTableStateFollowsStorageIntegrity is spec 2026-10-14
// §11 (Plan S3-C4 Task 43): forward.Plugin gets the host's table state, the
// one rewrite and sitablestate read, exactly when storage integrity is
// enabled, so a server without it routes as before replica reads.
func TestBuildServer_ForwardTableStateFollowsStorageIntegrity(t *testing.T) {
	forwardOf := func(t *testing.T, bs *builtServer) *forward.Plugin {
		t.Helper()
		for _, candidate := range requireExternalChain(t, bs).QueryPlugins {
			if typed, ok := candidate.(*forward.Plugin); ok {
				return typed
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("forward plugin missing from the query chain")
		return nil
	}

	plain, err := buildServer(Options{Config: minimalServerCfg(t), NetworkState: network.NewInMemoryNetworkState(), Rewriter: stubRewriterFactory{}}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build without SI: %v", err)
	}
	if fwd := forwardOf(t, plain); fwd.TableState != nil {
		t.Fatalf("forward.TableState = %v without storage integrity, want nil", fwd.TableState)
	}
	plain.teardown()

	cfg := minimalServerCfg(t)
	enabled := true
	cfg.StorageIntegrity.Enabled = &enabled
	state := sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary, sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__a__i3", ReplicaOf: 2})
	withSI, err := buildServer(Options{Config: cfg, NetworkState: network.NewInMemoryNetworkState(), Rewriter: siProbeStubRewriterFactory{}, StorageIntegrityTableState: state}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build with SI: %v", err)
	}
	defer withSI.teardown()
	if fwd := forwardOf(t, withSI); fwd.TableState != sitable.TableState(state) {
		t.Fatalf("forward.TableState = %v, want the injected table state", fwd.TableState)
	}
}
```

```go
// replicaServed reports whether the table state's current snapshot serves
// database from a member's copy on this host. It is false without a table
// state.
func (p *Plugin) replicaServed(database string) bool {
	if p.TableState == nil || database == "" {
		return false
	}
	return slices.Contains(sitable.ServedDatabases(p.TableState.Current()), database)
}

// replicaAware reports whether the replica rules apply to the session: a
// table state is wired and the session is not peer-trusted (a session
// forwarded from a peer was routed by its entry proxy).
func (p *Plugin) replicaAware(st *chsession.SessionState) bool {
	return p.TableState != nil && !st.PeerTrusted()
}

// refuseEndedReplicaServing refuses a statement on a session that OnHello or a
// USE kept on this host for a replica-served database, once the current
// snapshot no longer serves that database. 733 is retryable; reconnecting
// routes the client to the owner.
func (p *Plugin) refuseEndedReplicaServing(sess chsession.Session) error {
	if sess == nil {
		return nil
	}
	st := sess.State()
	if !p.replicaAware(st) {
		return nil
	}
	db := st.ReplicaServedDatabase
	if db == "" || p.replicaServed(db) {
		return nil
	}
	return &chproto.ClientError{
		Code:    chproto.CodeTableIsBeingRestarted,
		Message: fmt.Sprintf("storage_integrity: database %s is no longer served from a copy on this host; reconnect to reach its owner (retryable)", db),
	}
}
```

In `pkg/plugins/forward/forward.go` (`OnQuery`, `:199-246`), replace:

```go
// OnQuery intercepts standalone USE statements. When USE targets a logical
// database hosted on a different peer than the session's current RouteTarget,
// pivots the session via pivotToPeer. Anything other than a bare USE
// (USE … SETTINGS …, multi-statement, etc.) is a no-op — the rewriter's
// maybeUpdateLogicalDatabase callback handles complex forms.
func (p *Plugin) OnQuery(ctx context.Context, qctx *plugin.QueryContext) error {
	newDB, ok := matchUse(qctx.OriginalSQL)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	info, found := p.Databases.Get(newDB)
	if !found {
		return nil // let CH return the real "doesn't exist" error
	}

	sess := qctx.Session
	st := sess.State()

	if info.IndexerId == p.SelfIndexerID {
		// New database is local. If the session is currently forwarded
		// to a peer, we must rebind back to local CH — otherwise the
		// USE packet would be sent to the peer's CH which doesn't host
		// this database and will reject. If the session was never
		// forwarded, the local upstream is already correct.
		if !st.IsForwarding {
			return nil
		}
		return p.rebindToLocal(ctx, sess, newDB)
	}

	peerAddr, ok := p.Topology.ProxyByIndexerId(info.IndexerId)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer %d not found in topology", info.IndexerId)
	}
	newAddr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", peerAddr.Url, peerAddr.HousegatePort)

	if newAddr == st.GetRouteTarget() {
		return nil // already on the right peer — skip
	}

	return p.pivotToPeer(ctx, sess, &chproto.ClientHello{
		Name:            st.ClientHostname,
		Major:           st.ClientVersion.Major,
		Minor:           st.ClientVersion.Minor,
		ProtocolVersion: st.ClientRevision,
		Database:        newDB,
	}, info.IndexerId)
}
```

```go
// OnQuery intercepts standalone USE statements. When USE targets a logical
// database hosted on a different peer than the session's current RouteTarget,
// pivots the session via pivotToPeer. Anything other than a bare USE
// (USE … SETTINGS …, multi-statement, etc.) is a no-op — the rewriter's
// maybeUpdateLogicalDatabase callback handles complex forms. With a
// TableState, a USE of a replica-served database stays local and marks the
// session, and any other statement on a marked session whose database is no
// longer served is refused (spec 2026-10-14 §11).
func (p *Plugin) OnQuery(ctx context.Context, qctx *plugin.QueryContext) error {
	newDB, ok := matchUse(qctx.OriginalSQL)
	if !ok {
		return p.refuseEndedReplicaServing(qctx.Session)
	}
	info, found := p.Databases.Get(newDB)
	if !found {
		return nil // let CH return the real "doesn't exist" error
	}

	sess := qctx.Session
	st := sess.State()
	replicaAware := p.replicaAware(st)

	if info.IndexerId == p.SelfIndexerID {
		if replicaAware {
			st.SetReplicaServedDatabase("")
		}
		// New database is local. If the session is currently forwarded
		// to a peer, we must rebind back to local CH — otherwise the
		// USE packet would be sent to the peer's CH which doesn't host
		// this database and will reject. If the session was never
		// forwarded, the local upstream is already correct.
		if !st.IsForwarding {
			return nil
		}
		return p.rebindToLocal(ctx, sess, newDB)
	}

	if replicaAware && p.replicaServed(newDB) {
		// Spec 2026-10-14 §11: served from this host's member copy, so the
		// database is local for routing; a forwarded session returns home.
		if st.IsForwarding {
			if err := p.rebindToLocal(ctx, sess, newDB); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		st.SetReplicaServedDatabase(newDB)
		log.Infow("forward: kept a replica-served session local",
			"db", newDB, "owner", info.IndexerId)
		return nil
	}

	peerAddr, ok := p.Topology.ProxyByIndexerId(info.IndexerId)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer %d not found in topology", info.IndexerId)
	}
	newAddr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", peerAddr.Url, peerAddr.HousegatePort)

	// Already on the right peer: no pivot.
	if newAddr != st.GetRouteTarget() {
		if err := p.pivotToPeer(ctx, sess, &chproto.ClientHello{
			Name:            st.ClientHostname,
			Major:           st.ClientVersion.Major,
			Minor:           st.ClientVersion.Minor,
			ProtocolVersion: st.ClientRevision,
			Database:        newDB,
		}, info.IndexerId); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	// The session now reads a database hosted elsewhere, not a copy here.
	if replicaAware {
		st.SetReplicaServedDatabase("")
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
// replicaServingState is a host that governs db1.t (Active) and serves rrdb.a
// and rrdb.b, owned by indexer 2, from its member's copies (spec 2026-10-14
// §11).
func replicaServingState() *sitable.Fake {
	return sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary,
		sitable.Table{ID: "db1.t", Status: sitable.Active},
		sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__a__i3", ReplicaOf: 2},
		sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.b", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__b__i5", ReplicaOf: 2},
	)
}

// TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsMapsReplicaTablesToTheCopy: a Replica table is
// listed with SafeTable = UnsafeTable = hg_replica.<CopyTable> and no excluded
// parts in either read mode; Active tables keep their hg_safe / hg_unsafe
// entries.
func TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsMapsReplicaTablesToTheCopy(t *testing.T) {
	state := replicaServingState()
	rs := &fakeReadState{}
	parts := map[string][]string{"db1.t": {"all_1_1_0"}, "rrdb.a": {"all_2_2_0"}}
	for _, mode := range []ReadMode{ReadModeSafe, ReadModeUnsafeLatest} {
		t.Run(string(mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := buildStorageIntegrityArgs(StorageIntegrityOptions{Enabled: true, TableState: state, ReadState: rs}, state.Current(), mode, parts)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			tables := got.GetTables()
			if len(tables) != 3 {
				t.Fatalf("tables = %v, want db1.t, rrdb.a and rrdb.b", tables)
			}
			for id, copyTable := range map[string]string{"rrdb.a": "hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3", "rrdb.b": "hg_replica.rrdb__b__i5"} {
				tbl := tables[id]
				if tbl.GetSafeTable() != copyTable || tbl.GetUnsafeTable() != copyTable || len(tbl.GetExcludedUnsafeParts()) != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("%s = %v, want safe and unsafe %s and no excluded parts", id, tbl, copyTable)
				}
			}
			if tbl := tables["db1.t"]; tbl.GetSafeTable() != "hg_safe.db1__t" || tbl.GetUnsafeTable() != "hg_unsafe.db1__t" {
				t.Fatalf("db1.t = %v, want its hg_safe / hg_unsafe entry", tbl)
			}
		})
	}
	if len(rs.calls) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("building args must never call the port: %v", rs.calls)
	}
}

// TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsWithoutReplicaTablesIsUnchanged: with no
// Replica table the block is byte-identical to the one built before replica
// reads.
func TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsWithoutReplicaTablesIsUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	state := sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary,
		sitable.Table{ID: "db1.t", Status: sitable.Active},
		sitable.Table{ID: "db1.p", Status: sitable.Pending},
		sitable.Table{ID: "db1.g", Status: sitable.Gone},
	)
	parts := map[string][]string{"db1.t": {"all_1_1_0"}}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		mode ReadMode
		want *pb.StorageIntegrityArgs
	}{
		{ReadModeSafe, &pb.StorageIntegrityArgs{
			Tables:              map[string]*pb.StorageIntegrityArgs_Table{"db1.t": {SafeTable: "hg_safe.db1__t", UnsafeTable: "hg_unsafe.db1__t"}},
			ReadMode:            pb.StorageIntegrityArgs_READ_MODE_SAFE,
			ReservedRowIdColumn: DefaultReservedRowIDColumn,
			ContractVersion:     StorageIntegrityContractV2,
			ReservedDatabases:   sitable.ReservedDatabases(),
		}},
		{ReadModeUnsafeLatest, &pb.StorageIntegrityArgs{
			Tables:              map[string]*pb.StorageIntegrityArgs_Table{"db1.t": {SafeTable: "hg_safe.db1__t", UnsafeTable: "hg_unsafe.db1__t", ExcludedUnsafeParts: []string{"all_1_1_0"}}},
			ReadMode:            pb.StorageIntegrityArgs_READ_MODE_UNSAFE_LATEST,
			ReservedRowIdColumn: DefaultReservedRowIDColumn,
			ContractVersion:     StorageIntegrityContractV2,
			ReservedDatabases:   sitable.ReservedDatabases(),
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(string(tc.mode), func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := buildStorageIntegrityArgs(StorageIntegrityOptions{Enabled: true, TableState: state, ReadState: &fakeReadState{}}, state.Current(), tc.mode, parts)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			deterministic := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}
			gotBytes, err := deterministic.Marshal(got)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			wantBytes, err := deterministic.Marshal(tc.want)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(gotBytes, wantBytes) {
				t.Fatalf("args = %v, want %v", got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// servedSnapshot overrides a snapshot's Active and Served lists, so a test can
// build the inconsistent snapshots a host must never publish.
type servedSnapshot struct {
	sitable.Snapshot
	active, served []sitable.Table
}

func (s servedSnapshot) Active() []sitable.Table { return s.active }
func (s servedSnapshot) Served() []sitable.Table { return s.served }

// TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsRefusesATableBothActiveAndReplica: a table id
// listed both Active and Replica, or a Replica table without a copy table, is
// refused rather than mapped to either surface.
func TestBuildStorageIntegrityArgsRefusesATableBothActiveAndReplica(t *testing.T) {
	base := sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary).Current()
	for name, tc := range map[string]struct {
		snap sitable.Snapshot
		id   string
	}{
		"both Active and Replica": {servedSnapshot{Snapshot: base,
			active: []sitable.Table{{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Active}},
			served: []sitable.Table{{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: "rrdb__a__i3", ReplicaOf: 2}},
		}, "rrdb.a"},
		"Replica without a copy table": {servedSnapshot{Snapshot: base,
			served: []sitable.Table{{ID: "rrdb.b", Status: sitable.Replica, ReplicaOf: 2}},
		}, "rrdb.b"},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := buildStorageIntegrityArgs(StorageIntegrityOptions{Enabled: true}, tc.snap, ReadModeSafe, nil)
			want := "storage-integrity table " + tc.id + " is listed both Active and Replica, or Replica without a copy table"
			var rej *RejectedError
			if !errors.As(err, &rej) || rej.Code != pb.RewriteCode_RewriteError || rej.Message != want {
				t.Fatalf("err = %v, want RewriteError %q", err, want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestUnsafeLatestIsRefusedForReplicaTables is spec 2026-10-14 §11 Read modes:
// an unsafe_latest read of a Replica table is refused after the classification
// pass, naming safe mode and the owner, before the promotion port and before
// anything is returned for ClickHouse; the same read in safe mode passes, and
// unsafe_latest of an Active table still takes its two passes.
func TestUnsafeLatestIsRefusedForReplicaTables(t *testing.T) {
	const want = "storage_integrity read mode unsafe_latest is not available for rrdb.a: it is served read-only from a copy of indexer 2's published data; read it with SQL_x_read_mode='safe'"
	classified := func(sql string, ids ...string) *pb.RewriteSQLResponse {
		return acknowledgedSIResponse(&pb.RewriteSQLResponse{Code: pb.RewriteCode_Success, SqlAfterRewrite: sql, StatementType: pb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_SELECT, OriginalAccessedTables: siAccessed(ids...)})
	}
	for name, accessed := range map[string][]string{
		"the Replica table alone":    {"rrdb.a"},
		"with an Active table":       {"db1.t", "rrdb.a"},
		"with another Replica table": {"rrdb.a", "rrdb.b"},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			rs := &fakeReadState{parts: map[string][]string{"db1.t": {"all_1_1_0"}}}
			be := &sequenceBackend{script: []*pb.RewriteSQLResponse{classified("pass1", accessed...), classified("pass2", accessed...)}}
			res, err := dynamicSIFactory(be, replicaServingState(), rs).NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(WithReadMode(context.Background(), ReadModeUnsafeLatest), "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a", "")
			var rej *RejectedError
			if !errors.As(err, &rej) || rej.Code != pb.RewriteCode_RewriteError || rej.Message != want {
				t.Fatalf("err = %v, want RewriteError %q", err, want)
			}
			if res.SQL != "" || len(be.requests) != 1 || len(rs.calls) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("SQL=%q passes=%d port calls=%v, want nothing returned, one pass and no port call", res.SQL, len(be.requests), rs.calls)
			}
		})
	}

	safe := &sequenceBackend{script: []*pb.RewriteSQLResponse{classified("safe pass", "rrdb.a")}}
	if res, err := dynamicSIFactory(safe, replicaServingState(), &fakeReadState{}).NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(WithReadMode(context.Background(), ReadModeSafe), "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a", ""); err != nil || res.SQL != "safe pass" {
		t.Fatalf("safe read of a Replica table = %q, %v; want it rewritten", res.SQL, err)
	}

	active := &sequenceBackend{script: []*pb.RewriteSQLResponse{classified("pass1", "db1.t"), classified("pass2", "db1.t")}}
	rs := &fakeReadState{parts: map[string][]string{"db1.t": {"all_1_1_0"}}}
	if res, err := dynamicSIFactory(active, replicaServingState(), rs).NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(WithReadMode(context.Background(), ReadModeUnsafeLatest), "SELECT count() FROM db1.t", ""); err != nil || res.SQL != "pass2" {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe_latest of an Active table = %q, %v; want the second pass", res.SQL, err)
	}
}

// TestUnsafeLatestNeverSendsTheCopyTwice: SafeTable = UnsafeTable = the copy,
// so an engine's unsafe_latest rendering reads the copy twice (hg_safe UNION
// ALL hg_unsafe). That classification pass is never returned for ClickHouse:
// the Rewrite result is empty, no second pass runs, and the copy entry the
// engine saw carries no excluded parts.
func TestUnsafeLatestNeverSendsTheCopyTwice(t *testing.T) {
	const doubled = "SELECT count() FROM (SELECT * FROM hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3 WHERE _part NOT IN ())"
	be := &sequenceBackend{script: []*pb.RewriteSQLResponse{
		acknowledgedSIResponse(&pb.RewriteSQLResponse{Code: pb.RewriteCode_Success, SqlAfterRewrite: doubled, StatementType: pb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_SELECT, OriginalAccessedTables: siAccessed("rrdb.a")}),
		acknowledgedSIResponse(&pb.RewriteSQLResponse{Code: pb.RewriteCode_Success, SqlAfterRewrite: doubled, StatementType: pb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_SELECT, OriginalAccessedTables: siAccessed("rrdb.a")}),
	}}
	rs := &fakeReadState{parts: map[string][]string{"rrdb.a": {"all_9_9_0"}}}
	res, err := dynamicSIFactory(be, replicaServingState(), rs).NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(WithReadMode(context.Background(), ReadModeUnsafeLatest), "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a", "")
	if err == nil || res.SQL != "" || strings.Contains(res.SQL, "hg_replica") {
		t.Fatalf("Rewrite = %q, %v; want a refusal and no statement for ClickHouse", res.SQL, err)
	}
	if len(be.requests) != 1 || len(rs.calls) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("passes=%d port calls=%v, want the classification pass only", len(be.requests), rs.calls)
	}
	entry := siArgsOf(be.requests[0]).GetTables()["rrdb.a"]
	if entry.GetSafeTable() != "hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3" || entry.GetUnsafeTable() != "hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3" || len(entry.GetExcludedUnsafeParts()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("classification entry = %v, want the copy on both surfaces and no excluded parts", entry)
	}
}

// TestScrubberMapsTheCopyBackToItsLogicalTable: an upstream message naming a
// served copy maps back to the logical table; any other hg_replica name stays
// redacted.
func TestScrubberMapsTheCopyBackToItsLogicalTable(t *testing.T) {
	s := NewStorageIntegrityScrubber(replicaServingState().Current())
	for _, tc := range []struct{ in, want string }{
		{"Table hg_replica.rrdb__a__i3 does not exist", "Table rrdb.a does not exist"},
		{"Missing columns: 'x' while processing hg_replica.rrdb__b__i5", "Missing columns: 'x' while processing rrdb.b"},
		{"Table hg_replica.rrdb__a__i2 does not exist", "Table <storage-integrity>.rrdb__a__i2 does not exist"},
		{"Database hg_replica does not exist", "Database <storage-integrity> does not exist"},
		{"Table hg_safe.db1__t does not exist", "Table db1.t does not exist"},
	} {
		if got := s.Scrub(tc.in); got != tc.want {
			t.Errorf("Scrub(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.in, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package rewriter

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/housegate/rewriter-proto/gen/pb"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/network"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/sitable"
)

// The replica parity tests pin spec 2026-10-14 §11's routing claim for both
// rewrite engines: a table the host serves from its member's copy resolves to
// hg_replica.<copy> before the remote mapping of its database, which keeps
// sending the database's ordinary tables to the owner. The host is indexer 1;
// rrdb is owned by indexer 2 and its tables a and b are Replica.

const (
	replicaParityCopyA = "rrdb__a__i3"
	replicaParityCopyB = "rrdb__b__i5"
)

// replicaParityState serves rrdb.a and rrdb.b from the member's copies.
func replicaParityState() *sitable.Fake {
	return sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary,
		sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.a", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: replicaParityCopyA, ReplicaOf: 2},
		sitable.Table{ID: "rrdb.b", Status: sitable.Replica, CopyTable: replicaParityCopyB, ReplicaOf: 2},
	)
}

// replicaParityNetwork registers rrdb on indexer 2 and both indexers' proxies,
// so buildRemoteUpstreams maps rrdb to the owner.
func replicaParityNetwork() *network.InMemoryNetworkState {
	st := network.NewInMemoryNetworkState()
	st.DatabaseInfos["rrdb"] = network.DatabaseInfo{DatabaseId: "rrdb", IndexerId: 2}
	st.IndexerInfos[1] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 1, IndexerUrl: "self.internal", ClickhouseProxyPort: 9000}
	st.IndexerInfos[2] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 2, IndexerUrl: "owner.internal", ClickhouseProxyPort: 9001}
	return st
}

// replicaParityOptions is the SI read surface of a member host: safe reads by
// default, the promotion port wired (as on an SI host with its SNode), the
// signed lane on.
func replicaParityOptions() StorageIntegrityOptions {
	return StorageIntegrityOptions{
		Enabled:           true,
		TableState:        replicaParityState(),
		DefaultReadMode:   ReadModeSafe,
		ReadState:         &fakeReadState{},
		InsertLaneEnabled: true,
	}
}

// TestReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping: the request names the copy for
// the Replica tables while rrdb keeps its remote upstream, so only the
// engine's lookup order decides; the engine-gated tests below pin that order.
func TestReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping(t *testing.T) {
	be := &fakeBackend{resp: acknowledgedSIResponse(&pb.RewriteSQLResponse{Code: pb.RewriteCode_Success, SqlAfterRewrite: "x", StatementType: pb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_SELECT})}
	f := &SentioNetworkFactory{
		options:  Options{PhysicalDatabase: "phys", StorageIntegrity: replicaParityOptions()},
		registry: replicaParityNetwork(),
		backend:  be,
	}
	f.SetGetIndexerId(func() uint64 { return 1 })
	if _, err := f.NewRewriter(&fakeSession{logical: "rrdb", physical: "phys"}).Rewrite(context.Background(), "SELECT count() FROM a", ""); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dyn := be.lastReq.GetOptions()[0].GetTableNameArgs().GetDynamicArgs()
	for id, copyTable := range map[string]string{"rrdb.a": sitable.ReplicaDatabase + "." + replicaParityCopyA, "rrdb.b": sitable.ReplicaDatabase + "." + replicaParityCopyB} {
		tbl := dyn.GetStorageIntegrity().GetTables()[id]
		if tbl.GetSafeTable() != copyTable || tbl.GetUnsafeTable() != copyTable {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %v, want %s on both surfaces", id, tbl, copyTable)
		}
	}
	key := dyn.GetLogicalDatabaseToRemoteUpstreamIndex()["rrdb"]
	up := dyn.GetRemoteUpstreams()[key]
	if key != "2" || up == nil || !strings.Contains(up.GetUser(), "owner.internal:9001") {
		t.Fatalf("rrdb remote mapping = %q -> %v, want the owner's upstream kept", key, up)
	}
	if dyn.GetUpstreamLogicalDatabaseInContext() != "rrdb" {
		t.Fatalf("logical context = %q, want rrdb", dyn.GetUpstreamLogicalDatabaseInContext())
	}
}

// TestUseOfAReplicaServedDatabaseIsRewrittenLocally: forward.Plugin keeps a
// USE of a served database on this host, so the rewrite of that USE drops the
// database's remote mapping (both engines refuse a USE of a remote-mapped
// database); every other statement, and a USE of a database that is not
// served, keeps the mapping.
func TestUseOfAReplicaServedDatabaseIsRewrittenLocally(t *testing.T) {
	be := &fakeBackend{resp: acknowledgedSIResponse(&pb.RewriteSQLResponse{Code: pb.RewriteCode_Success, SqlAfterRewrite: "x", StatementType: pb.StatementType_STATEMENT_TYPE_SELECT})}
	reg := replicaParityNetwork()
	reg.DatabaseInfos["other"] = network.DatabaseInfo{DatabaseId: "other", IndexerId: 2}
	f := &SentioNetworkFactory{
		options:  Options{PhysicalDatabase: "phys", StorageIntegrity: replicaParityOptions()},
		registry: reg,
		backend:  be,
	}
	f.SetGetIndexerId(func() uint64 { return 1 })
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		sql         string
		rrdb, other bool
	}{
		{sql: "USE rrdb", rrdb: false, other: true},
		{sql: "use `rrdb`;", rrdb: false, other: true},
		{sql: "USE other", rrdb: true, other: true},
		{sql: "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.o", rrdb: true, other: true},
		{sql: "USE rrdb SETTINGS max_threads = 1", rrdb: true, other: true},
	} {
		if _, err := f.NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(context.Background(), tc.sql, ""); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Rewrite(%q): %v", tc.sql, err)
		}
		remote := be.lastReq.GetOptions()[0].GetTableNameArgs().GetDynamicArgs().GetLogicalDatabaseToRemoteUpstreamIndex()
		_, rrdb := remote["rrdb"]
		_, other := remote["other"]
		if rrdb != tc.rrdb || other != tc.other {
			t.Fatalf("%q: remote mapping = %v, want rrdb mapped %v and other mapped %v", tc.sql, remote, tc.rrdb, tc.other)
		}
	}
}

// requireReplicaParity drives one real engine through the member-host cases.
func requireReplicaParity(t *testing.T, f *SentioNetworkFactory) {
	t.Helper()
	f.SetGetIndexerId(func() uint64 { return 1 })
	ctx := context.Background()
	rewrite := func(t *testing.T, sess *fakeSession, ctx context.Context, sql string) RewriteResult {
		t.Helper()
		res, err := f.NewRewriter(sess).Rewrite(ctx, sql, "")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Rewrite(%q): %v", sql, err)
		}
		t.Logf("%s -> %s", sql, res.SQL)
		return res
	}
	copyA := sitable.ReplicaDatabase + "." + replicaParityCopyA
	copyB := sitable.ReplicaDatabase + "." + replicaParityCopyB
	reads := func(sql string, copies ...string) {
		t.Helper()
		for _, sess := range []*fakeSession{{}, {logical: "rrdb", physical: "phys"}} {
			stmt := sql
			if sess.logical != "" {
				stmt = strings.ReplaceAll(sql, "rrdb.", "")
			}
			res := rewrite(t, sess, ctx, stmt)
			for _, c := range copies {
				if !strings.Contains(res.SQL, c) {
					t.Fatalf("%q (logical %q) -> %q, want it to read %s", stmt, sess.logical, res.SQL, c)
				}
			}
			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(res.SQL), "remote(") {
				t.Fatalf("%q (logical %q) -> %q, want no remote() leg for a Replica table", stmt, sess.logical, res.SQL)
			}
		}
	}
	reads("SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a", copyA)
	reads("SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a AS x JOIN rrdb.b AS y ON x.id = y.id", copyA, copyB)

	// A USE of the served database, kept local by forward.Plugin, is a local
	// USE: it moves the session to the physical database and records rrdb.
	useSess := &fakeSession{}
	if res := rewrite(t, useSess, ctx, "USE rrdb"); !strings.Contains(res.SQL, "phys") || strings.Join(useSess.setLogical, ",") != "rrdb" {
		t.Fatalf("USE rrdb -> %q, logical %v; want a local USE of the physical database recording rrdb", res.SQL, useSess.setLogical)
	}

	// An ordinary table of the same database still goes to its owner.
	if res := rewrite(t, &fakeSession{}, ctx, "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.o"); !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(res.SQL), "remote(") || strings.Contains(res.SQL, sitable.ReplicaDatabase) {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary rrdb.o -> %q, want a remote() leg to the owner", res.SQL)
	}

	// A computed reserved name on an ordinary session is refused (K48).
	if _, err := f.NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(ctx, "SELECT * FROM merge(concat('hg_', 'replica'), '.*')", ""); !errors.As(err, new(*RejectedError)) {
		t.Fatalf("merge(concat('hg_', 'replica'), '.*') = %v, want a RejectedError", err)
	}

	// unsafe_latest of a Replica table is refused with the safe-mode text.
	const want = "storage_integrity read mode unsafe_latest is not available for rrdb.a: it is served read-only from a copy of indexer 2's published data; read it with SQL_x_read_mode='safe'"
	_, err := f.NewRewriter(&fakeSession{}).Rewrite(WithReadMode(ctx, ReadModeUnsafeLatest), "SELECT count() FROM rrdb.a", "")
	var rej *RejectedError
	if !errors.As(err, &rej) || rej.Message != want {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe_latest read of rrdb.a = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
}

// TestNativeEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping runs the parity
// cases on the in-process rewriter-go engine. Skips without the FFI library;
// run locally with:
//
//	bazel test //pkg/rewriter:rewriter_test \
//	  --test_filter=TestNativeEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping \
//	  --test_env=POLYGLOT_SQL_FFI_PATH=<libpolyglot_sql_ffi path>
func TestNativeEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("POLYGLOT_SQL_FFI_PATH") == "" {
		t.Skip("POLYGLOT_SQL_FFI_PATH not set; native engine FFI lib unavailable")
	}
	f, err := NewSentioNetworkFactory(Options{
		Engine:           EngineNative,
		PhysicalDatabase: "phys",
		Listen:           ":9000",
		StorageIntegrity: replicaParityOptions(),
	}, replicaParityNetwork())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewSentioNetworkFactory(native): %v", err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	requireReplicaParity(t, f)
}

// TestGRPCEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping runs the parity cases
// on a rewriter-grpc service, the devnet2 housegate-rewriter image. Skips
// without its address; run locally against a container of the pinned image
// with:
//
//	bazel test //pkg/rewriter:rewriter_test \
//	  --test_filter=TestGRPCEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping \
//	  --test_env=HOUSEGATE_TEST_REWRITER_GRPC_ADDR=127.0.0.1:50551
func TestGRPCEngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping(t *testing.T) {
	addr := os.Getenv("HOUSEGATE_TEST_REWRITER_GRPC_ADDR")
	if addr == "" {
		t.Skip("HOUSEGATE_TEST_REWRITER_GRPC_ADDR not set; rewriter-grpc service unavailable")
	}
	f, err := NewSentioNetworkFactory(Options{
		Engine:           EngineGRPC,
		ServiceAddr:      addr,
		Timeout:          10 * time.Second,
		PhysicalDatabase: "phys",
		Listen:           ":9000",
		StorageIntegrity: replicaParityOptions(),
	}, replicaParityNetwork())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewSentioNetworkFactory(grpc): %v", err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	requireReplicaParity(t, f)
}
```
