- [ ] **Step 12: Write the failing relay tests**

The tests run the relay between a scripted client on a `net.Pipe` and fake upstreams on loopback ports (an owner and replica hosts at revision 54453, below the addendum, timezone UTC), with a fake `UpstreamFailover` that classifies failures exactly as `agent.ReplicaFailover` will.

Create `pkg/proxy/relay_replica_failover_test.go`:

```go
package proxy

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go/proto"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/testutil"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chsession"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/plugin"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/plugins/sistatement"
)

// The replica-failover tests (spec 2026-10-14 §11, Plan S3-C4 K46) run the
// agent's relay between a scripted client (net.Pipe) and fake upstreams on
// loopback ports: an owner and replica hosts speaking revision 54453, below
// the addendum, in timezone UTC.

const failoverDB = "db2"

// quarantinedRead is the refusal a quarantined owner's host answers for a
// read of its table.
var quarantinedRead = chproto.TableRefusedMessage(failoverDB+".t", "indexer_quarantined", "storage-integrity indexer 2 is quarantined")

// fakeUpstream is a ClickHouse-like server on a loopback port; serve runs
// once per accepted connection.
type fakeUpstream struct {
	t    *testing.T
	ln   net.Listener
	addr string

	mu      sync.Mutex
	hellos  []chproto.ClientHello
	queries []chproto.Query
}

func startFakeUpstream(t *testing.T, serve func(*fakeConn)) *fakeUpstream {
	t.Helper()
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f := &fakeUpstream{t: t, ln: ln, addr: ln.Addr().String()}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = ln.Close() })
	go func() {
		for {
			conn, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			go func() {
				defer conn.Close()
				_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
				serve(&fakeConn{up: f, conn: conn, codec: chproto.NewCodec(conn, chproto.DirFromClient)})
			}()
		}
	}()
	return f
}

func (f *fakeUpstream) seen() ([]chproto.ClientHello, []chproto.Query) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]chproto.ClientHello(nil), f.hellos...), append([]chproto.Query(nil), f.queries...)
}

// closedAddr is a loopback address nothing listens on.
func closedAddr(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	addr := ln.Addr().String()
	_ = ln.Close()
	return addr
}

type fakeConn struct {
	up    *fakeUpstream
	conn  net.Conn
	codec *chproto.Codec
}

// hello reads the ClientHello and answers a ServerHello named name.
func (c *fakeConn) hello(name string) bool {
	pkt, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientHelloCode))
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	h, ok := pkt.Decoded.(*chproto.ClientHello)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	c.up.mu.Lock()
	c.up.hellos = append(c.up.hellos, *h)
	c.up.mu.Unlock()
	var b proto.Buffer
	(&proto.ServerHello{Name: name, Major: 24, Minor: 1, Revision: deferredTestRev, Timezone: "UTC", DisplayName: name}).EncodeAware(&b, deferredTestRev)
	if _, err := c.conn.Write(b.Buf); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	c.codec.SetRevision(deferredTestRev)
	c.codec.SetCompression(proto.CompressionDisabled)
	return true
}

// query reads the next Query packet and records it.
func (c *fakeConn) query() (*chproto.Query, bool) {
	pkt, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientQueryCode))
	if err != nil || pkt.Type != uint64(chproto.ClientQueryCode) {
		return nil, false
	}
	q := pkt.Decoded.(*chproto.Query)
	c.up.mu.Lock()
	c.up.queries = append(c.up.queries, *q)
	c.up.mu.Unlock()
	return q, true
}

// data reads one client Data packet.
func (c *fakeConn) data() bool {
	pkt, err := c.codec.ReadPacket()
	return err == nil && pkt.Type == uint64(chproto.ClientDataCode)
}

func (c *fakeConn) exception(code int32, message string) {
	_ = c.codec.WriteException(&chproto.Exception{Code: proto.Error(code), Name: "DB::Exception", Message: message})
}

func (c *fakeConn) progress() {
	var b proto.Buffer
	b.PutUVarInt(uint64(proto.ServerCodeProgress))
	proto.Progress{Rows: 1, Bytes: 8, TotalRows: 1}.EncodeAware(&b, deferredTestRev)
	_, _ = c.conn.Write(b.Buf)
}

func (c *fakeConn) endOfStream() {
	_, _ = c.conn.Write([]byte{byte(chproto.ServerEndOfStreamCode)})
}

// drain reads until the peer closes the connection.
func (c *fakeConn) drain() { _, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, c.conn) }

// replicaServes answers every query with a Progress packet and EndOfStream.
func replicaServes(c *fakeConn) {
	if !c.hello("replica") {
		return
	}
	for {
		if _, ok := c.query(); !ok || !c.data() {
			return
		}
		c.progress()
		c.endOfStream()
	}
}

// ownerQuarantined answers every read with the quarantine refusal after its
// terminator and every other query with EndOfStream.
func ownerQuarantined(c *fakeConn) {
	if !c.hello("owner") {
		return
	}
	for {
		q, ok := c.query()
		if !ok || !c.data() {
			return
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(q.Body, "SELECT") {
			c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, quarantinedRead)
			continue
		}
		c.endOfStream()
	}
}

// fakeFailover classifies failures exactly as agent.ReplicaFailover does.
type fakeFailover struct {
	candidates []string

	mu      sync.Mutex
	asked   []string
	reports []string
}

func (f *fakeFailover) Candidates(_ context.Context, database string) ([]string, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.asked = append(f.asked, database)
	return f.candidates, nil
}

func (f *fakeFailover) Reason(phase FailoverPhase, cause error, exc *chproto.Exception) (string, bool) {
	switch {
	case exc == nil && cause != nil, exc != nil && phase == FailoverAtHello:
		return "owner_unreachable", true
	case exc != nil && phase == FailoverAtRead && chproto.IsIndexerQuarantinedReadMessage(exc.Message):
		return "owner_quarantined", true
	}
	return "", false
}

func (f *fakeFailover) FailedOver(_ context.Context, database, reason, _, to string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.reports = append(f.reports, database+" "+reason+" "+to)
}

func (f *fakeFailover) state() (asked, reports []string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string(nil), f.asked...), append([]string(nil), f.reports...)
}

// failoverClient is the client end of a relay under test.
type failoverClient struct {
	t     *testing.T
	conn  net.Conn
	codec *chproto.Codec
	relay *Relay
	done  chan error
}

// startFailoverRelay runs a relay whose dialer reaches owner and whose
// failover is f (nil: none), and returns its client end before the hello.
func startFailoverRelay(t *testing.T, owner string, f UpstreamFailover, hooks plugin.Hooks, obs PacketObserver) *failoverClient {
	t.Helper()
	clientEnd, relayEnd := net.Pipe()
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = clientEnd.Close() })
	if hooks == nil {
		hooks = plugin.NoopHooks{}
	}
	dial := func(ctx context.Context, _ chsession.Session) (*chproto.Codec, error) {
		conn, err := (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, "tcp", owner)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return chproto.NewCodec(conn, chproto.DirToUpstream), nil
	}
	r := NewRelay(chsession.New(1, relayEnd), hooks, obs, dial)
	r.failover = f
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	c := &failoverClient{t: t, conn: clientEnd, codec: chproto.NewCodec(clientEnd, chproto.DirToUpstream), relay: r, done: make(chan error, 1)}
	go func() { c.done <- r.Run(ctx) }()
	return c
}

// hello sends the ClientHello for database and returns the ServerHello's
// display name, or the error that ended the session.
func (c *failoverClient) hello(database string) (string, error) {
	c.t.Helper()
	_ = c.conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
	if err := c.codec.WriteClientHello(&chproto.ClientHello{Name: "client", Major: 24, Minor: 1, ProtocolVersion: deferredTestRev, Database: database, User: "default"}); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	c.codec.SetServerHelloRevisionHint(deferredTestRev)
	pkt, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ServerHelloCode), uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	srv, ok := pkt.Decoded.(*chproto.ServerHello)
	if !ok {
		c.t.Fatalf("hello answered %T, want a ServerHello", pkt.Decoded)
	}
	c.codec.SetRevision(deferredTestRev)
	c.codec.SetCompression(proto.CompressionDisabled)
	return srv.DisplayName, nil
}

func (c *failoverClient) mustHello(want string) {
	c.t.Helper()
	got, err := c.hello(failoverDB)
	if err != nil || got != want {
		c.t.Fatalf("hello = %q, %v; want the ServerHello of %q", got, err, want)
	}
}

func (c *failoverClient) sendQuery(id, sql string, settings ...chproto.Setting) {
	c.t.Helper()
	q := &chproto.Query{
		ID:       id,
		Body:     sql,
		Settings: settings,
		Info: proto.ClientInfo{
			ProtocolVersion: deferredTestRev, Major: 24, Minor: 1,
			Interface: proto.InterfaceTCP, Query: proto.ClientQueryInitial,
		},
		Stage:       proto.StageComplete,
		Compression: proto.CompressionDisabled,
	}
	if err := c.codec.WriteQuery(q); err != nil {
		c.t.Fatalf("write query %s: %v", id, err)
	}
}

func (c *failoverClient) sendEmptyData() {
	c.t.Helper()
	if err := c.codec.WriteEmptyDataBlock(); err != nil {
		c.t.Fatalf("write the empty Data block: %v", err)
	}
}

// run sends a query and its terminator and returns the packet types of its
// answer up to the terminal packet, with the Exception if it ended with one.
func (c *failoverClient) run(id, sql string, settings ...chproto.Setting) ([]uint64, *chproto.Exception, error) {
	c.t.Helper()
	c.sendQuery(id, sql, settings...)
	c.sendEmptyData()
	return c.answer()
}

func (c *failoverClient) answer() ([]uint64, *chproto.Exception, error) {
	c.t.Helper()
	var types []uint64
	for {
		_ = c.conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second))
		pkt, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode))
		if err != nil {
			return types, nil, err
		}
		types = append(types, pkt.Type)
		switch pkt.Type {
		case uint64(chproto.ServerEndOfStreamCode):
			return types, nil, nil
		case uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode):
			return types, pkt.Decoded.(*chproto.Exception), nil
		}
	}
}

// mustServe runs sql and requires the replica's Progress and EndOfStream.
func (c *failoverClient) mustServe(id, sql string) {
	c.t.Helper()
	types, exc, err := c.run(id, sql)
	if err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 2 || types[0] != uint64(chproto.ServerProgressCode) {
		c.t.Fatalf("%s: answer %v, exception %v, err %v; want the replica's Progress and EndOfStream", id, types, exc, err)
	}
}

// mustRefuse runs sql and requires exactly the Exception message want.
func (c *failoverClient) mustRefuse(id, sql, want string) {
	c.t.Helper()
	types, exc, err := c.run(id, sql)
	if err != nil || exc == nil || exc.Message != want || len(types) != 1 {
		c.t.Fatalf("%s: answer %v, exception %v, err %v; want only the Exception %q", id, types, exc, err, want)
	}
}

func (c *failoverClient) upstreamAddress() string {
	if named, ok := c.relay.sess.Upstream().Conn().(interface{ UpstreamAddress() string }); ok {
		return named.UpstreamAddress()
	}
	return ""
}

func requireNoFailover(t *testing.T, f *fakeFailover) {
	t.Helper()
	if asked, reports := f.state(); len(asked) != 0 || len(reports) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("candidates were asked for %v and reports %v; this failure must never fail over", asked, reports)
	}
}

// TestAgentFailsOverAReadWhenTheOwnerIsQuarantined: an eligible read that
// the owner refuses as quarantined is replayed on the first replica host
// that takes it, whether the owner refused before or after the client's
// terminator: the client sees only the replica's answer and the session stays
// on the replica.
func TestAgentFailsOverAReadWhenTheOwnerIsQuarantined(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("after the terminator", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{closedAddr(t), replica.addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
		c.mustHello("owner")
		c.mustServe("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
		hellos, queries := replica.seen()
		if len(hellos) != 1 || hellos[0].Database != failoverDB || hellos[0].ProtocolVersion != deferredTestRev {
			t.Fatalf("replica hellos = %+v, want one for %s at the client's revision", hellos, failoverDB)
		}
		if len(queries) != 1 || queries[0].ID != "q1" || queries[0].Body != "SELECT count() FROM t" {
			t.Fatalf("replica queries = %+v, want the replayed q1", queries)
		}
		if asked, reports := f.state(); len(asked) != 1 || asked[0] != failoverDB || len(reports) != 1 || reports[0] != failoverDB+" owner_quarantined "+replica.addr {
			t.Fatalf("asked %v, reports %v", asked, reports)
		}
		if got := c.upstreamAddress(); got != replica.addr {
			t.Fatalf("session upstream = %q, want the replica %q", got, replica.addr)
		}
		c.mustServe("q2", "SELECT 1")
		if _, queries := replica.seen(); len(queries) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("replica queries = %d, want the next query on the replica too", len(queries))
		}
	})

	t.Run("before the terminator", func(t *testing.T) {
		gotQuery := make(chan struct{}, 1)
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
			if !c.hello("owner") {
				return
			}
			if _, ok := c.query(); !ok {
				return
			}
			c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, quarantinedRead)
			c.drain()
		})
		replica := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
			if !c.hello("replica") {
				return
			}
			if _, ok := c.query(); !ok {
				return
			}
			gotQuery <- struct{}{}
			if !c.data() {
				return
			}
			c.progress()
			c.endOfStream()
		})
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
		c.mustHello("owner")
		c.sendQuery("q1", "WITH 1 AS x SELECT x")
		select {
		case <-gotQuery:
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("the read never reached the replica")
		}
		c.sendEmptyData()
		types, exc, err := c.answer()
		if err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("answer %v, exception %v, err %v; want the replica's answer with the terminator sent after the failover", types, exc, err)
		}
	})
}

// TestAgentFailsOverAtHelloWhenTheOwnerIsUnreachable: when the dial to the
// owner fails, or its host answers the hello with an Exception or closes the
// connection, the hello goes to the first candidate that completes it and the
// client's session runs there.
func TestAgentFailsOverAtHelloWhenTheOwnerIsUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
	for name, owner := range map[string]func(t *testing.T) string{
		"dial refused": closedAddr,
		"exception at hello": func(t *testing.T) string {
			return startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
				if _, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientHelloCode)); err == nil {
					c.codec.SetRevision(deferredTestRev)
					c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, "forward: dial peer for db2: connection refused")
				}
			}).addr
		},
		"closed at hello": func(t *testing.T) string {
			return startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
				_, _ = c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientHelloCode))
			}).addr
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
			f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{closedAddr(t), replica.addr}}
			c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner(t), f, nil, nil)
			c.mustHello("replica")
			c.mustServe("q1", "SELECT 1")
			hellos, _ := replica.seen()
			if len(hellos) != 1 || hellos[0].Database != failoverDB {
				t.Fatalf("replica hellos = %+v, want one for %s", hellos, failoverDB)
			}
			if _, reports := f.state(); len(reports) != 1 || reports[0] != failoverDB+" owner_unreachable "+replica.addr {
				t.Fatalf("reports = %v", reports)
			}
			if !c.relay.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible {
				t.Fatal("a session failed over at hello must stay eligible for reads")
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestAgentNeverFailsOverAWrite: an INSERT is never failed over, whatever its
// owner answers, and it ends the session's eligibility, so a later read is
// not failed over either.
func TestAgentNeverFailsOverAWrite(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
		if !c.hello("owner") {
			return
		}
		for {
			if _, ok := c.query(); !ok || !c.data() {
				return
			}
			c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, quarantinedRead)
		}
	})
	replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
	f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	c.mustRefuse("w1", "INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)", quarantinedRead)
	if c.relay.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible {
		t.Fatal("an INSERT must end the session's failover eligibility")
	}
	c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
	requireNoFailover(t, f)
}

// TestAgentNeverFailsOverInsertSelect: INSERT ... SELECT is a write.
func TestAgentNeverFailsOverInsertSelect(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
		if !c.hello("owner") {
			return
		}
		if _, ok := c.query(); ok && c.data() {
			c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, quarantinedRead)
		}
		c.drain()
	})
	replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
	f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	c.mustRefuse("w1", "INSERT INTO t SELECT * FROM s", quarantinedRead)
	requireNoFailover(t, f)
}

// TestAgentNeverFailsOverAfterData: once a packet of a read's answer reached
// the client, neither a later Exception nor a broken connection fails over.
func TestAgentNeverFailsOverAfterData(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("then the quarantine refusal", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
			if !c.hello("owner") {
				return
			}
			if _, ok := c.query(); ok && c.data() {
				c.progress()
				c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, quarantinedRead)
			}
			c.drain()
		})
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes).addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
		c.mustHello("owner")
		types, exc, err := c.run("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
		if err != nil || exc == nil || exc.Message != quarantinedRead || len(types) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("answer %v, exception %v, err %v; want the owner's Progress and its refusal", types, exc, err)
		}
		requireNoFailover(t, f)
	})

	t.Run("then the connection breaks", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
			if !c.hello("owner") {
				return
			}
			if _, ok := c.query(); ok && c.data() {
				c.progress()
			}
		})
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes).addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
		c.mustHello("owner")
		types, _, err := c.run("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
		if err == nil || len(types) != 1 || types[0] != uint64(chproto.ServerProgressCode) {
			t.Fatalf("answer %v, err %v; want the owner's Progress and then the session closed", types, err)
		}
		requireNoFailover(t, f)
	})
}

// TestAgentNeverFailsOverASessionAfterSet: a SET holds server-side state a
// replay cannot reproduce, so the session's reads no longer fail over.
func TestAgentNeverFailsOverASessionAfterSet(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
	replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
	f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	if types, exc, err := c.run("s1", "SET max_threads = 1"); err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("SET: answer %v, exception %v, err %v", types, exc, err)
	}
	c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
	requireNoFailover(t, f)
}

// TestAgentKeepsTheInjectedReadModeOnFailover: the replayed Query is the one
// the agent's plugins built, so the injected SQL_x_read_mode reaches the
// replica unchanged and never switches silently to safe.
func TestAgentKeepsTheInjectedReadModeOnFailover(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
	replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
	f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}
	hooks := &plugin.PluginChain{QueryPlugins: []plugin.QueryPlugin{&sistatement.ReadModeInjector{Mode: "unsafe_latest"}}}
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, hooks, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	c.mustServe("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
	_, ownerQueries := owner.seen()
	_, replicaQueries := replica.seen()
	if len(ownerQueries) != 1 || len(replicaQueries) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("owner queries %d, replica queries %d; want one each", len(ownerQueries), len(replicaQueries))
	}
	mode := func(q chproto.Query) string {
		for _, s := range q.Settings {
			if s.Key == "SQL_x_read_mode" {
				return s.Value
			}
		}
		return ""
	}
	if got, want := mode(replicaQueries[0]), mode(ownerQueries[0]); want != "'unsafe_latest'" || got != want {
		t.Fatalf("replica read mode %q, owner read mode %q; want the injected 'unsafe_latest' on both", got, want)
	}
}

// TestAgentSurfacesTheOriginalErrorWhenEveryCandidateFails: when no candidate
// serves, a read gets the owner's own refusal and keeps the owner, and a
// hello ends with the original dial error.
func TestAgentSurfacesTheOriginalErrorWhenEveryCandidateFails(t *testing.T) {
	refusesHello := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
		if _, err := c.codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientHelloCode)); err == nil {
			c.codec.SetRevision(deferredTestRev)
			c.exception(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited, "forward: dial peer for db2: connection refused")
		}
	})

	t.Run("read", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{closedAddr(t), refusesHello.addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
		c.mustHello("owner")
		c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
		if types, exc, err := c.run("u1", "USE other"); err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("the session must keep the owner after the failover found no replica: answer %v, exception %v, err %v", types, exc, err)
		}
		if asked, reports := f.state(); len(asked) != 1 || len(reports) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("asked %v, reports %v; want one lookup and no failover", asked, reports)
		}
	})

	t.Run("hello", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := closedAddr(t)
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{closedAddr(t), refusesHello.addr}}
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner, f, nil, nil)
		if _, err := c.hello(failoverDB); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("the hello must fail when no candidate completes it")
		}
		select {
		case err := <-c.done:
			if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "dial upstream: dial tcp "+owner+": ") {
				t.Fatalf("Run = %v, want the original dial error of %s", err, owner)
			}
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("Run did not end")
		}
	})
}

func replicaFailoverMetric(t *testing.T, name, reason string) (float64, bool) {
	t.Helper()
	families, err := prometheus.DefaultGatherer.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, family := range families {
		if family.GetName() != name {
			continue
		}
		for _, m := range family.GetMetric() {
			for _, label := range m.GetLabel() {
				if label.GetName() == "reason" && label.GetValue() == reason {
					return m.GetCounter().GetValue(), true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}

// TestAgentReplicaFailoverMetricsCountByReasonIncludingZeros: both counters
// export both reasons from startup, a served failover counts in
// clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total and a failover no candidate
// served in clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total.
func TestAgentReplicaFailoverMetricsCountByReasonIncludingZeros(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total", "clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total"} {
		for _, reason := range []string{"owner_quarantined", "owner_unreachable"} {
			if _, ok := replicaFailoverMetric(t, name, reason); !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s{reason=%q} is not exported", name, reason)
			}
		}
	}
	served := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_unreachable"))
	exhausted := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoverExhaustedTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined"))

	replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, closedAddr(t), &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{replica.addr}}, nil, NewMetricsObserver())
	c.mustHello("replica")
	if got := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_unreachable")); got != served+1 {
		t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_unreachable} = %g, want %g", got, served+1)
	}

	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
	c = startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{closedAddr(t)}}, nil, NewMetricsObserver())
	c.mustHello("owner")
	c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
	if got := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoverExhaustedTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined")); got != exhausted+1 {
		t.Fatalf("failover_exhausted{owner_quarantined} = %g, want %g", got, exhausted+1)
	}
}

// TestRelayWithoutUpstreamFailoverIsUnchanged: without an UpstreamFailover
// the quarantine refusal reaches the client and the session keeps its owner,
// a failed dial ends the handshake with today's error, and no session is
// marked eligible.
func TestRelayWithoutUpstreamFailoverIsUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, nil, nil, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	if c.relay.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible {
		t.Fatal("a relay without an UpstreamFailover must not mark the session eligible")
	}
	c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
	if types, exc, err := c.run("u1", "USE other"); err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the owner must keep serving the session: answer %v, exception %v, err %v", types, exc, err)
	}
	if c.relay.sess.State().LogicalDatabaseName() != "" {
		t.Fatal("a relay without an UpstreamFailover must not record a USE")
	}

	down := closedAddr(t)
	c = startFailoverRelay(t, down, nil, nil, nil)
	if _, err := c.hello(failoverDB); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the hello must fail when the owner cannot be dialed")
	}
	select {
	case err := <-c.done:
		var opErr *net.OpError
		if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "dial upstream: dial tcp "+down+": ") || !errors.As(err, &opErr) {
			t.Fatalf("Run = %v, want the dial error of %s wrapped as before", err, down)
		}
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Run did not end")
	}
}

// TestAgentNeverFailsOverAClosedSession: when the client hangs up while its
// read is in flight, the relay closes the session and the upstream read
// fails; that failure is not the owner's and is never failed over.
func TestAgentNeverFailsOverAClosedSession(t *testing.T) {
	owner := startFakeUpstream(t, func(c *fakeConn) {
		if !c.hello("owner") {
			return
		}
		if _, ok := c.query(); ok && c.data() {
			c.drain()
		}
	})
	f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes).addr}}
	c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, nil)
	c.mustHello("owner")
	c.sendQuery("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
	c.sendEmptyData()
	_ = c.conn.Close()
	select {
	case <-c.done:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("Run did not end after the client hung up")
	}
	requireNoFailover(t, f)
}

// TestAgentTriesTheNextCandidateWhenOneCannotServeTheRead: replica_hosts is
// every enrolled indexer but the owner, so a candidate can take the hello
// and the read and still not serve it: its member does not serve the
// database, so it relays the quarantined owner's refusal, or its connection
// breaks before it answers. The read then moves on to the next candidate,
// and the failover is reported once, for the candidate that served. When
// none serves, the client gets the owner's original refusal and the failover
// counts as exhausted.
func TestAgentTriesTheNextCandidateWhenOneCannotServeTheRead(t *testing.T) {
	breaksAfterTheRead := func(c *fakeConn) {
		if c.hello("member") {
			if _, ok := c.query(); ok {
				_ = c.data()
			}
		}
	}

	t.Run("the next candidate serves", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		refuses := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		breaks := startFakeUpstream(t, breaksAfterTheRead)
		replica := startFakeUpstream(t, replicaServes)
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{refuses.addr, breaks.addr, replica.addr}}
		served := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined"))
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, NewMetricsObserver())
		c.mustHello("owner")
		c.mustServe("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t")
		for name, up := range map[string]*fakeUpstream{"refusing": refuses, "breaking": breaks, "serving": replica} {
			if _, queries := up.seen(); len(queries) != 1 || queries[0].ID != "q1" {
				t.Fatalf("%s candidate queries = %+v, want the replayed q1 once", name, queries)
			}
		}
		if asked, reports := f.state(); len(asked) != 1 || len(reports) != 1 || reports[0] != failoverDB+" owner_quarantined "+replica.addr {
			t.Fatalf("asked %v, reports %v; want one lookup and one report, for the candidate that served", asked, reports)
		}
		if got := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined")); got != served+1 {
			t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_quarantined} = %g, want %g", got, served+1)
		}
		if got := c.upstreamAddress(); got != replica.addr {
			t.Fatalf("session upstream = %q, want the replica %q", got, replica.addr)
		}
		c.mustServe("q2", "SELECT 1")
	})

	t.Run("no candidate serves", func(t *testing.T) {
		owner := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		first := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		second := startFakeUpstream(t, ownerQuarantined)
		f := &fakeFailover{candidates: []string{first.addr, second.addr}}
		served := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined"))
		exhausted := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoverExhaustedTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined"))
		c := startFailoverRelay(t, owner.addr, f, nil, NewMetricsObserver())
		c.mustHello("owner")
		c.mustRefuse("q1", "SELECT count() FROM t", quarantinedRead)
		for name, up := range map[string]*fakeUpstream{"first": first, "second": second} {
			if _, queries := up.seen(); len(queries) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("%s candidate queries = %d, want the read tried once on each", name, len(queries))
			}
		}
		if asked, reports := f.state(); len(asked) != 1 || len(reports) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("asked %v, reports %v; want one lookup and no report", asked, reports)
		}
		if got := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoverExhaustedTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined")); got != exhausted+1 {
			t.Fatalf("failover_exhausted{owner_quarantined} = %g, want %g", got, exhausted+1)
		}
		if got := testutil.ToFloat64(agentReplicaFailoversTotal.WithLabelValues("owner_quarantined")); got != served {
			t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_quarantined} = %g, want it unchanged at %g", got, served)
		}
		// The session stays on the last candidate that answered, which
		// routes it as the owner would.
		if types, exc, err := c.run("u1", "USE other"); err != nil || exc != nil || len(types) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("after the failover found no replica: answer %v, exception %v, err %v", types, exc, err)
		}
	})
}
```

Create `pkg/plugin/upstream_failover.go`:

```go
package plugin

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
)

// FailoverPhase is where an agent session's upstream failed (spec 2026-10-14
// §11, Plan S3-C4 K46). pkg/proxy re-exports it, with the constants and the
// two interfaces below, as proxy.FailoverPhase, proxy.FailoverAtHello,
// proxy.FailoverAtRead, proxy.UpstreamFailover and proxy.FailoverReporter;
// they live here so a plugin package implements them without importing
// pkg/proxy.
type FailoverPhase uint8

const (
	// FailoverAtHello: the dial to the session's upstream, or phase 2 of its
	// handshake, failed before the client received a ServerHello.
	FailoverAtHello FailoverPhase = 1
	// FailoverAtRead: the first answer of an eligible read was an Exception,
	// or the connection broke before any packet of that read reached the
	// client.
	FailoverAtRead FailoverPhase = 2
)

// UpstreamFailover moves an agent session whose owner refuses a read as
// quarantined, or cannot be reached, to a replica host. Candidates returns
// host:port addresses in the order to try. Reason classifies a failure (cause
// for a dial, transport or handshake error, exc for an Exception); ok=false
// leaves the failure to the client. The relay decides when a failover may
// happen at all; a nil proxy.Server.UpstreamFailover keeps it exactly as
// before.
type UpstreamFailover interface {
	Candidates(ctx context.Context, database string) ([]string, error)
	Reason(phase FailoverPhase, cause error, exc *chproto.Exception) (reason string, ok bool)
}

// FailoverReporter is implemented by an UpstreamFailover that records every
// failover that reached a serving upstream: from is the failed upstream's
// address ("" when it is unknown), to the candidate that now serves the
// session.
type FailoverReporter interface {
	FailedOver(ctx context.Context, database, reason, from, to string)
}
```

Create `pkg/proxy/relay_replica_failover.go`:

```go
package proxy

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"time"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/log"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/plugin"
	sicore "github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/storageintegrity"
)

// The failover port of spec 2026-10-14 §11 (Plan S3-C4 K46), defined in
// pkg/plugin so that a plugin package (agent.ReplicaFailover) implements it
// without importing pkg/proxy.
type (
	FailoverPhase    = plugin.FailoverPhase
	UpstreamFailover = plugin.UpstreamFailover
	FailoverReporter = plugin.FailoverReporter
)

const (
	FailoverAtHello = plugin.FailoverAtHello
	FailoverAtRead  = plugin.FailoverAtRead
)

// replicaFailoverObserver is the metrics side of a failover, implemented by
// MetricsObserver.
type replicaFailoverObserver interface {
	ReplicaFailover(reason string)
	ReplicaFailoverExhausted(reason string)
}

// replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout bounds one failover step: the candidate
// lookup, and each candidate's dial, handshake and resent query.
const replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout = 10 * time.Second

// failoverQuery is the failover state of the session's active query, guarded
// by Relay.failoverMu. Only a SELECT, WITH or standalone USE of a session
// that is still ReplicaFailoverEligible is armed.
type failoverQuery struct {
	query      *chproto.Query // the Query packet exactly as it was written upstream
	terminator []byte         // the raw terminating empty Data block, once it was written upstream
	read       bool           // a SELECT or WITH that may still fail over at its first answer
	use        string         // a USE target, recorded as the session database at its EndOfStream
	answered   bool           // a packet of its answer was relayed to the client
	moving     *readFailover  // the read failover under way, once a candidate took the read
}

// readFailover is a read failover under way: a candidate took the read and
// its first answer decides whether it serves. It keeps the candidates not
// tried yet, the owner's failure the client gets when none serves (its
// Exception packet, or its read error) and what to report once one serves.
type readFailover struct {
	database, reason, from, to string
	remaining                  []string
	original                   *chproto.Packet
	originalErr                error
	failures                   []error
}

type failoverStatement uint8

const (
	failoverOther failoverStatement = iota
	failoverRead
	failoverUse
)

// classifyFailoverStatement returns failoverRead for a statement starting
// with SELECT or WITH, failoverUse and its target for a standalone USE, and
// failoverOther for everything else, an unreadable statement included.
func classifyFailoverStatement(sql string) (failoverStatement, string) {
	words, err := sicore.LeadingKeywords(sql, 1)
	if err != nil || len(words) == 0 {
		return failoverOther, ""
	}
	switch words[0] {
	case "SELECT", "WITH":
		return failoverRead, ""
	case "USE":
		if db, ok, err := sicore.ParseUseDatabaseStrict(sql); err == nil && ok && db != "" {
			return failoverUse, db
		}
	}
	return failoverOther, ""
}

// noteFailoverStatement clears the session's failover eligibility at the
// first statement that is not a SELECT, WITH or standalone USE, or that runs
// under an ownership plan (every signed INSERT lane, query-only and abort
// plans): replaying the hello and one read on a new upstream must reproduce
// the session exactly.
func (r *Relay) noteFailoverStatement(qctx *plugin.QueryContext) {
	kind, _ := classifyFailoverStatement(qctx.Query.Body)
	planned := qctx.AgentPrepare != nil || qctx.QueryOnly != nil || qctx.SynthesizedInsert != nil ||
		qctx.DeferredInsert != nil || qctx.SuppressUpstreamExecution || qctx.AbortWithSuccess
	if kind == failoverOther || planned {
		r.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible = false
	}
}

// writeQuery writes the Query of an ordinary forwarded query. With an
// UpstreamFailover it arms the query's failover state while the session is
// eligible, and writes under failoverMu, so a read failover never races it.
func (r *Relay) writeQuery(up *chproto.Codec, qctx *plugin.QueryContext) error {
	if r.failover == nil {
		return up.WriteQuery(qctx.Query)
	}
	r.failoverMu.Lock()
	defer r.failoverMu.Unlock()
	r.failoverQuery = nil
	if kind, db := classifyFailoverStatement(qctx.Query.Body); kind != failoverOther && r.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible {
		r.failoverQuery = &failoverQuery{query: qctx.Query, read: kind == failoverRead, use: db}
	}
	return up.WriteQuery(qctx.Query)
}

// spliceClientPacket writes a client packet upstream. With an
// UpstreamFailover it writes to the session's current upstream under
// failoverMu, because a read failover may have replaced up, keeps the armed
// read's terminating empty Data block for a resend, and disarms the query at
// any other packet: client Data also ends the session's eligibility, and so
// does a USE whose outcome the relay can no longer follow.
func (r *Relay) spliceClientPacket(up *chproto.Codec, pkt *chproto.Packet, inputComplete bool) error {
	if r.failover == nil {
		return up.WriteRawPacket(pkt.Raw)
	}
	r.failoverMu.Lock()
	defer r.failoverMu.Unlock()
	if current := r.sess.Upstream(); current != nil {
		up = current
	}
	isData := pkt.Type == uint64(chproto.ClientDataCode)
	fq := r.failoverQuery
	switch {
	case fq != nil && isData && inputComplete && fq.terminator == nil:
		fq.terminator = append([]byte(nil), pkt.Raw...)
	case fq != nil:
		if isData || fq.use != "" {
			r.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible = false
		}
		r.failoverQuery = nil
	case isData && !inputComplete:
		r.sess.State().ReplicaFailoverEligible = false
	}
	return up.WriteRawPacket(pkt.Raw)
}

// failoverRead runs before upstreamToClient handles a packet or a read error
// of up, and returns what the loop handles instead. It returns true once the
// armed read moved to a replica host that has been sent its Query and
// terminator: the loop then reads the answer from the new upstream and drops
// this packet or error. Otherwise it returns false with the packet or error
// the loop handles exactly as without a failover: the one it was given, or,
// once every candidate that took the read failed it too, the owner's original
// refusal or read error. A candidate whose first answer is itself a failure
// the failover moves on (the quarantined owner's refusal it relays, or a
// connection that broke before any packet) leaves the read to the next
// candidate, so a reachable host that cannot serve the read never ends the
// failover. The failover counts as served, and is reported, only at the first
// answer that is not such a failure. It never fails over once a packet of the
// answer reached the client.
func (r *Relay) failoverRead(ctx context.Context, up *chproto.Codec, pkt *chproto.Packet, readErr error) (bool, *chproto.Packet, error) {
	r.failoverMu.Lock()
	fq := r.failoverQuery
	if fq == nil {
		r.failoverMu.Unlock()
		return false, pkt, readErr
	}
	var exc *chproto.Exception
	failed := false
	switch {
	case readErr != nil:
		failed = fq.read && !fq.answered && !errors.Is(readErr, chproto.ErrUnsupportedResultType)
	case pkt.Type == uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode):
		exc, _ = pkt.Decoded.(*chproto.Exception)
		failed = exc != nil && fq.read && !fq.answered
	}
	reason := ""
	if failed {
		var ok bool
		reason, ok = r.failover.Reason(FailoverAtRead, readErr, exc)
		failed = ok && !r.closing.Load() && ctx.Err() == nil
	}
	if !failed {
		// The read's own answer, the owner's or the serving candidate's.
		mv := fq.moving
		fq.moving = nil
		switch {
		case readErr != nil && errors.Is(readErr, chproto.ErrUnsupportedResultType):
			fq.answered = true
		case readErr != nil, pkt.Type == uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode):
			r.failoverQuery = nil
		case pkt.Type == uint64(chproto.ServerEndOfStreamCode):
			if fq.use != "" {
				r.sess.State().SetLogicalDatabase(fq.use)
			}
			r.failoverQuery = nil
		default:
			fq.answered = true
		}
		r.failoverMu.Unlock()
		if mv != nil {
			r.failedOver(ctx, mv.database, mv.reason, mv.from, mv.to)
		}
		return false, pkt, readErr
	}
	mv := fq.moving
	if mv == nil {
		database := r.failoverDatabase(nil)
		addrs, err := r.failoverCandidates(ctx, database)
		if err != nil {
			r.failoverQuery = nil
			r.failoverMu.Unlock()
			r.failoverExhausted(ctx, database, reason, err)
			return false, pkt, readErr
		}
		mv = &readFailover{database: database, reason: reason, from: failedUpstreamAddr(up, readErr), remaining: addrs, original: pkt, originalErr: readErr}
		fq.moving = mv
	} else {
		mv.failures = append(mv.failures, fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", mv.to, describeReadFailure(readErr, exc)))
	}
	to, err := r.readFailoverTo(ctx, fq, mv)
	if err != nil {
		r.failoverQuery = nil
		r.failoverMu.Unlock()
		r.failoverExhausted(ctx, mv.database, mv.reason, errors.Join(append(mv.failures, err)...))
		return false, mv.original, mv.originalErr
	}
	mv.to = to
	r.failoverMu.Unlock()
	return true, nil, nil
}

// describeReadFailure names a candidate's failed first answer for the
// exhausted log line.
func describeReadFailure(readErr error, exc *chproto.Exception) string {
	if exc != nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("answered code=%d %s", exc.Code, exc.Message)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("broke before answering: %v", readErr)
}

// readFailoverTo prepares the remaining candidates of mv in turn (dial, the
// session's hello with the failover database, the same revision and timezone
// the client received, then the armed Query and its terminator), consuming
// each, and rebinds the session to the first that takes them. The failed
// upstream stays bound until then. The caller holds failoverMu.
func (r *Relay) readFailoverTo(ctx context.Context, fq *failoverQuery, mv *readFailover) (string, error) {
	var errs []error
	for len(mv.remaining) > 0 {
		addr := mv.remaining[0]
		mv.remaining = mv.remaining[1:]
		up, sent, err := r.prepareReadCandidate(ctx, addr, mv.database, fq)
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", addr, err))
			continue
		}
		if err := r.sess.RebindUpstream(ctx, up, false); err != nil {
			closeCodec(up)
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", addr, err))
			continue
		}
		if r.closing.Load() {
			// The session closed while the candidate was prepared; its Close
			// may already have run on the previous upstream.
			closeCodec(up)
			return "", errors.New("the session closed during the failover")
		}
		r.sess.State().SetUpstreamHello(sent)
		return addr, nil
	}
	if len(errs) == 0 {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("no candidate left"))
	}
	return "", errors.Join(errs...)
}

func (r *Relay) prepareReadCandidate(ctx context.Context, addr, database string, fq *failoverQuery) (*chproto.Codec, *chproto.ClientHello, error) {
	state := r.sess.State()
	snap := state.Snapshot()
	hello := state.UpstreamHello()
	if hello == nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("the session has no replayable hello")
	}
	hello.Database = database
	hello.ProtocolVersion = snap.ClientRevision
	attemptCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	up, err := dialFailoverCandidate(attemptCtx, addr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	conn, _ := up.Conn().(net.Conn)
	if deadline, ok := attemptCtx.Deadline(); ok && conn != nil {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(deadline)
	}
	sent, _, srv, _, err := exchangeUpstreamHello(up, hello)
	if err == nil {
		rev := int(sent.ProtocolVersion)
		if int(srv.Revision) < rev {
			rev = int(srv.Revision)
		}
		switch {
		case rev != snap.ClientRevision:
			err = fmt.Errorf("negotiated revision %d, the client leg uses %d", rev, snap.ClientRevision)
		case snap.Timezone != "" && srv.Timezone != snap.Timezone:
			err = fmt.Errorf("server timezone %q, the client received %q", srv.Timezone, snap.Timezone)
		default:
			up.SetRevision(rev)
			if chproto.SupportsAddendum(rev) {
				res := up.ResolveUpstreamAddendum(chproto.AddendumResult{}, chproto.AddendumOpts{
					ProposedRecv: "chunked_optional",
					ProposedSend: "chunked_optional",
				})
				err = up.SendAddendum(res)
			}
		}
	}
	if err == nil {
		up.SetCompression(fq.query.Compression)
		err = up.WriteQuery(fq.query)
	}
	if err == nil && fq.terminator != nil {
		err = up.WriteRawPacket(fq.terminator)
	}
	if err != nil {
		closeCodec(up)
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	if conn != nil {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{})
	}
	return up, sent, nil
}

// failoverAtHello moves a session whose first upstream failed phase 2 of the
// handshake (cause; exc when it answered an Exception instead of a
// ServerHello) to the first candidate that completes phase 2 with the
// session's ClientHello, its Database set to the failover database, and binds
// it in place of the failed upstream (nil when the dial failed). When Reason
// declines or every candidate fails it returns cause unchanged.
func (r *Relay) failoverAtHello(ctx context.Context, failed *chproto.Codec, hello *chproto.ClientHello, cause error, exc *chproto.Exception) (*chproto.Codec, *chproto.ClientHello, *chproto.Packet, *chproto.ServerHello, error) {
	reason, ok := r.failover.Reason(FailoverAtHello, cause, exc)
	if !ok {
		return failed, nil, nil, nil, cause
	}
	database := r.failoverDatabase(hello)
	from := failedUpstreamAddr(failed, cause)
	addrs, err := r.failoverCandidates(ctx, database)
	var errs []error
	if err != nil {
		errs = append(errs, err)
	}
	for _, addr := range addrs {
		candidate := *hello
		candidate.Database = database
		up, sent, srvPkt, srv, err := helloCandidate(ctx, addr, &candidate)
		if err == nil {
			if failed == nil {
				err = r.sess.BindUpstream(ctx, up)
			} else {
				err = r.sess.RebindUpstream(ctx, up, false)
			}
			if err != nil {
				closeCodec(up)
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", addr, err))
			continue
		}
		r.failedOver(ctx, database, reason, from, addr)
		return up, sent, srvPkt, srv, nil
	}
	r.failoverExhausted(ctx, database, reason, errors.Join(errs...))
	return failed, nil, nil, nil, cause
}

func helloCandidate(ctx context.Context, addr string, hello *chproto.ClientHello) (*chproto.Codec, *chproto.ClientHello, *chproto.Packet, *chproto.ServerHello, error) {
	attemptCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	up, err := dialFailoverCandidate(attemptCtx, addr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	conn, _ := up.Conn().(net.Conn)
	if deadline, ok := attemptCtx.Deadline(); ok && conn != nil {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(deadline)
	}
	sent, srvPkt, srv, _, err := exchangeUpstreamHello(up, hello)
	if err != nil {
		closeCodec(up)
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	if conn != nil {
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Time{})
	}
	return up, sent, srvPkt, srv, nil
}

// exchangeUpstreamHello is phase 2 of the handshake on upstream: it writes
// hello (revision-capped by ClientHelloForUpstream) and reads the
// ServerHello, returning the hello it sent. An Exception instead of a
// ServerHello is returned as exc, with the handshake's error.
func exchangeUpstreamHello(upstream *chproto.Codec, hello *chproto.ClientHello) (*chproto.ClientHello, *chproto.Packet, *chproto.ServerHello, *chproto.Exception, error) {
	upstreamHello := chproto.ClientHelloForUpstream(hello)
	if err := upstream.WriteClientHello(upstreamHello); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("forward client hello: %w", err)
	}
	upstream.SetServerHelloRevisionHint(int(upstreamHello.ProtocolVersion))
	srvPkt, err := upstream.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ServerHelloCode), uint64(chproto.ServerExceptionCode))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read server hello: %w", err)
	}
	// Upstream may answer ClientHello with a ServerException instead — e.g.
	// invalid credentials forwarded by routing / peer-trust paths, or a
	// misconfigured peer port that lands on plain CH which doesn't recognise
	// our envelope user. Decode the Exception and surface its message so
	// operators don't see an opaque "decode failed".
	if exc, ok := srvPkt.Decoded.(*chproto.Exception); ok {
		return nil, nil, nil, exc, fmt.Errorf("upstream rejected handshake: code=%d %s: %s", exc.Code, exc.Name, exc.Message)
	}
	srv, ok := srvPkt.Decoded.(*chproto.ServerHello)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("server hello: unexpected packet type=%d (want ServerHello=%d): %w",
			srvPkt.Type, chproto.ServerHelloCode, chproto.ErrDecode)
	}
	return upstreamHello, srvPkt, srv, nil, nil
}

// failoverCandidates asks the UpstreamFailover for the session database's
// candidates, bounded by replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout.
func (r *Relay) failoverCandidates(ctx context.Context, database string) ([]string, error) {
	lookupCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, replicaFailoverAttemptTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	addrs, err := r.failover.Candidates(lookupCtx, database)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("replica hosts of %q: %w", database, err)
	}
	if len(addrs) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("replica hosts of %q: no candidate", database)
	}
	return addrs, nil
}

// failoverDatabase is the database a failover replays and looks candidates up
// for: the session's logical database (the hello's, or the target of its last
// successful USE), else the hello's.
func (r *Relay) failoverDatabase(hello *chproto.ClientHello) string {
	state := r.sess.State()
	if db := state.LogicalDatabaseName(); db != "" {
		return db
	}
	if hello != nil {
		return hello.Database
	}
	return state.PhysicalDatabaseName()
}

func (r *Relay) failedOver(ctx context.Context, database, reason, from, to string) {
	if o, ok := r.obs.(replicaFailoverObserver); ok {
		o.ReplicaFailover(reason)
	}
	if rep, ok := r.failover.(FailoverReporter); ok {
		rep.FailedOver(ctx, database, reason, from, to)
	}
}

func (r *Relay) failoverExhausted(ctx context.Context, database, reason string, err error) {
	if o, ok := r.obs.(replicaFailoverObserver); ok {
		o.ReplicaFailoverExhausted(reason)
	}
	_, logger := log.FromContext(ctx)
	logger.Warnw("relay: no replica host served the failover; the client gets the original error",
		"database", database, "reason", reason, "err", err)
}

// failedUpstreamAddr is the failed upstream's configured address, its remote
// address, or, when the dial itself failed, the address in the dial error.
func failedUpstreamAddr(up *chproto.Codec, cause error) string {
	if up != nil {
		if named, ok := up.Conn().(interface{ UpstreamAddress() string }); ok {
			return named.UpstreamAddress()
		}
		return upstreamAddr(up)
	}
	var opErr *net.OpError
	if errors.As(cause, &opErr) && opErr.Addr != nil {
		return opErr.Addr.String()
	}
	return ""
}

// dialFailoverCandidate dials a replica host. Its conn reports the address it
// was dialed with, as the agent's own dialer's does, so the SI statement
// lane's upstream switch compares the same identity.
func dialFailoverCandidate(ctx context.Context, addr string) (*chproto.Codec, error) {
	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, "tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("dial %s: %w", addr, err)
	}
	return chproto.NewCodec(&failoverConn{Conn: conn, address: addr}, chproto.DirToUpstream), nil
}

type failoverConn struct {
	net.Conn
	address string
}

func (c *failoverConn) UpstreamAddress() string { return c.address }
```

```go
func (m *MetricsObserver) ReplicaFailoverExhausted(reason string) {
	agentReplicaFailoverExhaustedTotal.WithLabelValues(reason).Inc()
}
```

```bash
before any packet reached the client): the relay replays the hello

clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total{reason} and
```

```go
package agent

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go/proto"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/log"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/network"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/proxy"
)

// fakeReplicaDiscovery answers StorageIntegrityReplicaHosts with hosts or err
// and records each call.
type fakeReplicaDiscovery struct {
	hosts []uint64
	err   error
	calls []string
}

func (d *fakeReplicaDiscovery) StorageIntegrityReplicaHosts(_ context.Context, database string, owner uint64) ([]uint64, error) {
	d.calls = append(d.calls, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", database, owner))
	return d.hosts, d.err
}

// replicaFailoverState is a network of four indexers: db2 is owned by
// indexer 1, and indexer 2 advertises no HouseGate port.
func replicaFailoverState() *network.InMemoryNetworkState {
	ns := network.NewInMemoryNetworkState()
	ns.DatabaseInfos["db2"] = network.DatabaseInfo{IndexerId: 1}
	ns.IndexerInfos[0] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 0, IndexerUrl: "node-a", ClickhouseProxyPort: 9001}
	ns.IndexerInfos[1] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 1, IndexerUrl: "node-b", ClickhouseProxyPort: 9002}
	ns.IndexerInfos[2] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 2, IndexerUrl: "node-c"}
	ns.IndexerInfos[3] = network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: 3, IndexerUrl: "node-d", ClickhouseProxyPort: 9004}
	return ns
}

// TestReplicaFailoverCandidatesSkipTheOwnerAndUnboundIndexers: candidates are
// the database's replica hosts in ascending id, once each, without the owner,
// an indexer without a HouseGate port or one the topology does not know; a
// database without a name or an owner, and a failed lookup, give none.
func TestReplicaFailoverCandidatesSkipTheOwnerAndUnboundIndexers(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	ns := replicaFailoverState()
	discovery := &fakeReplicaDiscovery{hosts: []uint64{3, 2, 9, 0, 1, 3}}
	f := &ReplicaFailover{Discovery: discovery, Databases: ns, Topology: ns}
	got, err := f.Candidates(ctx, "db2")
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"node-a:9001", "node-d:9004"}) {
		t.Fatalf("Candidates(db2) = %v, %v; want [node-a:9001 node-d:9004]", got, err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(discovery.calls, []string{"db2/1"}) {
		t.Fatalf("discovery calls = %v, want one for db2 with owner 1", discovery.calls)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(discovery.hosts, []uint64{3, 2, 9, 0, 1, 3}) {
		t.Fatalf("Candidates reordered the discovery's slice: %v", discovery.hosts)
	}

	for _, database := range []string{"", "unknown"} {
		if got, err := f.Candidates(ctx, database); err == nil || got != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Candidates(%q) = %v, %v; want no candidate and an error", database, got, err)
		}
	}
	if len(discovery.calls) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("discovery calls = %v; a database without an owner must not be looked up", discovery.calls)
	}

	discovery.err = errors.New("rpc: replica hosts of db2: no indexer answered sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo")
	if got, err := f.Candidates(ctx, "db2"); !errors.Is(err, discovery.err) || got != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Candidates with a failed lookup = %v, %v; want no candidate and the lookup's error", got, err)
	}
}

// TestReplicaFailoverReasonClassifiesQuarantineAndUnreachable: a read fails
// over only on the exact read-side quarantine refusal (owner_quarantined) or
// a broken connection (owner_unreachable); a hello fails over on any failure,
// an Exception included, because the remote host's pivot to the owner
// failed. Every other Exception of a read reaches the client unchanged, and
// both reasons are exported by the proxy's counters from startup.
func TestReplicaFailoverReasonClassifiesQuarantineAndUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
	f := &ReplicaFailover{}
	quarantined := chproto.TableRefusedMessage("db2.t", "indexer_quarantined", "storage-integrity indexer 1 is quarantined")
	exc := func(code int32, msg string) *chproto.Exception {
		return &chproto.Exception{Code: proto.Error(code), Name: "DB::Exception", Message: msg}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		phase  proxy.FailoverPhase
		cause  error
		exc    *chproto.Exception
		reason string
		ok     bool
	}{
		{"read refused as quarantined", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(392, quarantined), FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined, true},
		{"read refused as quarantined, seq unspent", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(392, quarantined+chproto.SeqUnspentSuffix), FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined, true},
		{"read connection broke", proxy.FailoverAtRead, io.EOF, nil, FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, true},
		{"read refused for another reason", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(392, chproto.TableRefusedMessage("db2.t", "SCHEMA_INVALID", "bad column")), "", false},
		{"read refused by the arbiter's write-side quarantine", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(392, chproto.IndexerQuarantinedMessage("db2.t")), "", false},
		{"read refused as pending", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(733, "storage_integrity: table db2.t is pending activation (retryable)"), "", false},
		{"read refused by ClickHouse", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, exc(60, "Table db2.t does not exist"), "", false},
		{"hello dial failed", proxy.FailoverAtHello, errors.New("dial upstream: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:1: connect: connection refused"), nil, FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, true},
		{"hello answered an Exception", proxy.FailoverAtHello, errors.New("upstream rejected handshake"), exc(392, "forward: dial peer: connection refused"), FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, true},
		{"nothing failed", proxy.FailoverAtRead, nil, nil, "", false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reason, ok := f.Reason(tc.phase, tc.cause, tc.exc)
			if reason != tc.reason || ok != tc.ok {
				t.Fatalf("Reason = %q, %v; want %q, %v", reason, ok, tc.reason, tc.ok)
			}
		})
	}

	if FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable != "owner_unreachable" || FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined != "owner_quarantined" {
		t.Fatalf("reasons = %q, %q", FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined)
	}
	families, err := prometheus.DefaultGatherer.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	exported := map[string]bool{}
	for _, family := range families {
		for _, m := range family.GetMetric() {
			for _, label := range m.GetLabel() {
				if label.GetName() == "reason" {
					exported[family.GetName()+"/"+label.GetValue()] = true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total", "clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total"} {
		for _, reason := range []string{FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined, FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable} {
			if !exported[name+"/"+reason] {
				t.Fatalf("%s{reason=%q} is not exported", name, reason)
			}
		}
	}
}

// TestReplicaFailoverLogsEachFailover: every failover that reached a serving
// replica host is logged at info as "agent: replica failover" with the
// database, its owner, the reason and both addresses.
func TestReplicaFailoverLogsEachFailover(t *testing.T) {
	ns := replicaFailoverState()
	f := &ReplicaFailover{Discovery: &fakeReplicaDiscovery{hosts: []uint64{0}}, Databases: ns, Topology: ns}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	ctx := log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.New(slog.NewTextHandler(&buf, nil)))
	if _, err := f.Candidates(ctx, "db2"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.FailedOver(ctx, "db2", FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined, "node-b:9002", "node-a:9001")
	line := buf.String()
	for _, want := range []string{`level=INFO`, `msg="agent: replica failover"`, `database=db2`, `owner=1`, `reason=owner_quarantined`, `from=node-b:9002`, `to=node-a:9001`} {
		if !strings.Contains(line, want) {
			t.Fatalf("log %q lacks %s", line, want)
		}
	}
}

// ReplicaFailover satisfies the relay's port under its pkg/proxy names.
var (
	_ proxy.UpstreamFailover = (*ReplicaFailover)(nil)
	_ proxy.FailoverReporter = (*ReplicaFailover)(nil)
)
```

```go
func TestBuildAgentWiresReplicaFailoverOnlyForAnUnpinnedRPCNetworkState(t *testing.T) {

	if err := os.WriteFile(yamlState, []byte("indexer_infos: {}\n"), 0o600); err != nil {

		cfg.Agent.Mode = true

	}

	failover, ok := srv.UpstreamFailover.(*agent.ReplicaFailover)
	if !ok {

				t.Fatalf("UpstreamFailover = %T, want nil", srv.UpstreamFailover)

	}
}
```

Create `pkg/plugins/agent/replica_failover.go`:

```go
package agent

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/log"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/plugin"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/registry"
)

// Replica failover reasons, the reason label of
// clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total and
// clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total.
const (
	FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable = "owner_unreachable"
	FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined = "owner_quarantined"
)

// ReplicaFailover is the agent's replica tier (spec 2026-10-14 §11, Plan
// S3-C4 K46): it fails a session's reads, never its writes, over to a host
// that serves the owner's database from its member's copy, when the owner
// refuses a read as quarantined or cannot be reached. It implements
// plugin.UpstreamFailover and plugin.FailoverReporter, which pkg/proxy
// re-exports as proxy.UpstreamFailover and proxy.FailoverReporter. The relay
// decides when a failover may happen; ReplicaFailover names the candidates
// and classifies the failure.
type ReplicaFailover struct {
	Discovery registry.StorageIntegrityReplicaDiscovery
	Databases registry.Databases
	Topology  registry.Topology

	// owners remembers each database's owner, as Candidates resolved it,
	// for the failover log.
	owners sync.Map
}

// Candidates returns the database's replica hosts in ascending indexer id,
// once each, as Url:HousegatePort, without the owner (Databases.Get) and
// without any indexer the topology does not know or that advertises no
// HouseGate port. An empty database, one Databases.Get does not know, and a
// failed discovery give no candidate: the original failure then reaches the
// client.
func (f *ReplicaFailover) Candidates(ctx context.Context, database string) ([]string, error) {
	if database == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("agent: replica failover: the session has no database")
	}
	db, ok := f.Databases.Get(database)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("agent: replica failover: database %s is not in the network state", database)
	}
	f.owners.Store(database, db.IndexerId)
	hosts, err := f.Discovery.StorageIntegrityReplicaHosts(ctx, database, db.IndexerId)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	ids := append([]uint64(nil), hosts...)
	sort.Slice(ids, func(i, j int) bool { return ids[i] < ids[j] })
	var out []string
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id == db.IndexerId || (i > 0 && ids[i-1] == id) {
			continue
		}
		addr, ok := f.Topology.ProxyByIndexerId(id)
		if !ok || addr.Url == "" || addr.HousegatePort == 0 {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, addr.Addr())
	}
	return out, nil
}

// Reason classifies a failure. At FailoverAtRead only an Exception that
// chproto.IsIndexerQuarantinedReadMessage matches fails over
// (owner_quarantined); every other Exception of a read reaches the client
// unchanged. In either phase a failure without an Exception (dial, EOF,
// reset, read error) is owner_unreachable, and so is any Exception at
// FailoverAtHello, since the remote host's pivot to the owner failed.
func (f *ReplicaFailover) Reason(phase plugin.FailoverPhase, cause error, exc *chproto.Exception) (string, bool) {
	switch {
	case exc == nil && cause != nil:
		return FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, true
	case exc != nil && phase == plugin.FailoverAtHello:
		return FailoverReasonOwnerUnreachable, true
	case exc != nil && phase == plugin.FailoverAtRead && chproto.IsIndexerQuarantinedReadMessage(exc.Message):
		return FailoverReasonOwnerQuarantined, true
	}
	return "", false
}

// FailedOver logs a failover that reached a serving replica host.
func (f *ReplicaFailover) FailedOver(ctx context.Context, database, reason, from, to string) {
	owner, _ := f.owners.Load(database)
	_, logger := log.FromContext(ctx)
	logger.Infow("agent: replica failover", "database", database, "owner", owner, "reason", reason, "from", from, "to", to)
}

var (
	_ plugin.UpstreamFailover = (*ReplicaFailover)(nil)
	_ plugin.FailoverReporter = (*ReplicaFailover)(nil)
)
```

```go
// buildAgentReplicaFailover returns the agent's replica read failover (spec
// 2026-10-14 §11, Plan S3-C4 K46), or nil. It exists only when the agent
// discovers its upstreams (no agent.upstream pin) through a network state that
// answers replica-host discovery, which only the RPC source does: a pinned
// upstream, a YAML file and a host-injected in-memory state keep every relay
// exactly as before.
func buildAgentReplicaFailover(opts Options, rf *redisFactory) (proxy.UpstreamFailover, error) {
	cfg := opts.Config
	if cfg.Agent.Upstream != "" || (opts.NetworkState == nil && !cfg.NetworkState.IsRpcSource()) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	reg, err := agentNetworkState(opts, rf)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	discovery, ok := reg.(registry.StorageIntegrityReplicaDiscovery)
	if !ok || isNilInterface(discovery) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return &agent.ReplicaFailover{Discovery: discovery, Databases: reg, Topology: reg}, nil
}
```

- [ ] **Step 22: Write the integration test**

The member host is Task 43's `startReplicaReadsHost` (indexer 1, serving `rrdb.a` and `rrdb.b` from `hg_replica`). The owner, indexer 2, is a fake HouseGate that answers ClickHouse's timezone at revision 54453 and refuses every statement but `SET` with the quarantine refusal its host answers for its tables. The agent's network state is a JSON-RPC fake of the storage node that lists both indexers, gives `rrdb` (owned by 2) to the agent's account, so the selector always lands on the owner, and answers `replica_hosts` `{rrdb: [1]}`.

Create `pkg/integration/storage_integrity_agent_replica_failover_test.go`:

```go
package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go/proto"
	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"

	housegate "github.com/housegate/housegate"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/chproto"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/config"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/integration/testenv"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/network"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/sitable"
)

// The agent replica-failover test (spec 2026-10-14 §11, Plan S3-C4 K46) runs
// the agent of a client whose only database, rrdb, is owned by indexer 2,
// against a member host (indexer 1, Task 43's startReplicaReadsHost) that
// serves rrdb.a and rrdb.b from hg_replica copies. The owner is a fake
// HouseGate that refuses every statement with the quarantine refusal its host
// answers for its tables. The agent's network state is a JSON-RPC fake of the
// storage-node RPC that advertises indexer 1 as rrdb's replica host.

// failoverOwnerRevision is below the addendum revision, so the fake owner
// speaks no addendum; the client, the agent and the member host then all
// negotiate it.
const failoverOwnerRevision = 54453

var failoverOwnerRefusal = chproto.TableRefusedMessage(replicaReadsDB+".a", "indexer_quarantined", "storage-integrity indexer 2 is quarantined")

// startQuarantinedOwner is the fake owner host: it answers the hello with
// ClickHouse's timezone, a SET with EndOfStream and every other statement
// with the quarantine refusal.
func startQuarantinedOwner(t *testing.T, timezone string) net.Listener {
	t.Helper()
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = ln.Close() })
	go func() {
		for {
			conn, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			go func() {
				defer conn.Close()
				_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second))
				codec := chproto.NewCodec(conn, chproto.DirFromClient)
				if _, err := codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientHelloCode)); err != nil {
					return
				}
				var b proto.Buffer
				(&proto.ServerHello{Name: "owner", Major: 25, Minor: 8, Revision: failoverOwnerRevision, Timezone: timezone, DisplayName: "quarantined-owner"}).EncodeAware(&b, failoverOwnerRevision)
				if _, err := conn.Write(b.Buf); err != nil {
					return
				}
				codec.SetRevision(failoverOwnerRevision)
				codec.SetCompression(proto.CompressionDisabled)
				for {
					q, err := codec.ReadPacket(uint64(chproto.ClientQueryCode))
					if err != nil || q.Type != uint64(chproto.ClientQueryCode) {
						return
					}
					if pkt, err := codec.ReadPacket(); err != nil || pkt.Type != uint64(chproto.ClientDataCode) {
						return
					}
					if strings.HasPrefix(q.Decoded.(*chproto.Query).Body, "SET ") {
						if _, err := conn.Write([]byte{byte(chproto.ServerEndOfStreamCode)}); err != nil {
							return
						}
						continue
					}
					if err := codec.WriteException(&chproto.Exception{Code: proto.Error(chproto.CodeQueryIsProhibited), Name: "DB::Exception", Message: failoverOwnerRefusal}); err != nil {
						return
					}
				}
			}()
		}
	}()
	return ln
}

// failoverNetworkRPC is the agent's network state: indexers 1 (the member
// host) and 2 (the owner), rrdb owned by 2 and permitted to the agent's
// account, and replica_hosts {rrdb: [1]}.
func failoverNetworkRPC(t *testing.T, member, owner string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var indexers []network.IndexerInfo
	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var req struct {
			Method string        `json:"method"`
			Params []interface{} `json:"params"`
			ID     uint64        `json:"id"`
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		infos := indexers
		mu.Unlock()
		database := network.DatabaseInfo{DatabaseId: replicaReadsDB, IndexerId: replicaReadsOwner}
		var result any
		switch req.Method {
		case "sentio_getIndexerInfos":
			result = infos
		case "sentio_getIndexerInfoById":
			id, _ := req.Params[0].(float64)
			for _, info := range infos {
				if info.IndexerId == uint64(id) {
					result = info
				}
			}
		case "sentio_getDatabaseInfoById":
			if req.Params[0] == replicaReadsDB {
				result = database
			}
		case "sentio_getDatabaseInfoByAccount":
			result = []network.DatabaseInfo{database}
		case "sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo":
			result = map[string]any{"enabled": true, "replica_databases": []string{}, "replica_hosts": map[string][]uint64{replicaReadsDB: {1}}}
		}
		body, _ := json.Marshal(result)
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":%d,"result":%s}`, req.ID, body)
	}))
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	u, err := url.Parse(srv.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, rpcPort, _ := net.SplitHostPort(u.Host)
	info := func(id uint64, addr string) network.IndexerInfo {
		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		hp, _ := strconv.Atoi(port)
		sp, _ := strconv.Atoi(rpcPort)
		return network.IndexerInfo{IndexerId: id, IndexerUrl: host, ClickhouseProxyPort: uint16(hp), StorageNodeRpcPort: uint16(sp)}
	}
	mu.Lock()
	indexers = []network.IndexerInfo{info(1, member), info(replicaReadsOwner, owner)}
	mu.Unlock()
	return srv.URL
}

// replicaFailovers reads clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total for
// reason from the in-process agent's registry.
func replicaFailovers(t *testing.T, reason string) float64 {
	t.Helper()
	families, err := prometheus.DefaultGatherer.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, family := range families {
		if family.GetName() != "clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total" {
			continue
		}
		for _, m := range family.GetMetric() {
			for _, label := range m.GetLabel() {
				if label.GetName() == "reason" && label.GetValue() == reason {
					return m.GetCounter().GetValue()
				}
			}
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total{reason=%q} is not exported", reason)
	return 0
}

// TestAgentReplicaFailover_ReadsAQuarantinedOwnersTableFromAMember: a client
// of the quarantined owner's database reads, in safe mode, through its agent:
// the agent's session lands on the owner, which refuses the read as
// quarantined, and the agent replays the hello and the read on the member
// host, which answers from the copies. A write is refused by the owner and
// never replayed, and a session that issued a SET no longer fails over (the
// client drops a connection after any error, so a write cannot be followed on
// its session). Once the owner cannot be reached at all, a new session's
// hello fails over too.
func TestAgentReplicaFailover_ReadsAQuarantinedOwnersTableFromAMember(t *testing.T) {
	seed := seedReplicaReads(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var timezone string
	if err := seed.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT timezone()").Scan(&timezone); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	member := startReplicaReadsHost(t, sitable.NewFake(sitable.Ordinary, replicaReadsServed()...))
	owner := startQuarantinedOwner(t, timezone)
	rpcURL := failoverNetworkRPC(t, member.Addr, owner.Addr().String())
	rpc, err := network.NewRpcNetworkState(rpcURL, network.RpcOptions{Timeout: 2 * time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	agent := testenv.StartAgentProxyWithSelector(t, authTestKey1, func(cfg *config.Config, opts *housegate.Options) {
		cfg.NetworkState.Source = rpcURL
		opts.NetworkState = rpc
	})

	quarantined := replicaFailovers(t, "owner_quarantined")
	conn := openConnDB(t, agent.Addr, replicaReadsDB)
	safe := clickhouse.Context(ctx, clickhouse.WithSettings(clickhouse.Settings{"SQL_x_read_mode": clickhouse.CustomSetting{Value: "safe"}}))
	var n uint64
	if err := conn.QueryRow(safe, "SELECT count() FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id").Scan(&n); err != nil || n != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("read through the agent = %d, %v; want the copies' JOIN count 2", n, err)
	}
	if got := replicaFailovers(t, "owner_quarantined"); got != quarantined+1 {
		t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_quarantined} = %g, want %g", got, quarantined+1)
	}
	if got := queryUint64(t, conn, "SELECT sum(id) FROM rrdb.a"); got != 6 {
		t.Fatalf("a second read on the failed-over session = %d, want 6 from the copy", got)
	}

	writer := openConnDB(t, agent.Addr, replicaReadsDB)
	if err := writer.Exec(ctx, "INSERT INTO a (id, v) VALUES (9, 'x')"); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), failoverOwnerRefusal) {
		t.Fatalf("a write through the agent = %v, want the owner's refusal %q", err, failoverOwnerRefusal)
	}
	stateful := openConnDB(t, agent.Addr, replicaReadsDB)
	if err := stateful.Exec(ctx, "SET max_threads = 1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SET through the agent: %v", err)
	}
	if err := stateful.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT count() FROM a").Scan(&n); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), failoverOwnerRefusal) {
		t.Fatalf("a read after a SET on the same session = %d, %v; want the owner's refusal, never a failover", n, err)
	}
	if got := replicaFailovers(t, "owner_quarantined"); got != quarantined+1 {
		t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_quarantined} = %g after the write and the stateful read, want still %g", got, quarantined+1)
	}
	if got := queryUint64(t, seed, "SELECT count() FROM "+sitable.ReplicaDatabase+"."+replicaReadsCopyA); got != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("copy rows = %d, want the 3 installed rows", got)
	}

	unreachable := replicaFailovers(t, "owner_unreachable")
	_ = owner.Close()
	fresh := openConnDB(t, agent.Addr, replicaReadsDB)
	if got := queryUint64(t, fresh, "SELECT count() FROM a"); got != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("a read through a session whose owner is unreachable = %d, want 3 from the copy", got)
	}
	if got := replicaFailovers(t, "owner_unreachable"); got != unreachable+1 {
		t.Fatalf("failovers{owner_unreachable} = %g, want %g", got, unreachable+1)
	}
}
```

```text
**Replica read failover** (spec 2026-10-14 §11). An agent without a pinned `agent.upstream` and with an RPC `network_state.source` fails reads, never writes, over to a host that serves a quarantined or unreachable owner's database from its member's verified copy. When the owner's host answers a `SELECT` or `WITH` with `storage_integrity: table <id> was refused: indexer_quarantined: <reason>` as its first packet, or the owner cannot be reached at hello or before any packet of such a read reached the client, the agent replays the hello and that one query on the first host in `replica_hosts[<database>]` (from `sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo`, asked of the network-state source first and then of every other indexer, cached 30 s per database), without the owner and indexers that advertise no HouseGate port. Only a session that has issued nothing but `SELECT`, `WITH` and `USE`, without external-table data, is eligible: an INSERT (INSERT ... SELECT included), `SET`, DDL or any other statement ends eligibility for the rest of the session, and a query fails over at most once and never after a packet of its answer reached the client. The injected `SQL_x_read_mode` is kept, so an `unsafe_latest` read is refused by the replica host with a message naming safe mode: read with `SQL_x_read_mode='safe'`. When no candidate serves, the client gets the original error. Each failover logs `agent: replica failover` (database, owner, reason, from, to) and counts in `clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total{reason}` (`owner_quarantined`, `owner_unreachable`); `clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total{reason}` counts those no candidate served.
```
