```markdown
Stage 3, P3, of the multi-source storage-integrity network: reads from members (spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` §11 and §14 bullet 1; plan S3-C4 Tasks 42–44, contract §29, clarifications K44–K48 and K50). A member host answers a quarantined or unreachable owner's SI tables read-only, in safe mode, from its member's verified copies in `hg_replica`; the agent fails reads, never writes, over to such a host. Everything is inert until a host injects Replica entries (sentio-node, plan S3-C4 Task 46) or an agent runs with an RPC network state and no pinned upstream.

Table status (Task 42):
- `sitable.Replica` (status 5, `replica`), `Table.CopyTable` / `ReplicaOf`, `Snapshot.Served()`, `ServedDatabases`; `Schema` misses a Replica table, so the signed ingress refuses it with its existing not-active text.
- `sitablestate` Replica rows: reads and metadata pass; every write, DDL and data-carrying creation is refused 392 `storage_integrity: table <id> is served read-only from a copy of indexer <n>'s published data; write through its owner`.
- `sitable.ReplicaReads`, fed by `sitablestate`, counts in-flight replica-served reads per database (K44); `Options.StorageIntegrityReplicaReads` injects it.
- `registry.TableStatusReplica` and the additive status fields `replica_of`, `served_from`, `owner_entry`, `frozen_since` (omitted for every other status); `RpcNetworkState` accepts the status `replica`.

Routing and rewrite (Task 43):
- `forward.Plugin.TableState`: a hello or standalone `USE` of a replica-served database stays local; once serving ends, the session's next statement gets the retryable 733 asking to reconnect.
- The rewrite reads Replica tables from the copy (`SafeTable` = `UnsafeTable` = `hg_replica.<copy>`), keeps the database's remote mapping for its ordinary tables, refuses `unsafe_latest` of a copy with a message naming safe mode, and the scrubber maps the copy back. Both engines resolve SI tables before remote mapping, measured with rewriter-go v0.17.0 (FFI) and the devnet2 `rewriter-grpc` v0.17.0 image.
- Writes and DDL of a served table are refused by the engines first, as measured on ClickHouse 25.8.28.1 (`rewriter rejected SQL (code=UnsupportedStatement): insert target maps to a remote upstream; remote() can only appear as a SELECT-side table function`, and `storage-integrity table rrdb.a accepts writes only through the signed statement lane` for ALTER, DELETE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE, RENAME and every CREATE), with sitablestate's 392 as the second layer.
- `sireserved` refuses a computed object-carrier argument on a peer loopback (`merge(concat('hg_', 'replica'), '.*')`, and any identifier argument, which ClickHouse resolves through the statement's aliases: `WITH concat('hg_', 'replica') AS d SELECT * FROM merge(d, '.*')`; reason `computed_carrier_argument`, K48); S3-A's `peerLegForms` and the measured peer legs still pass.

Agent read failover (Task 44):
- `chproto.TableRefusedMessage` / `IsIndexerQuarantinedReadMessage`; `replica_databases` / `replica_hosts` in `StorageIntegrityInfo`; `RpcNetworkState.StorageIntegrityReplicaHosts` (the network-state source, then every indexer but the owner; 30 s cache).
- `proxy.Server.UpstreamFailover`: the relay fails a session over only at hello or at an eligible read's first answer (the read-side quarantine refusal, or a broken connection before any packet reached the client), replays the hello and that one query on the first replica host that takes them at the client's revision and timezone, and only then rebinds; a replica host whose first answer is itself such a failure (the owner's refusal relayed by a host whose member does not serve) is followed by the next one, and only a usable answer counts as a failover. Writes, INSERT ... SELECT, `SET`, anything after an answer packet and a closing session never fail over; the injected read mode is kept; an exhausted failover lets the original error through. The port lives in `pkg/plugin` and `pkg/proxy` re-exports it.
- `agent.ReplicaFailover`, wired for an agent with an RPC network state and no pinned `agent.upstream`; counters `clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failovers_total{reason}` and `clickhouse_proxy_agent_replica_failover_exhausted_total{reason}`; log `agent: replica failover`.
- `TestAgentReplicaFailover_ReadsAQuarantinedOwnersTableFromAMember`: an agent of a quarantined owner's database reads the copies through the member host (ClickHouse 25.8.28.1, FFI v0.17.0).

Compatibility: `Snapshot` gains `Served()`, which breaks every outside implementation; the only one, sentio-node's table state, pins this release together with its own change (plan S3-C4 Task 46, K47). No wire change for older clients beyond the status name `replica`, which no host answers before every agent is upgraded (K47). Rollback: the previous release.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
```

```bash
[ "$(git -C "$d" rev-list --count "$ref..HEAD")" = 1 ] && [ -z "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain)" ] || { echo "the ledger worktree $d is not one clean record commit ahead of $ref: stop"; exit 1; }
if [ "$ref" = origin/main ]; then
  git -C "$d" push -u origin HEAD
  printf '%s\n\n%s\n' "$(git -C "$d" log -1 --format=%s): Appendix C of Plan S3-C4 only, docs only (contract §32.7, decision D23)." '🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)' > "$L/record-s3c4-$n-pr.md"
  (cd "$d" && gh pr create --repo housegate/housegate --base main --title "$(git log -1 --format=%s)" --body-file "$L/record-s3c4-$n-pr.md") | tee "$L/record-s3c4-$n-pr-url"
else
  git -C "$d" push origin "HEAD:${ref#origin/}"
fi
```

## Task 45: arbiter-core — `member/serve`: serving view, owner probe, serving leases and the install hold; release `CORE_TAG_P3` (S3-C4)

Spec §11 ("Reads from members"), clarifications K44 and K45, contract §30. A member host serves a peer owner's database read-only from the member's copy only while the member says it may: the owner is quarantined, or its HouseGate has been unreachable from the member for `t_unreach`; the owner's `track_frontiers` entry in the latest published manifest, read from the arbiter in the same poll, has not moved over two polls; the copy equals that entry, the audits are clean, and the copy holds exactly the registry's Active incarnations of the database, none Foreign, Diverged or excluded; serving is enabled. The member grants its host one lease per served database, and before any install of that database it revokes the lease and waits until the host released it or it expired, so the host never reads a copy that is changing (K44). This task adds the package `member/serve` (the serving view, the owner probe, the leases, the bearer-token endpoint `GET /v1/serving` / `POST /v1/serving/{acquire,renew,release}` and its client `serve.Client`, the `sentio_node_si_member_serve_*` series), gives Plan S3-C2's installer the pair `install.Deps.AfterInstall` of its `BeforeInstall` seam, wires both into `member.Role` through `member.Config.Serve` (nil: byte for byte the P2 member), and releases arbiter-core as `CORE_TAG_P3`.

Nothing here touches consensus: no Raft command, tag, Raft-reachable field, snapshot version, header byte or feature string; `arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()` stays as `CORE_TAG_P2` has it; arbiter-proto stays at `PROTO_TAG` and housegate at the `HG_TAG_P1` pin of `CORE_TAG_P2` (contract §30.1). The member reads the arbiter only through the SafeState reads S3-C2 already makes (`GetSafeWatermark`, `GetManifest`). `CORE_TAG_P3` is what Task 46 pins in sentio-node (`serve.Client`, `serve.HostDeadlineMargin` on the host; `member.Config.Serve`, `Role.ServeHandler()`, `Role.ServeMetrics()` on the `si-member` process) and what Plan S3-D's `CORE_TAG_P4` builds on. This task may run in parallel with Tasks 42–44 (it needs only `CORE_TAG_P2`).

Notes (Facts F45.1–F45.14 for Appendix B):
- **F45.1 — The condition order.** Every poll evaluates each `(owner, database)` of `Copies.Databases()` and reports the first failing condition, in this order: `serving_disabled`; `installing`; `feed_unavailable` (the latest manifest could not be read in this poll, within `PollInterval`, or carries no entry of the owner); `owner_available`; `entry_unconfirmed`; `table_missing` (no copy of the database, or the database listed under two owners); `audit_unclean`; then, over the registry's Active incarnations of the database (`table_missing` when there is none, or when one of them belongs to another owner by `ManifestOwner`, all or nothing as the host answers it, K45): `table_foreign`, `table_diverged`, `table_excluded` (the copy of an Active incarnation at that seq has that condition), `copy_behind` (the owner's journal entry is not the published one), `table_missing` (an Active incarnation has no copy at its seq, or the copy's schema hash differs from the incarnation's or its name is not `sitable.CopyTable(id, seq)`). Contract §30.2's closed enum has no value for a duplicate listing or a mixed-owner database; both fail closed as `table_missing`. A disabled registry quarantines nobody and has no Active incarnation, so it reads `owner_available` unless `t_unreach` triggers, then `table_missing`.
- **F45.2 — "Lists exactly the Active incarnations" (§30.2 condition 4).** The copies of incarnations that are not Active (a Pending table not yet in a table set, whose copy Task 30's copyset already keeps; a Retiring one before its copy is dropped; an older seq of an Active table) are neither served nor counted, whatever their condition, so a new table never interrupts the serving of its database. The view's `tables` lists exactly the Active incarnations, which is what the host requires (K45, contract §31.4): the host answers Replica only when the view matches the registry by seq, schema hash and copy name. A Genesis incarnation's registry `SchemaHash` is the genesis manifest's (arbiter `fsm/table_registry.go:261`), which is what Task 32's `TableState.SchemaHash` (`TableSchemaHash(NetworkID, schema)`) gives for a genesis copy, so genesis tables serve like chain ones.
- **F45.3 — Two polls, and what resets them.** A database counts the consecutive polls that read the same owner entry; a poll whose manifest read fails, every poll while the database is installing, and `AfterInstall` reset the count to 0. So serving resumes only after two full polls since the install (contract §30.2), and after a feed failure only after two good polls (fail closed). A poll reads the registry, the manifest and the journal without the lock and applies them under it; a `BeforeInstall` or `AfterInstall` that ran in between (an epoch counter) makes that poll count as installing, so a stale journal read never confirms an entry. `FrozenSinceUnixMs` is the time of the first poll that read the owner's current entry (per owner, not reset by installs). With `Enabled` off a poll reads nothing from the arbiter, so a member whose serving is off costs no SafeState barrier (the agent window's `W-x-m` phase of Task 48).
- **F45.4 — One lease per database.** `Acquire` succeeds only for a database the last poll found serving and only at its view's `SnapshotID`; it replaces any earlier lease of the database (a host that restarted lost its id), recording the new lease before it ends the old one. It is refused while installing, because `BeforeInstall` marks installing before it revokes, under the same lock. A revoked lease is never renewed (409) and still expires `LeaseTTL` after its last renew, so `BeforeInstall` waits at most one TTL. An unknown database answers 409 `member serving: database %s is not served: table_missing`. A pass that only moves an owner's journal to a later snapshot with the same entry (a carried track) changes no copy, calls no `BeforeInstall` and does not revoke: the view's `snapshot_id` moves while the lease stays held and renewable; a host that acquires again uses the new `snapshot_id` (Task 46).
- **F45.5 — `BeforeInstall` and `AfterInstall` in the installer.** Task 32's `installGates.check` calls `BeforeInstall` at most once per database and pass, right before the first statement that changes a copy of it, in an owner's install pass (`applyOwner`) and in an audit of a copy (`auditCopy`, the equal-hash twin `DROP PART`). This task adds `installGates.done`, deferred where the gates are created, which calls `AfterInstall` once for every database whose `BeforeInstall` returned nil: after the owner's journal write (`return i.journalOwner(...)` runs before the deferred call), or once the pass failed. A failed pass after an `ATTACH` leaves unjournaled parts (`TableState.Diverged`), so the database answers `table_diverged` and is not served; a database whose `BeforeInstall` failed was never held and is not paired. Nothing waits when both seams are nil (P2). The audit's twin drops are held too, so a host never reads twins disappear under a lease.
- **F45.6 — `BeforeInstall` itself.** It returns at once without a lease; with one it waits for the release or the expiry and counts the wait in `lease_waits_total{outcome}`; on `ctx`'s error it clears installing again (no lease is outstanding then, since it was revoked), and serving may resume after two polls. A lease restored after a restart (F45.14) is a lease here: an install waits for it the same way.
- **F45.14 — Leases survive a restart (review round 1).** `serve.New` builds the lease tables empty, so a crashed and restarted si-member used to find no lease and install at once while its host, a separate process, still answered the database Replica from its old snapshot until its next successful poll or its lease deadline (the member's endpoint is down while it restarts). Every lease is therefore recorded in `serve.LeaseFile` (`serve-leases.json`) in `Deps.StateDir` (the member's state directory, a persistent volume; `member.newServing` passes `Config.StateDir`) before a grant or a renew is answered: id, database, owner, last renew in unix nanoseconds and the TTL it was granted with, written atomically as the install journal is (temp file, `Sync`, rename, directory `Sync`), under `mu`. A grant or renew that cannot be recorded is refused with 500 `serve: record leases in <path>: <error>` and changes nothing (the host's renew then fails, so it serves only until its deadline, which the recorded expiry covers); a release that cannot be recorded leaves the lease in the file until it expires, which only makes a restart wait longer. `New` restores every recorded lease that has not expired, revoked: its renew answers 409, the host drops it at its next poll (the view does not serve the database for two polls) and releases it once its reads drained, and an install waits for that release or the expiry exactly as before the restart. An unreadable record fails `New` (`serve: lease file <path>: <error>`, a version other than 1, or a record without an id, a database or a TTL), since the member cannot tell which leases its host still holds. `Deps.StateDir` is required (`serve: Deps.StateDir is required: the server records its leases there before it grants or renews one`). Tests: `TestARestartedMemberWaitsForTheLeasesItsPreviousProcessGranted` (a host that releases, a host that stays silent, and a lease past its expiry not restored), `TestLeasesAreRecordedBeforeTheyAreGrantedOrRenewed` (the record, a blocked file refusing grant and renew with 500, unreadable files refused by `New`).
- **F45.7 — `ConditionExcluded` in P3.** S3-C2's journal has no exclusion; `servedCopies` marks a table excluded when its journal (`TableState.SnapshotID`, `Entry`) is not at its owner's journal entry, that is a ready copy not installed yet, which is the P5 meaning of a checkpoint's `excluded` (spec §9.1; Plan S3-E1's `ExclusionNotInstalled`). Foreign takes precedence over Diverged. `AuditClean` is the installer's (the startup and restart audits and the self-audit). Since S3-C2's review fix 245-1, a ready copy that no audit covered since the start or the last ClickHouse restart (one the copyset made ready after that audit) is `TableState.Diverged` and keeps `Stats.AuditClean` false until `Apply` audits it, so the view reports `audit_unclean` (the table `diverged`) until then; nothing here changes for it. An owner without a journal entry has no copy (`table_missing`).
- **F45.8 — `publishedFeed` has its own two-entry `manifestfeed.Store`.** Each poll reads `GetSafeWatermark` from the arbiter and the manifest through the store, which fetches by snapshot id and keeps only manifests `manifestfeed.Verify` accepted (requested id, its own root, the partition ledger); it then requires the watermark's `ManifestRoot` and `track_frontiers` (K37). A separate store keeps the role's feed untouched.
- **F45.9 — `Deps.NodeID`.** §30.3's view has `node_id`, but §30.2's `Config` and `Deps` carry no node id; `Deps.NodeID` is added, filled by `newServing` from `member.Config.NodeID`.
- **F45.10 — Renew's 404.** Contract §31.5 says the host counts a lease `expired` "when the member answered 404", but §30.3 answers release with 200 for an unknown id; the 404 is renew's (`member serving: unknown lease %s`). `Client.Renew` wraps `ErrLeaseRevoked` for the 409 and for the 404, each with the member's text, so the host stops serving on either; contract §30.4 has no error that tells them apart and this task adds none. Task 46 tells an expired lease from a revoked one by the serving view instead: a lease has expired on the member exactly when the view of its database no longer lists it (its Appendix B, "`expired` without a 404"). `Release` never fails for an unknown id.
- **F45.11 — The token and the Prometheus dependency.** The handler compares SHA-256 sums of the presented and the configured token with `subtle.ConstantTimeCompare`, so neither the content nor the length leaks; only `Authorization: Bearer <token>` is accepted, and 401 comes before routing. `Config.String`, `GoString` and `LogValue` print `<redacted>`; no client error carries a token. arbiter-core had no Prometheus import; `github.com/prometheus/client_golang` becomes a direct requirement at the version the housegate pin already selects (`v1.23.2` at housegate `v0.20.0`), so no module of the build list changes version (Step 4 checks it); its `prometheus` package is the only new Bazel repository (`com_github_prometheus_client_golang`).
- **F45.12 — Files and tests.** The role's serving side lives in a new `member/serving.go`, not in Task 34's `role.go` and `config.go` (which the header's File Structure names as its home), so the hunks on S3-C2's files are one import and one field in `config.go` and seven small edits in `role.go` (Step 23's script). `TestRoleWiresServeIntoTheInstaller` proves them by behaviour (the seams reach the server) and by parsing the package's sources, as Task 34's `TestRoleCallsOnlyReadRPCs` does: every `install.Deps` literal outside `serving.go` sets `BeforeInstall` and `AfterInstall` to the two results of `r.installHooks()` in its function, and the package calls `attachServing` and uses `runServing`. `TestInstallerWithoutAGateIsUnchanged` and `TestInstallerHoldsEachChangedDatabaseUntilItsJournalWrite` are ClickHouse-gated like every Task 32 `Apply` test, because only a real pass shows the statement order; they run in `integration-clickhouse` with `//member/install:install_test` (Task 32 Step 16).
- **F45.13 — The ClickHouse test.** `TestServeHoldsInstallsOfAServedDatabase` runs the lease protocol against a real ClickHouse and a real HTTP listener: a host holds the lease of a served copy (made by `ddl.EnsureCopy`) and reads it; the next entry's install, the installer's statement `ALTER TABLE <copy> ATTACH PARTITION … FROM <scratch>` (scratch from `ddl.ScratchIntent`), waits through ten reads that keep the published row count, runs after the release, and serving resumes at the new snapshot. It uses unique databases (`serve_replica_<hex>`, `serve_rstage_<hex>`), not `hg_replica` / `hg_rstage`, because CI runs every ClickHouse target against one server in parallel, and it drives `BeforeInstall` / `AfterInstall` directly; the installer's side of the pairing is `TestInstallerHoldsEachChangedDatabaseUntilItsJournalWrite`.
- **Residual (Follow-ups, unchanged):** K44's residual (queries already running past the host's local deadline) is the host's (Task 46).

```go
type fakeRegistry struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot
	on   bool
}

func (r *fakeRegistry) View() (wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, bool) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.snap, r.on
}
func (r *fakeRegistry) Changed() <-chan struct{} { return make(chan struct{}) }
func (r *fakeRegistry) Ready() <-chan struct{} {
	c := make(chan struct{})
	close(c)
	return c
}
func (r *fakeRegistry) set(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.snap, r.on = snap, true
}

type fakePublished struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	m     replay.SafeSnapshotManifest
	err   error
	reads int
}

func (p *fakePublished) Latest(context.Context) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.reads++
	return p.m, p.err
}
func (p *fakePublished) readCount() int {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return p.reads
}
func (p *fakePublished) set(m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, err error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.m, p.err = m, err
}

type fakeCopies struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	copies map[OwnerDatabase]DatabaseCopy
}

func (c *fakeCopies) Databases() []OwnerDatabase {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	var out []OwnerDatabase
	for key := range c.copies {
		out = append(out, key)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b OwnerDatabase) int { return strings.Compare(a.Database, b.Database) })
	return out
}
func (c *fakeCopies) Database(owner uint64, database string) (DatabaseCopy, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	d, ok := c.copies[OwnerDatabase{Owner: owner, Database: database}]
	return d, ok
}
func (c *fakeCopies) set(owner uint64, database string, d DatabaseCopy) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.copies[OwnerDatabase{Owner: owner, Database: database}] = d
}

// fakeDialer answers every probe with err (nil: a connection that closes).
type fakeDialer struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	err   error
	dials int
}

func (d *fakeDialer) Dial(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error) {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	d.dials++
	if d.err != nil {
		return nil, d.err
	}
	client, server := net.Pipe()
	_ = server.Close()
	return client, nil
}
func (d *fakeDialer) count() int {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	return d.dials
}
func (d *fakeDialer) set(err error) {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	d.err = err
}

var errRefused = errors.New("dial tcp 10.0.0.1:32001: connect: connection refused")

// harness runs one Server against the fakes. Inside a synctest bubble its
// clock is the bubble's.
type harness struct {
	t       *testing.T
	srv     *Server
	reg     *fakeRegistry
	pub     *fakePublished
	copies  *fakeCopies
	dialer  *fakeDialer
	metrics *Metrics
	// stateDir is the member's state directory, where the server records
	// its leases; restart builds the next server on the same one.
	stateDir string
	// stop ends the current server's Run.
	stop context.CancelFunc
}

// testConfig is serving on, the test token, polls every second.
func testConfig() Config {
	return Config{Enabled: true, Token: testToken, PollInterval: time.Second}
}

// newHarness builds the test world (owner 0 quarantined, entry40 published
// and copied), applies setup and starts Run with t.Context: its first poll
// runs at once, the next ones every PollInterval.
func newHarness(t *testing.T, cfg Config, setup ...func(*harness)) *harness {
	t.Helper()
	h := &harness{
		t: t, reg: &fakeRegistry{}, pub: &fakePublished{}, dialer: &fakeDialer{},
		copies: &fakeCopies{copies: map[OwnerDatabase]DatabaseCopy{}}, metrics: NewMetrics(),
		stateDir: t.TempDir(),
	}
	h.reg.set(registrySnapshot(testOwner))
	h.pub.set(manifestAt("0xs40", entry40), nil)
	h.copies.set(testOwner, testDatabase, copyAt("0xs40", entry40))
	for _, f := range setup {
		f(h)
	}
	h.start(cfg)
	return h
}

// start builds a server on the harness's ports and state directory and runs
// it until restart or the end of the test.
func (h *harness) start(cfg Config) {
	h.t.Helper()
	srv, err := New(cfg, Deps{
		Registry: h.reg, Published: h.pub, Copies: h.copies, Dial: h.dialer.Dial,
		Metrics: h.metrics, Logger: slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler), NodeID: "member-b",
		StateDir: h.stateDir,
	})
	if err != nil {
		h.t.Fatalf("New: %v", err)
	}
	ctx, stop := context.WithCancel(h.t.Context())
	h.srv, h.stop = srv, stop
	go func() { _ = srv.Run(ctx) }()
	synctest.Wait()
}

// restart stops the server as a crash would, losing everything it held in
// memory, and starts a new one on the same state directory: the si-member
// process restarting while its host keeps its lease.
func (h *harness) restart(cfg Config) {
	h.t.Helper()
	h.stop()
	synctest.Wait()
	h.metrics = NewMetrics()
	h.start(cfg)
}

// advance moves the bubble's clock by d and lets every goroutine settle.
func advance(d time.Duration) {
	time.Sleep(d)
	synctest.Wait()
}

// database is dex's entry of the serving view.
func (h *harness) database() DatabaseView {
	h.t.Helper()
	for _, d := range h.srv.Serving().Databases {
		if d.Database == testDatabase && d.Owner == testOwner {
			return d
		}
	}
	h.t.Fatalf("the serving view has no database %s of owner %d: %+v", testDatabase, testOwner, h.srv.Serving())
	return DatabaseView{}
}

func (h *harness) requireServing() {
	h.t.Helper()
	if d := h.database(); !d.Serving || d.Reason != "" {
		h.t.Fatalf("dex: serving %t reason %q, want serving", d.Serving, d.Reason)
	}
}

func (h *harness) requireReason(want Reason) {
	h.t.Helper()
	if d := h.database(); d.Serving || d.Reason != want {
		h.t.Fatalf("dex: serving %t reason %q, want not serving with %q", d.Serving, d.Reason, want)
	}
}

// call sends one request to the handler, with the test token unless
// token is set, and returns the status and the decoded JSON body.
func (h *harness) call(method, path, body string, token ...string) (int, map[string]any) {
	h.t.Helper()
	tok := testToken
	if len(token) > 0 {
		tok = token[0]
	}
	var rd io.Reader
	if body != "" {
		rd = strings.NewReader(body)
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, rd)
	if tok != "" {
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+tok)
	}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.srv.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	var out map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(rec.Body.Bytes()), &out); err != nil {
		h.t.Fatalf("%s %s answered %d with a body that is not a JSON object: %q", method, path, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}
	if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); ct != "application/json" {
		h.t.Fatalf("%s %s: Content-Type %q", method, path, ct)
	}
	return rec.Code, out
}

// acquire takes a lease of dex at snapshotID and returns its id.
func (h *harness) acquire(snapshotID string) string {
	h.t.Helper()
	status, out := h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"`+snapshotID+`"}`)
	if status != http.StatusOK {
		h.t.Fatalf("acquire: %d %v", status, out)
	}
	id, _ := out["lease_id"].(string)
	if len(id) != 32 || strings.Trim(id, "0123456789abcdef") != "" {
		h.t.Fatalf("lease id %q is not 128 bits of lowercase hex", id)
	}
	if ttl, _ := out["ttl_ms"].(float64); ttl != float64(h.srv.cfg.LeaseTTL.Milliseconds()) {
		h.t.Fatalf("ttl_ms %v, want %d", out["ttl_ms"], h.srv.cfg.LeaseTTL.Milliseconds())
	}
	return id
}

func (h *harness) renew(id string) (int, map[string]any) {
	h.t.Helper()
	return h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/renew", `{"lease_id":"`+id+`"}`)
}

func (h *harness) release(id string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	if status, out := h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/release", `{"lease_id":"`+id+`"}`); status != http.StatusOK || len(out) != 0 {
		h.t.Fatalf("release: %d %v, want 200 {}", status, out)
	}
}

// requireError checks a refusal's status and exact error text.
func requireError(t *testing.T, status int, out map[string]any, wantStatus int, wantText string) {
	t.Helper()
	if status != wantStatus || out["error"] != wantText || len(out) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("answered %d %v, want %d {\"error\": %q}", status, out, wantStatus, wantText)
	}
}

// metricValues gathers m into "name{label=value}" (or "name") -> value.
func metricValues(t *testing.T, m *Metrics) map[string]float64 {
	t.Helper()
	reg := prometheus.NewPedanticRegistry()
	if err := m.Register(reg); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Register: %v", err)
	}
	families, err := reg.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Gather: %v", err)
	}
	out := map[string]float64{}
	for _, mf := range families {
		for _, metric := range mf.GetMetric() {
			key := mf.GetName()
			for _, l := range metric.GetLabel() {
				key += "{" + l.GetName() + "=" + l.GetValue() + "}"
			}
			out[key] = metric.GetGauge().GetValue() + metric.GetCounter().GetValue()
		}
	}
	return out
}

// requireMetrics checks the listed series' values.
func requireMetrics(t *testing.T, m *Metrics, want map[string]float64) {
	t.Helper()
	got := metricValues(t, m)
	for key, v := range want {
		if g, ok := got[key]; !ok || g != v {
			t.Errorf("%s = %v (present %t), want %v", key, g, ok, v)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package serve

import (
	"net/http"
	"reflect"

// TestServingRequiresTheEntryUnchangedOverTwoPolls: a database serves only
// once two consecutive polls read the same owner entry (spec §11).
func TestServingRequiresTheEntryUnchangedOverTwoPolls(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		start := time.Now()
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		// Poll 1 (at start) is the first to read entry40.
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		if d := h.database(); d.FrozenSinceUnixMs != start.UnixMilli() || len(d.Tables) != 0 || d.Lease != nil {
			t.Fatalf("after poll 1: %+v", d)
		}
		// The entry moves before poll 2, and the copy follows it.
		h.pub.set(manifestAt("0xs41", entry41), nil)
		h.copies.set(testOwner, testDatabase, copyAt("0xs41", entry41))
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		if d := h.database(); d.FrozenSinceUnixMs != start.Add(time.Second).UnixMilli() {
			t.Fatalf("frozen_since_unix_ms %d, want poll 2's %d", d.FrozenSinceUnixMs, start.Add(time.Second).UnixMilli())
		}
		// Poll 3 reads entry41 a second time.
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		want := DatabaseView{
			Database: "dex", Owner: 0, Serving: true, SnapshotID: "0xs41", Entry: entry41,
			FrozenSinceUnixMs: start.Add(time.Second).UnixMilli(), OwnerQuarantined: true,
			Tables: []ServedTable{
				{TableID: "dex.pools", IncarnationSeq: 8, CopyTable: "dex__pools__i8", SchemaHash: "0xpools"},
				{TableID: "dex.swaps", IncarnationSeq: 7, CopyTable: "dex__swaps__i7", SchemaHash: "0xswaps"},
			},
		}
		if got := h.srv.Serving(); got.NodeID != "member-b" || len(got.Databases) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Databases[0], want) {
			t.Fatalf("serving view %+v, want node member-b and %+v", got, want)
		}
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_databases{state=serving}":     1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_databases{state=not_serving}": 0,
		})
	})
}

// TestServingStopsWhenTheOwnerEntryAdvances: a late acknowledgement that
// advances a quarantined owner's entry stops serving and revokes the lease;
// the install runs after the release, and serving resumes only after two
// polls at the new entry.
func TestServingStopsWhenTheOwnerEntryAdvances(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		first := h.acquire("0xs40")

		// A late acknowledgement advances the quarantined owner's entry.
		h.pub.set(manifestAt("0xs41", entry41), nil)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || l.LeaseID != first || l.State != "revoking" {
			t.Fatalf("lease %+v, want %s revoking", l, first)
		}
		status, out := h.renew(first)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+first+" is revoked")
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonCopyBehind)

		// The install waits for the release, then the copy reaches entry41.
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { done <- h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase) }()
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case err := <-done:
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %v while the revoked lease is still held", err)
		default:
		}
		h.release(first)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err := <-done; err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall: %v", err)
		}
		h.copies.set(testOwner, testDatabase, copyAt("0xs41", entry41))
		h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)

		// Serving resumes only after two polls at entry41 since the install.
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database dex moved to snapshot 0xs41; acquire again")
		if second := h.acquire("0xs41"); second == first {
			t.Fatalf("the new lease reuses the id %s", first)
		}
	})
}

// TestServingNeverStartsWithACopyBehindTheEntry: a copy behind the published
// entry never serves, however long the entry is stable.
func TestServingNeverStartsWithACopyBehindTheEntry(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig(), func(h *harness) {
			h.pub.set(manifestAt("0xs41", entry41), nil)
		})
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		for range 20 {
			advance(time.Second)
			h.requireReason(ReasonCopyBehind)
		}
		status, out := h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database dex is not served: copy_behind")
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_databases{state=not_serving}":    1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_not_serving{reason=copy_behind}": 1,
		})
	})
}

// TestServingRefusesAForeignDivergedExcludedOrMissingTable: a Foreign,
// Diverged, excluded or missing Active table, or one that disagrees with the
// registry, serves nothing of the database.
func TestServingRefusesAForeignDivergedExcludedOrMissingTable(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(c *DatabaseCopy, reg *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, on *bool)
		want   Reason
	}{
		{"foreign", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			c.Tables[1].Condition = ConditionForeign
		}, ReasonTableForeign},
		{"diverged", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			c.Tables[0].Condition = ConditionDiverged
		}, ReasonTableDiverged},
		{"excluded", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			c.Tables[0].Condition = ConditionExcluded
		}, ReasonTableExcluded},
		{"foreign before diverged", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			c.Tables[0].Condition, c.Tables[1].Condition = ConditionDiverged, ConditionForeign
		}, ReasonTableForeign},
		{"a registry table the copy lacks", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) { c.Tables = c.Tables[1:] }, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"another incarnation", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			c.Tables[1].IncarnationSeq, c.Tables[1].CopyTable = 6, "dex__swaps__i6"
		}, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"another schema hash", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) { c.Tables[1].SchemaHash = "0xold" }, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"a copy name that is not sitable.CopyTable", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) { c.Tables[1].CopyTable = "dex__swaps" }, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"a table of another owner", func(_ *DatabaseCopy, reg *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			reg.Incarnations[1].OwnerIndexerID = ownerID(1)
		}, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"no table", func(c *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) { c.Tables = nil }, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"no Active incarnation", func(_ *DatabaseCopy, reg *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, _ *bool) {
			reg.Incarnations[0].Status, reg.Incarnations[1].Status = wire.TableStatusRetiring, wire.TableStatusRetiring
		}, ReasonTableMissing},
		{"a disabled registry", func(_ *DatabaseCopy, _ *wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, on *bool) { *on = false }, ReasonOwnerAvailable},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				h := newHarness(t, testConfig(), func(h *harness) {
					c := copyAt("0xs40", entry40)
					reg := registrySnapshot(testOwner)
					on := true
					tc.mutate(&c, &reg, &on)
					h.copies.set(testOwner, testDatabase, c)
					h.reg.mu.Lock()
					h.reg.snap, h.reg.on = reg, on
					h.reg.mu.Unlock()
				})
				for range 3 {
					advance(time.Second)
					h.requireReason(tc.want)
				}
				status, out := h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
				requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database dex is not served: "+string(tc.want))
			})
		})
	}
}

// not Active (a Pending table never added, a Retiring one, an older seq of an

			)

				TableCopy{TableID: "dex.quotes", IncarnationSeq: 11, CopyTable: "dex__quotes__i11", SchemaHash: "0xquotes", Condition: ConditionForeign},
				TableCopy{TableID: "dex.swaps", IncarnationSeq: 5, CopyTable: "dex__swaps__i5", SchemaHash: "0xswaps0", Condition: ConditionDiverged},

func TestServingIsOffWhenDisabled(t *testing.T) {

// TestServingRequiresTheOwnerQuarantinedOrUnreachable: an available owner's
// database is never served; the quarantine starts and ends serving.
func TestServingRequiresTheOwnerQuarantinedOrUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("quarantine", func(t *testing.T) {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newHarness(t, testConfig(), func(h *harness) { h.reg.set(registrySnapshot()) })
			for range 3 {
				advance(time.Second)
				h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
			}
			// The entry has been stable for three polls: serving starts at the
			// first poll that sees the quarantine.
			h.reg.set(registrySnapshot(testOwner))
			advance(time.Second)
			h.requireServing()
			if d := h.database(); !d.OwnerQuarantined || d.OwnerUnreachable {
				t.Fatalf("owner flags %+v", d)
			}
			id := h.acquire("0xs40")
			// The release of the quarantine revokes the lease at the next poll.
			h.reg.set(registrySnapshot())
			advance(time.Second)
			h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
			status, out := h.renew(id)
			requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+id+" is revoked")
		})
	})
	t.Run("a reachable owner", func(t *testing.T) {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := testConfig()
			cfg.OwnerHouseGate = map[uint64]string{testOwner: "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a:32001"}
			h := newHarness(t, cfg, func(h *harness) { h.reg.set(registrySnapshot()) })
			for range 120 {
				advance(time.Second)
				h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
			}
			if n := h.dialer.count(); n < 24 {
				t.Fatalf("%d probes in 120s, want one every 5s", n)
			}
		})
	})
}

// TestServeStartsAfterTheOwnerIsUnreachableForTUnreach: an owner whose every
// probe failed for t_unreach triggers serving; one successful probe restarts
// the count.
func TestServeStartsAfterTheOwnerIsUnreachableForTUnreach(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		cfg := testConfig()
		cfg.OwnerUnreachableAfter = MinOwnerUnreachableAfter
		cfg.OwnerProbeInterval = time.Second
		cfg.OwnerHouseGate = map[uint64]string{testOwner: "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a:32001"}
		h := newHarness(t, cfg, func(h *harness) {
			h.reg.set(registrySnapshot())
			h.dialer.set(errRefused)
		})
		// Probes and polls run on whole seconds; observe between them.
		advance(500 * time.Millisecond)
		// Every probe fails from t=0; t_unreach is 15s.
		for range 14 {
			advance(time.Second)
			h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
		}
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{"sentio_node_si_member_serve_owner_unreachable{owner=0}": 0})
		advance(time.Second) // t=15.5
		h.requireServing()
		if d := h.database(); d.OwnerQuarantined || !d.OwnerUnreachable {
			t.Fatalf("owner flags %+v", d)
		}
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{"sentio_node_si_member_serve_owner_unreachable{owner=0}": 1})

		// One successful probe ends the streak: t_unreach counts again from
		// the next failure.
		// (The poll at 16 may run before or after the probe at 16, so the
		// first observation is at 17.5.)
		h.dialer.set(nil)
		advance(2 * time.Second) // t=17.5
		h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
		h.dialer.set(errRefused)
		// The streak starts with the probe at 18: unreachable from 33.
		for range 15 {
			advance(time.Second)
			h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
		}
		advance(time.Second) // t=33.5
		h.requireServing()
	})
}
```

```go
package serve

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"
)

// TestAcquireRefusesAStaleSnapshot: a host acquires a served database only at
// the snapshot the view names; other databases and bad bodies are refused.
func TestAcquireRefusesAStaleSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		status, out := h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs39"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database dex moved to snapshot 0xs40; acquire again")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"nft","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database nft is not served: table_missing")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusBadRequest, "member serving: acquire needs a database and a snapshot_id")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40","owner":0}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusBadRequest, `member serving: json: unknown field "owner"`)
		if d := h.database(); d.Lease != nil {
			t.Fatalf("a refused acquire left lease %+v", d.Lease)
		}
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || *l != (LeaseView{LeaseID: id, State: "held", RemainingMs: 30000}) {
			t.Fatalf("lease view %+v", l)
		}
	})
}

// TestRenewAfterRevokeIsRefused: a database that stops serving revokes its
// lease; renew then answers 409, and the lease still expires LeaseTTL after
// its last renew (404 from then on).
func TestRenewAfterRevokeIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		advance(10 * time.Second)
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		if status != http.StatusOK || out["ttl_ms"] != float64(30000) || len(out) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("renew: %d %v", status, out)
		}
		renewed := time.Now()
		// The owner leaves quarantine: the next poll revokes the lease.
		h.reg.set(registrySnapshot())
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonOwnerAvailable)
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || l.State != "revoking" || l.RemainingMs != 29000 {
			t.Fatalf("lease view %+v, want revoking with 29000ms left", l)
		}
		status, out = h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+id+" is revoked")
		// A revoked lease still expires LeaseTTL after its last renew.
		advance(renewed.Add(DefaultLeaseTTL).Sub(time.Now()))
		status, out = h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusNotFound, "member serving: unknown lease "+id)
		if l := h.database().Lease; l != nil {
			t.Fatalf("an expired lease is still listed: %+v", l)
		}
	})
}

// TestReleaseIsIdempotent: release answers 200 for a held, a released and an
// unknown lease.
func TestReleaseIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		h.release(id)
		h.release(id)
		h.release("00000000000000000000000000000000")
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusNotFound, "member serving: unknown lease "+id)
		h.requireServing()
		if l := h.database().Lease; l != nil {
			t.Fatalf("a released lease is still listed: %+v", l)
		}
		if again := h.acquire("0xs40"); again == id {
			t.Fatalf("a new lease reuses the released id %s", id)
		}
	})
}

// TestBeforeInstallRevokesAndWaitsForTheRelease: BeforeInstall stops serving,
// revokes the lease and returns only once the host releases it (K44).
func TestBeforeInstallRevokesAndWaitsForTheRelease(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		done := make(chan error, 1)
		go func() { done <- h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase) }()
		synctest.Wait()
		h.requireReason(ReasonInstalling)
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || l.LeaseID != id || l.State != "revoking" {
			t.Fatalf("lease view %+v, want %s revoking", l, id)
		}
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+id+" is revoked")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: database dex is not served: installing")
		advance(5 * time.Second)
		select {
		case err := <-done:
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %v while the lease is held", err)
		default:
		}
		h.requireReason(ReasonInstalling)
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_databases{state=revoking}":           1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_not_serving{reason=installing}":      1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_revoking_seconds":                    5,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=released}": 0,
		})
		h.release(id)
		synctest.Wait()
		if err := <-done; err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall: %v", err)
		}
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=released}": 1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=expired}":  0,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_revoking_seconds":                    0,
		})
		// Installing holds until AfterInstall, then two polls confirm the entry.
		advance(3 * time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonInstalling)
		h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
	})
}

// TestBeforeInstallWaitsForExpiryWhenTheHostIsSilent: a host that neither
// renews nor releases holds an install for exactly one LeaseTTL after its
// last renew.
func TestBeforeInstallWaitsForExpiryWhenTheHostIsSilent(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		advance(4 * time.Second)
		if status, _ := h.renew(id); status != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("renew: %d", status)
		}
		renewed := time.Now()
		done := make(chan time.Time, 1)
		go func() {
			if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("BeforeInstall: %v", err)
			}
			done <- time.Now()
		}()
		// The host neither renews nor releases.
		advance(DefaultLeaseTTL - 500*time.Millisecond)
		select {
		case at := <-done:
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned at %s, before the lease expired", at.Sub(renewed))
		default:
		}
		advance(time.Second)
		select {
		case at := <-done:
			if at.Sub(renewed) != DefaultLeaseTTL {
				t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %s after the last renew, want exactly the lease ttl %s", at.Sub(renewed), DefaultLeaseTTL)
			}
		default:
			t.Fatal("BeforeInstall still waits after the lease expired")
		}
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusNotFound, "member serving: unknown lease "+id)
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=expired}":  1,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=released}": 0,
		})
		h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
	})
}

// TestBeforeInstallReturnsAtOnceWithoutALease: without a lease BeforeInstall
// only marks the database installing.
func TestBeforeInstallReturnsAtOnceWithoutALease(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		before := time.Now()
		if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase); err != nil || time.Since(before) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall: %v after %s", err, time.Since(before))
		}
		h.requireReason(ReasonInstalling)
		// A database the member does not list yet (a first install) too.
		if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), 1, "nft"); err != nil || time.Since(before) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall of a new database: %v after %s", err, time.Since(before))
		}
		h.srv.AfterInstall(1, "nft")
		h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=released}": 0,
			"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=expired}":  0,
		})
	})
}

// TestBeforeInstallGivesUpWithItsContext: a cancelled install clears
// installing again; the revoked lease stays revoked.
func TestBeforeInstallGivesUpWithItsContext(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		// The deadline falls between two polls (t=3.5).
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 2500*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
		if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(ctx, testOwner, testDatabase); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall: %v, want the context's deadline", err)
		}
		// Installing is cleared, so the database serves again after two
		// polls; the revoked lease stays revoked and a new acquire replaces it.
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
		advance(time.Second)
		h.requireServing()
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+id+" is revoked")
		next := h.acquire("0xs40")
		status, out = h.renew(id)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusNotFound, "member serving: unknown lease "+id)
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || l.LeaseID != next || l.State != "held" {
			t.Fatalf("lease view %+v, want %s held", l, next)
		}
	})
}

// TestARestartedMemberWaitsForTheLeasesItsPreviousProcessGranted is
// clarification K44 across a restart of the si-member: its host keeps the
// lease the previous process granted and may still answer the database
// Replica. The new process reads the lease back from its state directory,
// revoked, so an install of the database (the startup audit's included)
// waits for the host's release or the lease's expiry instead of returning at
// once, and a renew of the restored lease answers 409.
func TestARestartedMemberWaitsForTheLeasesItsPreviousProcessGranted(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("the host releases", func(t *testing.T) {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
			advance(time.Second)
			id := h.acquire("0xs40")
			advance(2 * time.Second)
			h.restart(testConfig())
			h.requireReason(ReasonEntryUnconfirmed)
			if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || *l != (LeaseView{LeaseID: id, State: "revoking", RemainingMs: 28000}) {
				t.Fatalf("lease view after the restart %+v, want %s revoking with 28000ms left", l, id)
			}
			status, out := h.renew(id)
			requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusConflict, "member serving: lease "+id+" is revoked")
			done := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { done <- h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase) }()
			advance(5 * time.Second)
			select {
			case err := <-done:
				t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %v after the restart while the host holds the lease", err)
			default:
			}
			h.release(id)
			synctest.Wait()
			if err := <-done; err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall: %v", err)
			}
			requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
				"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=released}": 1,
				"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=expired}":  0,
			})
			h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
		})
	})
	t.Run("the host is silent", func(t *testing.T) {
		synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
			advance(time.Second)
			id := h.acquire("0xs40")
			advance(4 * time.Second)
			if status, _ := h.renew(id); status != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("renew: %d", status)
			}
			renewed := time.Now()
			advance(3 * time.Second)
			h.restart(testConfig())
			done := make(chan time.Time, 1)
			go func() {
				if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase); err != nil {
					t.Errorf("BeforeInstall: %v", err)
				}
				done <- time.Now()
			}()
			advance(renewed.Add(DefaultLeaseTTL).Sub(time.Now()) - 500*time.Millisecond)
			select {
			case at := <-done:
				t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %s after the last renew, before the restored lease expired", at.Sub(renewed))
			default:
			}
			advance(time.Second)
			select {
			case at := <-done:
				if at.Sub(renewed) != DefaultLeaseTTL {
					t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall returned %s after the last renew, want exactly the lease ttl %s", at.Sub(renewed), DefaultLeaseTTL)
				}
			default:
				t.Fatal("BeforeInstall still waits after the restored lease expired")
			}
			requireMetrics(t, h.metrics, map[string]float64{
				"sentio_node_si_member_serve_lease_waits_total{outcome=expired}": 1,
			})
			h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
			// A lease past its expiry is not restored again.
			h.restart(testConfig())
			before := time.Now()
			if err := h.srv.BeforeInstall(t.Context(), testOwner, testDatabase); err != nil || time.Since(before) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("BeforeInstall after the lease expired: %v after %s", err, time.Since(before))
			}
			h.srv.AfterInstall(testOwner, testDatabase)
		})
	})
}

// TestLeasesAreRecordedBeforeTheyAreGrantedOrRenewed: the server writes every
// lease to LeaseFile in its state directory before it answers a grant or a
// renew, and drops it there on release. A grant or a renew it cannot record
// is refused with 500 and changes nothing, and New refuses a lease file it
// cannot read, since it could not tell which leases a host still holds.
func TestLeasesAreRecordedBeforeTheyAreGrantedOrRenewed(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		path := filepath.Join(h.stateDir, LeaseFile)
		recorded := func() []leaseRecord {
			t.Helper()
			b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("read the lease file: %v", err)
			}
			var f leaseFileContent
			if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &f); err != nil || f.Version != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("lease file %s: %v", b, err)
			}
			return f.Leases
		}
		id := h.acquire("0xs40")
		if got := recorded(); len(got) != 1 || got[0] != (leaseRecord{LeaseID: id, Database: testDatabase, Owner: testOwner, RenewedUnixNano: time.Now().UnixNano(), TTLMs: 30000}) {
			t.Fatalf("recorded %+v, want the granted lease", got)
		}
		advance(10 * time.Second)
		if status, _ := h.renew(id); status != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("renew: %d", status)
		}
		if got := recorded(); len(got) != 1 || got[0].RenewedUnixNano != time.Now().UnixNano() {
			t.Fatalf("recorded %+v, want the renew's time", got)
		}

		// A lease file the server cannot replace refuses the renew and the
		// grant, and changes neither.
		if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(path, "blocked"), 0o700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cannotRecord := "serve: record leases in " + path + ": "
		advance(5 * time.Second)
		status, out := h.renew(id)
		if msg, _ := out["error"].(string); status != http.StatusInternalServerError || !strings.HasPrefix(msg, cannotRecord) {
			t.Fatalf("renew with an unwritable lease file: %d %v, want 500 %q...", status, out, cannotRecord)
		}
		if l := h.database().Lease; l == nil || l.RemainingMs != 25000 {
			t.Fatalf("lease view %+v, want the renew not applied (25000ms left)", l)
		}
		h.release(id)
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`)
		if msg, _ := out["error"].(string); status != http.StatusInternalServerError || !strings.HasPrefix(msg, cannotRecord) {
			t.Fatalf("acquire with an unwritable lease file: %d %v, want 500 %q...", status, out, cannotRecord)
		}
		if l := h.database().Lease; l != nil {
			t.Fatalf("a grant that was not recorded left lease %+v", l)
		}
		if err := os.RemoveAll(path); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		next := h.acquire("0xs40")
		if got := recorded(); len(got) != 1 || got[0].LeaseID != next {
			t.Fatalf("recorded %+v, want only %s", got, next)
		}
		h.release(next)
		if got := recorded(); len(got) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("recorded %+v after the release, want none", got)
		}

		// New refuses a lease file it cannot read.
		for content, want := range map[string]string{
			"{":                           "serve: lease file %s: unexpected EOF",
			`{"version":2,"leases":[]}`:   "serve: lease file %s has version 2, want 1",
			`{"version":1,"leases":[{}]}`: "serve: lease file %s has a lease record without an id, a database or a ttl",
		} {
			dir := t.TempDir()
			bad := filepath.Join(dir, LeaseFile)
			if err := os.WriteFile(bad, []byte(content), 0o600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_, err := New(testConfig(), Deps{Registry: h.reg, Published: h.pub, Copies: h.copies, StateDir: dir})
			if err == nil || err.Error() != strings.ReplaceAll(want, "%s", bad) {
				t.Fatalf("New with lease file %q: %v, want %s", content, err, strings.ReplaceAll(want, "%s", bad))
			}
		}
	})
}
```

```go
package serve

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"
)

// TestHandlerRefusesAMissingOrWrongToken: every route answers 401 without the
// exact bearer token, before routing; with it, the methods, routes and bodies
// are checked.
func TestHandlerRefusesAMissingOrWrongToken(t *testing.T) {
	synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
		h := newHarness(t, testConfig())
		advance(time.Second)
		routes := []struct{ method, path, body string }{
			{http.MethodGet, "/v1/serving", ""},
			{http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/acquire", `{"database":"dex","snapshot_id":"0xs40"}`},
			{http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/renew", `{"lease_id":"00000000000000000000000000000000"}`},
			{http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/release", `{"lease_id":"00000000000000000000000000000000"}`},
			{http.MethodGet, "/v1/other", ""},
		}
		headers := []string{"", "Bearer ", "Bearer wrong-token", "Bearer " + testToken + "x", "Basic " + testToken, "bearer " + testToken, testToken}
		for _, r := range routes {
			for _, header := range headers {
				req := httptest.NewRequest(r.method, r.path, strings.NewReader(r.body))
				if header != "" {
					req.Header.Set("Authorization", header)
				}
				rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
				h.srv.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, req)
				if rec.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized || strings.TrimSpace(rec.Body.String()) != `{"error":"member serving: missing or wrong bearer token"}` {
					t.Errorf("%s %s with Authorization %q: %d %s", r.method, r.path, header, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
				}
			}
		}
		if d := h.database(); d.Lease != nil {
			t.Fatalf("an unauthenticated acquire granted %+v", d.Lease)
		}

		// With the token: the routes, methods and bodies.
		status, out := h.call(http.MethodGet, "/v1/serving", "")
		if status != http.StatusOK || out["node_id"] != "member-b" {
			t.Fatalf("GET /v1/serving: %d %v", status, out)
		}
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving", "")
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "member serving: POST /v1/serving is not allowed; use GET")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodGet, "/v1/serving/acquire", "")
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "member serving: GET /v1/serving/acquire is not allowed; use POST")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodGet, "/v1/other", "")
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusNotFound, "member serving: no route /v1/other")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/renew", `{`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusBadRequest, "member serving: unexpected EOF")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/renew", `{"lease_id":"a"} {"lease_id":"b"}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusBadRequest, "member serving: the body holds more than one JSON value")
		status, out = h.call(http.MethodPost, "/v1/serving/release", `{}`)
		requireError(t, status, out, http.StatusBadRequest, "member serving: lease_id is required")
	})
}
```

```go
package serve

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// TestNewRefusesABadConfig: New refuses each bad value with contract §30.2's
// text, and fills the defaults.
func TestNewRefusesABadConfig(t *testing.T) {
	deps := Deps{Registry: &fakeRegistry{}, Published: &fakePublished{}, Copies: &fakeCopies{}, StateDir: t.TempDir()}
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  Config
		deps *Deps
		want string
	}{
		{"no token", Config{Enabled: true}, nil, "serve: a bearer token is required"},
		{"t_unreach below the minimum", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerUnreachableAfter: 14 * time.Second}, nil, "serve: owner unreachable threshold 14s is below the minimum 15s"},
		{"a negative t_unreach", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerUnreachableAfter: -time.Second}, nil, "serve: owner unreachable threshold -1s is below the minimum 15s"},
		{"lease ttl below the minimum", Config{Token: testToken, LeaseTTL: 9 * time.Second}, nil, "serve: lease ttl 9s is below the minimum 10s"},
		{"a probe interval below 1s", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerProbeInterval: 500 * time.Millisecond}, nil, "serve: owner probe interval 500ms must be at least 1s and below the unreachable threshold 1m0s"},
		{"a probe interval at t_unreach", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerProbeInterval: time.Minute}, nil, "serve: owner probe interval 1m0s must be at least 1s and below the unreachable threshold 1m0s"},
		{"an address without a port", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerHouseGate: map[uint64]string{1: "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b"}}, nil, `serve: owner 1 housegate address "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b" is not host:port`},
		{"an address without a host", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerHouseGate: map[uint64]string{0: "a:32001", 2: ":34001"}}, nil, `serve: owner 2 housegate address ":34001" is not host:port`},
		{"port 0", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerHouseGate: map[uint64]string{3: "c:0"}}, nil, `serve: owner 3 housegate address "c:0" is not host:port`},
		{"a named port", Config{Token: testToken, OwnerHouseGate: map[uint64]string{4: "c:http"}}, nil, `serve: owner 4 housegate address "c:http" is not host:port`},
		{"no ports", Config{Token: testToken}, &Deps{}, "serve: Deps.Registry, Deps.Published and Deps.Copies are required"},
		{"no state directory", Config{Token: testToken}, &Deps{Registry: &fakeRegistry{}, Published: &fakePublished{}, Copies: &fakeCopies{}}, "serve: Deps.StateDir is required: the server records its leases there before it grants or renews one"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			d := deps
			if tc.deps != nil {
				d = *tc.deps
			}
			if _, err := New(tc.cfg, d); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("New: %v, want %s", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
	s, err := New(Config{Token: testToken}, deps)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("New with defaults: %v", err)
	}
	if s.cfg.OwnerUnreachableAfter != DefaultOwnerUnreachableAfter || s.cfg.OwnerProbeInterval != DefaultOwnerProbeInterval ||
		s.cfg.LeaseTTL != DefaultLeaseTTL || s.cfg.PollInterval != DefaultPollInterval {
		t.Fatalf("defaults %v", s.cfg)
	}
}

// TestConfigNeverPrintsItsToken: neither fmt nor slog prints Config.Token.
func TestConfigNeverPrintsItsToken(t *testing.T) {
	const secret = "s3cr3t-member-status-token"
	cfg := Config{Enabled: true, Token: secret, OwnerHouseGate: map[uint64]string{1: "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b:33001"}}
	var logged bytes.Buffer
	slog.New(slog.NewJSONHandler(&logged, nil)).Info("serving", "config", cfg)
	for _, out := range []string{fmt.Sprint(cfg), fmt.Sprintf("%v %+v %#v %s", cfg, cfg, cfg, cfg), logged.String()} {
		if strings.Contains(out, secret) || !strings.Contains(out, "<redacted>") {
			t.Fatalf("printed %q", out)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(logged.String(), `"owner_housegate":{"1":"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b:33001"}`) {
		t.Fatalf("the log lost the addresses: %s", logged.String())
	}
}
```

```go
func TestServeMetricsExportEveryStateReasonAndOutcomeIncludingZeros(t *testing.T) {
```

The tests run inside `testing/synctest` bubbles (Go 1.25+, the module is on 1.26): polls tick on whole seconds of the bubble's clock, and `advance` sleeps and then waits until every goroutine of the bubble is blocked, so an assertion after `advance` sees every poll and probe due at that instant. Where a probe and a poll fall on the same instant in an unknown order (`TestServeStartsAfterTheOwnerIsUnreachableForTUnreach`) or a context deadline would (`TestBeforeInstallGivesUpWithItsContext`), the tests observe at half seconds.

Create `member/serve/serve.go`:

```go
// Package serve is the serving side of a stage-3 si-member (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §11; Plan S3-C4 contract §30). It decides, per database of a
// peer owner, whether the member's copy may be served read-only by its host;
// it grants the host one lease per served database; and before any install
// of a database it revokes that lease and waits until the host released it
// or it expired, so the host never reads a copy while it changes. It changes
// no consensus state and calls nothing on the arbiter but the reads of its
// Published port.
package serve

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
)

const (
	// DefaultOwnerUnreachableAfter is t_unreach when Config leaves it zero.
	DefaultOwnerUnreachableAfter = 60 * time.Second
	// MinOwnerUnreachableAfter is the smallest t_unreach New accepts.
	MinOwnerUnreachableAfter = 15 * time.Second
	// DefaultOwnerProbeInterval is the time between two probes of an owner.
	DefaultOwnerProbeInterval = 5 * time.Second
	// OwnerProbeTimeout bounds one probe (a TCP dial of the owner's HouseGate).
	OwnerProbeTimeout = 3 * time.Second
	// DefaultLeaseTTL is the lease lifetime after a grant or a renew.
	DefaultLeaseTTL = 30 * time.Second
	// MinLeaseTTL is the smallest lease lifetime New accepts.
	MinLeaseTTL = 10 * time.Second
	// DefaultPollInterval is the time between two evaluations of the
	// serving conditions.
	DefaultPollInterval = 5 * time.Second
	// HostDeadlineMargin is how long before its local lease deadline a host
	// stops answering a database Replica.
	HostDeadlineMargin = 3 * time.Second
	// DefaultListen is the serving endpoint's listen address (Plan S3-C3's
	// siMember.statusPort).
	DefaultListen = ":9096"
)

// Config configures serving. Zero durations take their defaults.
type Config struct {
	// Enabled turns serving on. Without it the endpoint still answers, every
	// database reports serving_disabled and no lease is granted.
	Enabled bool
	// Token is the endpoint's bearer token. The caller passes it from the
	// environment, never from a config file; String, GoString and LogValue
	// never print it.
	Token string
	// OwnerUnreachableAfter is t_unreach: an owner counts as unreachable once
	// every probe of its HouseGate failed since a first failure at least this
	// long ago.
	OwnerUnreachableAfter time.Duration
	// OwnerProbeInterval is the time between two probes of an owner.
	OwnerProbeInterval time.Duration
	// LeaseTTL is how long a lease lives after its grant or its last renew.
	LeaseTTL time.Duration
	// PollInterval is the time between two evaluations of the conditions.
	PollInterval time.Duration
	// OwnerHouseGate maps an owner's indexer id to its HouseGate host:port.
	// An owner without an address only ever triggers serving by quarantine.
	OwnerHouseGate map[uint64]string
}

// String describes cfg without its token.
func (c Config) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("serve.Config{Enabled: %t, Token: %s, OwnerUnreachableAfter: %s, OwnerProbeInterval: %s, LeaseTTL: %s, PollInterval: %s, OwnerHouseGate: %v}",
		c.Enabled, redacted(c.Token), c.OwnerUnreachableAfter, c.OwnerProbeInterval, c.LeaseTTL, c.PollInterval, c.OwnerHouseGate)
}

// GoString is String, so %#v never prints the token either.
func (c Config) GoString() string { return c.String() }

// LogValue logs cfg without its token.
func (c Config) LogValue() slog.Value {
	return slog.GroupValue(
		slog.Bool("enabled", c.Enabled),
		slog.String("token", redacted(c.Token)),
		slog.Duration("owner_unreachable_after", c.OwnerUnreachableAfter),
		slog.Duration("owner_probe_interval", c.OwnerProbeInterval),
		slog.Duration("lease_ttl", c.LeaseTTL),
		slog.Duration("poll_interval", c.PollInterval),
		slog.Any("owner_housegate", c.OwnerHouseGate),
	)
}

func redacted(token string) string {
	if token == "" {
		return `""`
	}
	return "<redacted>"
}

func (c Config) withDefaults() Config {
	if c.OwnerUnreachableAfter == 0 {
		c.OwnerUnreachableAfter = DefaultOwnerUnreachableAfter
	}
	if c.OwnerProbeInterval == 0 {
		c.OwnerProbeInterval = DefaultOwnerProbeInterval
	}
	if c.LeaseTTL == 0 {
		c.LeaseTTL = DefaultLeaseTTL
	}
	if c.PollInterval <= 0 {
		c.PollInterval = DefaultPollInterval
	}
	return c
}

func (c Config) validate() error {
	if c.Token == "" {
		return errors.New("serve: a bearer token is required")
	}
	if c.OwnerUnreachableAfter < MinOwnerUnreachableAfter {
		return fmt.Errorf("serve: owner unreachable threshold %s is below the minimum %s", c.OwnerUnreachableAfter, MinOwnerUnreachableAfter)
	}
	if c.LeaseTTL < MinLeaseTTL {
		return fmt.Errorf("serve: lease ttl %s is below the minimum %s", c.LeaseTTL, MinLeaseTTL)
	}
	if c.OwnerProbeInterval < time.Second || c.OwnerProbeInterval >= c.OwnerUnreachableAfter {
		return fmt.Errorf("serve: owner probe interval %s must be at least 1s and below the unreachable threshold %s", c.OwnerProbeInterval, c.OwnerUnreachableAfter)
	}
	owners := make([]uint64, 0, len(c.OwnerHouseGate))
	for owner := range c.OwnerHouseGate {
		owners = append(owners, owner)
	}
	slices.Sort(owners)
	for _, owner := range owners {
		if !isHostPort(c.OwnerHouseGate[owner]) {
			return fmt.Errorf("serve: owner %d housegate address %q is not host:port", owner, c.OwnerHouseGate[owner])
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// isHostPort accepts host:port with a non-empty host and a numeric port
// other than 0.
func isHostPort(addr string) bool {
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
	if err != nil || host == "" {
		return false
	}
	n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
	return err == nil && n != 0
}

// Deps are the ports of a Server; member.Role implements them.
type Deps struct {
	// Registry is the member's table-registry follower: quarantine and the
	// Active incarnations each database must list.
	Registry dataplane.RegistryView
	// Published reads the latest published manifest once per poll.
	Published Published
	// Copies is the member's install journal.
	Copies Copies
	// Dial probes an owner's HouseGate; nil dials TCP with a net.Dialer.
	Dial func(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error)
	// Now is the clock; nil is time.Now. Polls, probes and lease waits use
	// time.Ticker and time.Timer, so a test that replaces Now runs in a
	// testing/synctest bubble.
	Now func() time.Time
	// Metrics receives the serving series; nil keeps an unregistered set.
	Metrics *Metrics
	// Logger receives serving transitions; nil is slog.Default().
	Logger *slog.Logger
	// StateDir is the member's state directory (member.Config.StateDir). The
	// server records every lease it holds in its LeaseFile before it grants
	// or renews one, and New reads the leases back, so a restarted member
	// never installs under a lease its previous process granted (K44).
	StateDir string
	// NodeID is the member's node id, answered as ServingView.NodeID.
	NodeID string
}

// Published gives the latest published manifest, read from the arbiter in
// this call and validated by the member feed's acceptance rule.
type Published interface {
	Latest(ctx context.Context) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error)
}

// Copies is the member's view of its install journal.
type Copies interface {
	// Databases lists every (owner, database) the member holds a copy of.
	Databases() []OwnerDatabase
	// Database is the copy of one database; false when the member holds none.
	Database(owner uint64, database string) (DatabaseCopy, bool)
}

// OwnerDatabase names one database of one owner.
type OwnerDatabase struct {
	Owner    uint64
	Database string
}

// DatabaseCopy is a copy of one database as the install journal records it.
type DatabaseCopy struct {
	// SnapshotID is the published manifest the owner's copies equal.
	SnapshotID string
	// Entry is the owner's track_frontiers entry of that manifest.
	Entry replay.TrackFrontier
	// Tables lists every ready copy of the database.
	Tables []TableCopy
	// AuditClean reports the startup audit and the self-audit clean.
	AuditClean bool
}

// TableCopy is one copied table.
type TableCopy struct {
	TableID        string
	IncarnationSeq uint64
	// CopyTable is the bare table name in hg_replica.
	CopyTable  string
	SchemaHash string
	Condition  TableCondition
}

// TableCondition is a copied table's install state.
type TableCondition string

const (
	// ConditionInstalled: the table is installed at DatabaseCopy.SnapshotID.
	ConditionInstalled TableCondition = "installed"
	// ConditionForeign: an install found a part no manifest lists; the table
	// is quarantined locally (Plan S3-C2 K36).
	ConditionForeign TableCondition = "foreign"
	// ConditionDiverged: a partition awaits its repair, or the copy holds a
	// part the journal does not list yet.
	ConditionDiverged TableCondition = "diverged"
	// ConditionExcluded: the table is not installed at the database's
	// snapshot (in P3: its journal is not at the owner's journal entry).
	ConditionExcluded TableCondition = "excluded"
)

// Server is the serving view, the owner probes, the leases and the endpoint.
type Server struct {
	cfg     Config
	reg     dataplane.RegistryView
	pub     Published
	copies  Copies
	dial    func(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error)
	now     func() time.Time
	metrics *Metrics
	logger  *slog.Logger
	nodeID  string
	// leaseFile is LeaseFile in Deps.StateDir.
	leaseFile string

	// mu guards everything below. It is never held across a call of a port
	// or a wait.
	mu      sync.Mutex
	epoch   uint64 // bumped by every BeforeInstall and AfterInstall
	dbs     map[OwnerDatabase]*dbState
	owners  map[uint64]*ownerState
	leases  map[string]*lease // by database
	byID    map[string]*lease
	feedErr string
}

// New validates cfg and returns a Server; Run starts its polls and probes.
func New(cfg Config, deps Deps) (*Server, error) {
	cfg = cfg.withDefaults()
	if err := cfg.validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if deps.Registry == nil || deps.Published == nil || deps.Copies == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("serve: Deps.Registry, Deps.Published and Deps.Copies are required")
	}
	if deps.StateDir == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("serve: Deps.StateDir is required: the server records its leases there before it grants or renews one")
	}
	s := &Server{
		cfg: cfg, reg: deps.Registry, pub: deps.Published, copies: deps.Copies,
		dial: deps.Dial, now: deps.Now, metrics: deps.Metrics, logger: deps.Logger, nodeID: deps.NodeID,
		leaseFile: filepath.Join(deps.StateDir, LeaseFile),
		dbs:       map[OwnerDatabase]*dbState{}, owners: map[uint64]*ownerState{},
		leases: map[string]*lease{}, byID: map[string]*lease{},
	}
	if s.dial == nil {
		s.dial = (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext
	}
	if s.now == nil {
		s.now = time.Now
	}
	if s.metrics == nil {
		s.metrics = NewMetrics()
	}
	if s.logger == nil {
		s.logger = slog.Default()
	}
	for owner, addr := range cfg.OwnerHouseGate {
		s.owners[owner] = &ownerState{addr: addr}
		s.metrics.ownerUnreachable.WithLabelValues(strconv.FormatUint(owner, 10)).Set(0)
	}
	if err := s.restoreLeases(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s, nil
}

// Run evaluates the serving conditions at once and then every PollInterval,
// and probes every owner of OwnerHouseGate every OwnerProbeInterval, until
// ctx ends; it returns ctx's error.
func (s *Server) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	var probes sync.WaitGroup
	for owner, addr := range s.cfg.OwnerHouseGate {
		probes.Go(func() { s.probeLoop(ctx, owner, addr) })
	}
	defer probes.Wait()
	s.poll(ctx)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(s.cfg.PollInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
			s.poll(ctx)
		}
	}
}

// Serving is the current serving view, databases sorted by name and owner.
func (s *Server) Serving() ServingView {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	now := s.now()
	s.sweepLocked(now)
	return s.viewLocked(now)
}
```
