```python
    def si_host_docs(self):
        """Every devnet2 SI host release rendered as its helmfile declares it, once per class."""
        cls = type(self)
        if not hasattr(cls, "_si_host_docs"):
            cls._si_host_docs = {name: documents(render_si_release(name)) for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES}
        return cls._si_host_docs

    def test_devnet2_replica_reads_follow_the_rollout(self):
        state = devnet2_p3_state()
        for mirror in (DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES, DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS, DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE, DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS):
            self.assertEqual(set(mirror), set(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        self.assertEqual(state["grants"], DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS)
        self.assertEqual(state["monitoring"], DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING)
        self.assertEqual(p3_rollout_problems(state), [])
        for name, docs in self.si_host_docs().items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                host = state["hosts"][name]
                self.assertEqual(host["sidecar"], DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES[name])
                self.assertEqual(host["replica_reads"], DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS[name])
                self.assertEqual(host["member_serve"], DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE[name])
                token_secret = DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS[name]
                self.assertEqual(token_secret, f"{name}-si-member-status-token")
                config = host_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]
                (node,) = [c for c in docs[("StatefulSet", name)]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"] if c["name"] == "sentio-node"]
                token = [item for item in node.get("env", []) if item["name"] == "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN"]
                if DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS[name] is None:
                    self.assertNotIn("replica_reads", config)
                    self.assertEqual(token, [])
                else:
                    self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS[name], f"http://{name}-si-member:{DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT}")
                    self.assertEqual(config["replica_reads"], {"member_status_url": DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS[name]})
                    # The host's token is its release's own token Secret (D29).
                    self.assertEqual(host["token_secret"], token_secret)
                    self.assertEqual(token, [{"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": token_secret, "key": "status-token"}}}])
                if ("ConfigMap", f"{name}-si-member-config") not in docs:
                    self.assertFalse(host["member_endpoint"] or host["member_serve"] or host["replica_reads"], f"{name}: P3 values without its si-member")
                    continue
                # One token Secret per host release serves the host and its member (D29).
                (member,) = docs[("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member")]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"]
                (member_token,) = [item for item in member["env"] if item["name"] == "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN"]
                self.assertEqual(member_token["valueFrom"]["secretKeyRef"]["name"], token_secret)
                service = docs[("Service", f"{name}-si-member")]
                self.assertIn(DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT, [port["port"] for port in service["spec"]["ports"] if port["name"] == "status"])
                member_config = si_member_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]["member"]
                if host["member_endpoint"]:
                    self.assertEqual(member_config["serve"]["listen"], f":{DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT}")
                    self.assertIs(member_config["serve"]["enabled"], DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE[name])
                else:
                    self.assertNotIn("serve", member_config)
                    self.assertFalse(DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE[name])
        # The si_gateway grant follows the rollout: only on a locked
        # installation, and always as the last si_gateway grant.
        network = self.control[("ClickHouseInstallation", FRESH_RELEASE)]["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_gateway/grants/query"]
        installations = {FRESH_RELEASE: network}
        for path in (INDEXER_B_CHI, INDEXER_C_CHI):
            chi = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
            installations[chi["metadata"]["name"]] = chi["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_gateway/grants/query"]
        for name, grants in installations.items():
            with self.subTest(installation=name):
                self.assertEqual(SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT in grants, DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS[name])
                if DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS[name]:
                    self.assertEqual(grants[-1], SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT)
                    self.assertEqual(grants.count(SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT), 1)
                    self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE[name], "C")

    def test_every_si_host_runs_one_reviewed_agent_sidecar(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES), set(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        self.assertIn(DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE, AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES)
        for image in AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES:
            self.assertRegex(image, r"^ghcr\.io/housegate/housegate:v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
        for name, docs in self.si_host_docs().items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                pod = docs[("StatefulSet", name)]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
                (sidecar,) = [c for c in pod["containers"] if c["name"] == "housegate-sidecar"]
                self.assertEqual(sidecar["image"], DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES[name])
                self.assertIn(sidecar["image"], AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES)
                # The window keeps the legacy lanes (stage-1 runbook §11 rule) and
                # never hands the sidecar the member status token (D29).
                self.assertIn({"name": "HOUSEGATE_SI_LANES", "value": "off"}, sidecar["env"])
                self.assertNotIn("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN", [item["name"] for item in sidecar["env"]])
                self.assertNotIn(DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS[name], secret_references(sidecar))
        # The P3 agent reads the status replica and the older one refuses it: no
        # member serves while any SI host still runs another agent (K47).
        if any(DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE.values()):
            self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES.values()), {DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE})

    def test_devnet2_member_owner_housegate_names_every_other_si_host(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE), {str(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name]) for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES})
        state = devnet2_p3_state()
        for name, docs in self.si_host_docs().items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                own = str(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name])
                values = si_release_values(name)
                port = int(values["housegate"]["listen"].rsplit(":", 1)[1])
                self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE[own], f"{name}:{port}")
                service = docs[("Service", name)]
                self.assertIn(port, [item["port"] for item in service["spec"]["ports"] if item["name"] == "housegate"])
                others = {key: value for key, value in DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE.items() if key != own}
                owners = state["hosts"][name]["owner_housegate"]
                if owners or DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE[name]:
                    self.assertEqual(owners, others)
                    self.assertEqual((values["siMember"].get("config") or {}).get("host_indexer_id"), DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name])
                if owners and state["hosts"][name]["member_endpoint"]:
                    self.assertEqual(si_member_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]["member"]["serve"]["owner_housegate"], {int(key): value for key, value in others.items()})

```

```bash
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py")
base = path.read_text()


def entry(text, name, key, value):
    match = re.search(rf"^{name} = \{{\n(.*?)^\}}\n", text, re.M | re.S)
    body, count = re.subn(rf'^    "{re.escape(key)}": .*,$', f'    "{key}": {value},', match.group(1), flags=re.M)
    assert count == 1, (name, key)
    return text[:match.start(1)] + body + text[match.end(1):]


cases = (
    ("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS", lambda t: entry(t, "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b", '"http://sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-member:9096"')),
    ("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", lambda t: entry(t, "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", "storage-integrity-si-v2", "True")),
    ("DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE", lambda t: entry(t, "DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c", "True")),
    ("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING", lambda t: t.replace("\nDEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING = False\n", "\nDEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING = True\n", 1)),
)
for name, change in cases:
    text = change(base)
    assert text != base, name
    path.write_text(text)
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(path), "ActualFreshNetworkTest.test_devnet2_replica_reads_follow_the_rollout"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f"{name} moved alone: {run.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1]}")
path.write_text(base)
PY
cd / && rm -rf "$d"
```

Create `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md` with:

````markdown
# Storage integrity devnet2: multi-source stage 3 P3 (reads from members)

This runbook turns on stage 3 P3 of the multi-source storage-integrity design on devnet2-si-v2 (releases `storage-integrity-si-v2`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b` and `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c` in `sentio-network-devnet2`): a host serves a quarantined or unreachable owner's SI databases read-only, in safe mode, from its si-member's copies. The member decides when it may serve a database: the owner is quarantined, or its HouseGate has been unreachable from the member for `t_unreach`; every copy equals the owner's entry in the latest published manifest, unchanged over two polls; the audits are clean and no table is Foreign, Diverged, excluded or missing; serving is enabled on that member. It grants its host a lease per database and revokes it before any install. The host answers those tables with the read-only status `replica`, keeps sessions on a replica-served database local, rewrites their reads to the copy and refuses writes, DDL and `unsafe_latest` for them. The agent fails reads, never writes, over to a replica host when the owner refuses them as quarantined or cannot be reached. Design: housegate `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` §11, §14 (the peer-trusted guard) and the P3 row of §16, as clarified by Plan S3-C4 (housegate `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3c4-p3-member-reads.md`, clarifications K44 to K50). It continues [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md) (stage 3 P2, done on `<P2_END>`: one si-member per host, copies equal to the published entries for 24 hours). The stage numbers below are this runbook's own.

| Stage | Change | Way back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | PR: host replica reads, member serving, the `si_gateway` replica grant and the replica-read rules in the charts (all off), the P3 images listed for review, the replica grant probe, this runbook; inert on merge | Revert the PR |
| 1 | Preparation and entry checks, read-only apart from a local rewriter container (§1, §2) | None needed |
| 2 | Grants: `GRANT SELECT ON hg_replica.*` for `si_gateway` on indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network installation, one users reload each (§3) | Revert each grant commit (§8.1) |
| 3 | The agent window, per host indexer-b, indexer-c, indexer-a: the member image `<SN_COMMIT_P3>` with its serving endpoint up and serving off, then the host image, the `<HG_TAG_P3>` agent sidecar and the host's replica reads in one commit (§4) | Revert the host commit, then the member commit (§8.2) |
| 4 | The user's local agent on `<HG_TAG_P3>` (checked), then serving on, one member at a time, then the replica-read rules (§5) | Revert each commit (§8.2) |
| 5 | Drill: one baseline row, indexer-c quarantined, reads of its table from both members through the user's agent, indexer-c released, serving ends (§6) | Release indexer-c (§6.4, §8.3) |
| 6 | End: the P3 exit record (§7) | None needed |

Nothing in this runbook changes the consensus format: no Raft command, field, snapshot version, header byte or feature string (Plan S3-A contract §0, §7). The voters stay on their image, and every component can return to its previous image: a host to its previous host image and agent sidecar, a member to the P2 image (§8). The only consensus writes are the drill's quarantine and release of indexer-c (§6.2, §6.4): two authority-signed commands outside the consensus update, each confirmed. They leave indexer-c's `quarantine_generation` two higher for good, which is harmless.

The order is binding (Plan S3-C4 K47). Older HouseGate clients refuse the status name `replica`, so no member serves before every SI host's agent sidecar and the user's local agent run `<HG_TAG_P3>`. The grants come first (§3), because a host whose member serves reads the copies as `si_gateway`. Each host restarts once in its window (§4), its member first, so the host's lease client finds a serving endpoint already up and `sentio_node_storage_integrity_member_status_up` never drops. Serving is turned on only after every window and the user's upgrade (§5).

A copy never answers `unsafe_latest`: a replica-served table refuses it with a message naming safe mode, before anything reaches ClickHouse, and no component switches a read's mode silently (K46). devnet2's agents inject `unsafe_latest` by default, so every read of this runbook from a copy sets `SQL_x_read_mode='safe'` itself. Writes, DDL and `INSERT … SELECT` never fail over and are refused with 392 on a replica-served table.

Every command block is bash. Run them from the root of a production checkout at `origin/main`, in order, in one dedicated `bash` session started with `set -eo pipefail` (from fish, run `bash` first). Every value a later block needs is written under `$si_backup`, so a block also runs in a new session once §0 is defined. Never run two stages in one window. From §3 until §7, make no other change to the three hosts, their members or the three SI installations: no other sync, apply or pod deletion outside this runbook. CHI manifests are applied with `kubectl` (server dry run first); no helmfile runs on `k8s-sea/clickhouse`.

Every block that pushes to production `main`, syncs a release, applies or deletes a resource, starts a container or an agent, runs a statement that could write, or submits a quarantine or a release needs explicit user confirmation in chat before it runs; each such block is preceded by the line `Confirm before running.`. Never re-run a confirmed block only to see its output: a re-run repeats its writes. Read-only checks sit in separate blocks that are safe to re-run, and both kinds `tee` their output into `$si_backup`; read that file instead.

Every commit of §3 to §5 is one single-service commit made by `si_p3_commit <label>` on a checkout held at a detached, freshly fetched `origin/main`: it makes exactly that label's edits and mirrors (`si_p3_edit`, which checks that each file parses to exactly the intended change), commits them, and `si_p3_push` runs the render tests, checks that HEAD changes exactly those files and pushes HEAD to `main`; the block then syncs or applies at once. The labels are `G-b`, `G-c`, `G-n` (§3), `W-<x>-m` and `W-<x>-h` (§4), `S-<x>` (§5.1 to §5.3) and `M` (§5.4).

Writes in this runbook: the grant, window, serving and monitoring commits; indexer-a's acceptance INSERT `5301` into `devnet101.swap_new2` through its upgraded sidecar (§4.3; disjoint from the stage-3 P0 runbook's `3001` to `3004`, the indexer-c runbook's `3101` and `3102`, the lockdown runbook's `4101` to `4104`, the P1 runbook's `5101` to `5104`, written into `devuser1.s3_p1`, and the P2 runbook's `5201`); the `devuser1` owner's baseline row `(4, 'p3-6.1-4')` of `<acceptance-db>.s3e_e2e` through its own local agent (§6.1; rows 1 to 3 are the indexer-c enrolment runbook's); the refused write attempts of §6.3, which write nothing; the drill's quarantine and release of indexer-c; and the replica grant probe of §3, whose denied rows write nothing. That is two promotions, at most four with retries, and never more than half of §1.3's budget. Retryable `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` windows are expected for a host's own tables while that host restarts in §4, and Pending (733, retryable) answers until its startup owner audit is clean (`owner_audit: repair`).

Passwords and tokens (decision D29): the member status token lives only in its own Secret per host release, `<release>-si-member-status-token` (the one key `status-token`, made by the P2 runbook's `make-p2-logins.sh` in the user's terminal), never in the Secret that holds the `si_member` password (`storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>`). On a host pod only the `sentio-node` container takes it; the member's `si-member` container checks it. This runbook reads the serving view only through `sentio-node storage-integrity member-serving`, which never prints the token, inspects Secrets by their key names only, and never prints, logs, passes on argv or copies into `$si_backup` a password or a token. The ClickHouse logins run through the lockdown runbook's `si_ch_exec`, which pipes a Secret straight into `kubectl exec -i` stdin. Never paste a password or a token into chat.

The user's actions (decision D40): the upgrade of the user's local agent to `<HG_TAG_P3>` before §5 (this runbook only checks it), and the `devuser1` owner's blocks of §6.1, §6.3 and §6.5, which the user runs in their own terminal, in a bash session where §0 is defined, with that owner's key file; the key never leaves that terminal.

## 0. Session helpers

Define the helpers of §0 of [storage-integrity-devnet2-dynamic-table-set.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-dynamic-table-set.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source-tracks.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source-tracks.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-lockdown.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-lockdown.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c.md), [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md) and [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md), unchanged and in that order, then these. They replace `si_backup`, so the earlier evidence stays untouched; `si_lockdown_dir` keeps the lockdown runbook's lock records. From the earlier runbooks they use, among others: `si_kubectl`, `si_arbiter`, `si_voter`, `si_leader`, `si_rpc_on`, `si_info`, `si_status`, `si_tracks`, `si_track`, `si_track_published`, `si_wait_track`, `si_accept_a_track`, `si_refusal`, `si_agent_start`, `si_agent_ch`, `si_agent_stop` (stage 1 and stage 2), `si_head_is`, `si_vm_query`, `si_vmalert_groups` (P0), `si_ch_exec`, `si_ch_admin`, `si_grants`, `si_chi_state`, `si_wait_chi`, `si_render_diff`, `si_secret_keys` (lockdown), `si_member_pod`, `si_member_metrics`, `si_copies_check`, `si_budget_capture` and `si_budget` (P2).

```bash
si_backup="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3"
si_p3_pin() { sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$si_backup/pins"; } # $1 a name of §1.1's pins file: its value
si_p3_image() { printf 'ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-%s@%s\n' "$(si_p3_pin SN_COMMIT_P3)" "$(si_p3_pin SN_DIGEST_P3)"; } # the P3 host and member image
si_p3_sidecar() { printf 'ghcr.io/housegate/housegate:%s@%s\n' "$(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3)" "$(si_p3_pin HG_DIGEST_P3)"; } # the P3 agent sidecar
si_c_id() { si_p3_pin INDEXER_C_ID; } # indexer-c's SI indexer id
si_host_release() { # $1 a|b|c: that host's sentio-node release
  case "$1" in a|b|c) echo "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$1" ;; *) echo "unknown host $1 (a|b|c)" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
}
si_acceptance_db() { cat "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/acceptance-db"; } # indexer-c's acceptance database (indexer-c runbook §8)
si_container_image() { si_kubectl get pod "$1" -o jsonpath="{.spec.containers[?(@.name==\"$2\")].image}"; } # $1 pod, $2 container
si_pod_state() { # $1 pod: its uid, each container's restart count and its start time, one line
  si_kubectl get pod "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name} uid={.metadata.uid} {range .status.containerStatuses[*]}{.name}={.restartCount} {end}started={.status.startTime}{"\n"}'
}
si_member_serving() { # $1 a|b|c: the member's serving view (JSON), read in the host's sentio-node container with the token from its own environment, which the command never prints
  si_kubectl exec "$(si_host_release "$1")-0" -c sentio-node -- /sentio-node storage-integrity member-serving --config-path /config/standalone.yaml
}
si_serving_db() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 database: that database's entry of the member's serving view, one JSON line
  si_member_serving "$1" | jq -c --arg db "$2" '.databases[] | select(.database == $db)'
}
si_replica_status() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 database, $3 table: that host's table status with the replica fields
  si_rpc_on "$1" "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"sentio_getStorageIntegrityTableStatus\",\"params\":[\"$2\",\"$3\"]}" | jq -c '.result | {status, replica_of, served_from, owner_entry, frozen_since, schema_hash, registry_version}'
}
si_replica_hosts() { # $1 a|b|c: that host's replica_databases and replica_hosts (sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo)
  si_rpc_on "$1" '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo","params":[]}' | jq -c '.result | {si_indexer_id, quarantined, replica_databases, replica_hosts}'
}
si_host_replica_metrics() { # $1 a|b|c: the host's replica-read series, exposition lines from its :9091
  si_kubectl exec "$(si_host_release "$1")-0" -c sentio-node -- wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:9091/metrics | grep -E '^sentio_node_storage_integrity_(replica_|member_status_up|tables\{status="replica"\})' || true
}
si_wait_serving() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 database: polls the member's view every 10 s for up to 300 s until it serves that database; prints the entry
  local n view=""
  for n in $(seq 1 30); do
    view="$(si_serving_db "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null)" || view=""
    if [ -n "$view" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$view" | jq -r .serving)" = true ]; then printf '%s\n' "$view"; return 0; fi
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "the member of host $1 does not serve $2 after 300 s (poll $n): ${view:-no view}" >&2
  return 1
}
si_wait_not_serving() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 database, $3 reason: polls for up to 300 s until that database is not served, for that reason, and holds no lease
  local n view=""
  for n in $(seq 1 30); do
    view="$(si_serving_db "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null)" || view=""
    if [ -n "$view" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$view" | jq -r '"\(.serving) \(.reason) \(.lease == null)"')" = "false $3 true" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$view"; return 0; fi
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "the member of host $1 still serves $2, or not for reason $3, after 300 s (poll $n): ${view:-no view}" >&2
  return 1
}
si_failovers() { grep -F 'agent: replica failover' "$si_backup/agent.log" || true; } # the local agent's replica failover lines
si_local_agent_version() { # the user's local agent: prints housegate -version and fails unless it starts with "housegate <HG_TAG_P3> "
  local v
  v="$(housegate -version 2>&1 | head -n 1)" || v=""
  printf '%s\n' "$v"
  case "$v" in "housegate $(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3) "*) return 0 ;; esac
  echo "the local agent is not housegate $(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3): the user upgrades it in their own terminal (D40); stop" >&2
  return 1
}
si_sync() { helmfile -f k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml sync --selector "name=$1"; } # $1 release of the SI helmfile
si_render_diff_is() { # $1 release, then the exact "changed Kind/name" lines si_render_diff must print for HEAD, in any order
  local got want rel="$1"
  shift
  got="$(si_render_diff "$rel" | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" || return 1
  want="$(printf '%s\n' "$@" | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
  [ "$got" = "$want" ] || { echo "HEAD renders ${got% } for $rel, not ${want% }" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "render diff of $rel: ${want% }"
}
si_p3_message() { # $1 commit label: its commit subject
  case "$1" in
    G-b|G-c) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 si_gateway hg_replica grant on indexer-${1#G-} (users reload)" ;;
    G-n) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 si_gateway hg_replica grant on the network installation (users reload)" ;;
    W-[abc]-m) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 member image with its serving endpoint on sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-${1:2:1} (serving off)" ;;
    W-[abc]-h) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 host image, agent sidecar $(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3) and replica reads on sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-${1:2:1}" ;;
    S-[abc]) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 serving on for member-${1#S-}" ;;
    M) echo "chore(devnet2): stage-3 P3 replica-read monitoring" ;;
    *) echo "unknown commit label $1" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_p3_commit() { # $1 commit label: on a clean checkout at a freshly fetched origin/main, makes that label's edits (si_p3_edit) and commits exactly them; prints the files
  local files msg
  git fetch -q origin main || return 1
  [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo "the checkout is not a clean, freshly fetched origin/main" >&2; return 1; }
  msg="$(si_p3_message "$1")" || return 1
  files="$(si_p3_edit "$1")" || { git checkout -q -- .; return 1; }
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # one word per file
  git commit -q -m "$msg" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" -- $files || return 1
  echo "$files"
}
si_p3_push() { # $1 commit record under $si_backup, then every file HEAD must change: render tests, HEAD check, record, push to main; refuses a commit pushed already
  local f="$si_backup/$1"
  shift
  [ ! -e "$f" ] || { echo "$f exists: that commit was pushed already; never re-run a confirmed block" >&2; return 1; }
  python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py || return 1
  si_head_is "$@" || return 1
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$f"
  git push origin HEAD:main
}
si_apply_chi() { # $1 CHI manifest, $2 CHI name: server dry run, apply, wait for Completed
  si_kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f "$1" && si_kubectl apply -f "$1" && si_wait_chi "$2"
}
si_grant_snapshot() { # $1 phase (before|after), $2 CHI, then its hosts: every si_* row of system.grants and every ClickHouse pod of the CHI, one tab-separated line each
  local phase="$1" chi="$2" h row
  shift 2
  for h in "$@"; do
    si_grants "$h" | while IFS= read -r row; do printf '%s\tgrant\t%s\t%s\n' "$phase" "$h" "$row"; done
  done
  si_chi_state "$chi" | grep '^pod ' | while IFS= read -r row; do printf '%s\tpod\t%s\t%s\n' "$phase" "$chi" "$row"; done
}
si_grant_check() { # $1 grants file of si_grant_snapshot: on every host, after = before plus exactly si_gateway SELECT ON hg_replica.*, and no ClickHouse pod restarted
  python3 -I - "$1" <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows = {}
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    phase, kind, host, body = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t", 3)
    rows.setdefault((phase, kind, host), set()).add(body)
want = {"user_name": "si_gateway", "access_type": "SELECT", "access_object": "", "database": "hg_replica", "table": None, "column": None, "is_partial_revoke": 0, "grant_option": 0}
hosts = sorted({host for _, kind, host in rows if kind == "grant"})
if not hosts:
    sys.exit("no grants in %s; stop" % sys.argv[1])
for host in hosts:
    before, after = rows.get(("before", "grant", host), set()), rows.get(("after", "grant", host), set())
    added = [json.loads(row) for row in after - before]
    if not before or (before - after) or added != [want]:
        sys.exit("host %s: the grants changed by %s and lost %s; stop" % (host, added, sorted(before - after)))
    print("host %s: si_gateway SELECT ON hg_replica.* added, nothing else changed" % host)
for _, kind, chi in sorted(key for key in rows if key[1] == "pod" and key[0] == "before"):
    if rows[("before", "pod", chi)] != rows.get(("after", "pod", chi)):
        sys.exit("%s: a ClickHouse pod restarted or moved: %s; stop" % (chi, sorted(rows.get(("after", "pod", chi), set()))))
    print("%s: every ClickHouse pod kept its uid, restart count and start time" % chi)
PY
}
si_replica_grant_probe() { # $1 network|indexer-b|indexer-c: the replica grant probe as si_gateway on that installation's source ClickHouse ({copy}: its first hg_replica table); one TSV line per row; fails on any row whose outcome differs from its expect column
  local corpus=charts/storage-integrity/tests/clickhouse_replica_grant_probe.tsv host copy role expect stmt out code got n=0 bad=0
  case "$1" in network) host=a ;; indexer-b) host=b ;; indexer-c) host=c ;; *) echo "usage: si_replica_grant_probe network|indexer-b|indexer-c" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
  [ -s "$corpus" ] || { echo "$corpus is missing" >&2; return 2; }
  copy="$(si_ch_admin "$host" "SELECT name FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'hg_replica' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1")" || return 2
  [ -n "$copy" ] || { echo "no hg_replica table on $1: its member holds no copy" >&2; return 2; }
  [ "$(si_ch_admin "$host" "EXISTS TABLE hg_replica.si_probe_denied")" = 0 ] || { echo "hg_replica.si_probe_denied exists on $1 before the probe; stop" >&2; return 2; }
  printf 'row\trole\texpect\tgot\tcode\tstatement\n'
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r role expect stmt <&3 || [ -n "$role" ]; do
    case "$role" in ''|'#'*|role) continue ;; esac
    n=$((n + 1))
    if [ "$role" != si_gateway ]; then printf '%s\t%s\t%s\tno-login\t-\t%s\n' "$n" "$role" "$expect" "$stmt"; bad=$((bad + 1)); continue; fi
    stmt="${stmt//\{copy\}/\`$copy\`}"
    if out="$(si_ch_exec "$host" si_gateway "$stmt" 2>&1)"; then
      code=0
    else
      code="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/.*Code: \([0-9][0-9]*\)\..*/\1/p' | head -n 1)"
      code="${code:-unknown}"
    fi
    case "$code" in 0) got=ok ;; 497) got=denied ;; 516|unknown) got=error ;; *) got=ok ;; esac
    [ "$got" = "$expect" ] || bad=$((bad + 1))
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$n" "$role" "$expect" "$got" "$code" "$stmt"
  done 3< "$corpus"
  if [ "$(si_ch_admin "$host" "EXISTS TABLE hg_replica.si_probe_denied")" != 0 ]; then
    si_ch_admin "$host" "DROP TABLE hg_replica.si_probe_denied SYNC" || true
    echo "si_gateway created hg_replica.si_probe_denied on $1 (dropped again): the grant is wider than SELECT; stop" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || { echo "the corpus has no rows" >&2; return 2; }
  [ "$bad" = 0 ] || { echo "$bad of $n rows differ from their expect column" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "every row of $n is as expected on $1" >&2
}
si_run_record() { # $1 plan key (s3c2, s3c3), $2 the opening words of a run-record item: that item of the plan's Appendix C on its ledger copy, sub-items included
  python3 -I "$HOME/.cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py" show "$(si_p3_pin HOUSEGATE_REPO)" "$1" | python3 -I -c '
import sys
start, out = "- " + sys.argv[1], []
for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.rstrip("\n")
    if out and (line.startswith("- ") or line.startswith("#")):
        break
    if out or line.startswith(start):
        out.append(line)
if not out:
    sys.exit("no run-record item starting %r" % start)
print("\n".join(out))
' "$2"
}
si_revert_p3() { # $1 commit record under $si_backup, $2 what to apply after the revert: a release of the SI helmfile, or chi:<manifest>:<CHI name>; a revert pushed already is only applied again
  local f="$si_backup/$1" c manifest chi
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "no $1: nothing to revert"; return 0; }
  if [ -f "$f.reverted" ]; then
    echo "$1 is reverted on main already ($(cat "$f.reverted")): applying only"
  else
    git fetch -q origin main || return 1
    [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo "the checkout is not a clean, freshly fetched origin/main" >&2; return 1; }
    c="$(cat "$f")"
    git show --stat "$c" | cat
    git revert --no-edit "$c" || { git revert --abort; echo "reverting $1 conflicts with a later commit on main: aborted, nothing changed; revert the later one first (§8)" >&2; return 1; }
    python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py || { git reset -q --hard HEAD~1; echo "the revert of $1 fails the render tests: dropped, nothing pushed; revert the later commits first (§8)" >&2; return 1; }
    git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
    git rev-parse HEAD > "$f.reverted"
  fi
  case "$2" in
    chi:*)
      manifest="${2#chi:}"; chi="${manifest#*:}"; manifest="${manifest%%:*}"
      si_apply_chi "$manifest" "$chi"
      ;;
    *) si_sync "$2" ;;
  esac
}
si_p3_edit() { # $1 commit label: makes that commit's edits in this checkout and prints the files it changed; refuses an edit made already
  python3 -I - "$1" "$si_backup/pins" <<'PY'
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

label, pins_file = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
pins = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in Path(pins_file).read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
host_image = f"ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{pins['SN_COMMIT_P3']}@{pins['SN_DIGEST_P3']}"
sidecar_tag = f"{pins['HG_TAG_P3']}@{pins['HG_DIGEST_P3']}"
runbook = "docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md"
D = "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2"
TESTS = "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
GRANT = "GRANT SELECT ON hg_replica.*"
HOSTS = {"a": ("0", "network", "storage-integrity-si-v2", "4.3", "5.3"),
         "b": ("1", "indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "4.1", "5.1"),
         "c": (pins["INDEXER_C_ID"], "indexer-c", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c", "4.2", "5.2")}
OWNERS = {"0": "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a:32001", "1": "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b:33001",
          pins["INDEXER_C_ID"]: "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c:34001"}
changed = {}


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"si_p3_edit {label}: {message}")


def read(path):
    return changed.get(path, Path(path).read_text())


def indent(line):
    return len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))


def block(lines, keys):
    """(header index, end index) of the YAML key at keys: its block is lines header+1 .. end-1."""
    lo, hi, start = 0, len(lines), None
    for key in keys:
        child, start = None, None
        for i in range(lo, hi):
            line = lines[i]
            if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
                continue
            child = indent(line) if child is None else child
            if indent(line) == child and re.match(rf"^\s*{re.escape(key)}:(\s|$)", line):
                start = i
                break
        if start is None:
            fail(f"no key {'.'.join(keys)}")
        lo, hi = start + 1, len(lines)
        for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)):
            if lines[i].strip() and indent(lines[i]) <= indent(lines[start]):
                hi = i
                break
    end = hi
    while end > start + 1 and not lines[end - 1].strip():
        end -= 1
    return start, end


def edit(path, change, check):
    """Apply the text change to path, then require that the parsed YAML changed exactly as check says."""
    old_text = read(path)
    new_text = change(old_text)
    if yaml.safe_load(new_text) != check(yaml.safe_load(old_text)):
        fail(f"{path} would not parse as intended")
    changed[path] = new_text


def insert_at_end(path, keys, new_lines):
    def change(text):
        lines = text.split("\n")
        _, end = block(lines, keys)
        return "\n".join(lines[:end] + new_lines + lines[end:])
    return change


def set_key(path, keys, value):
    """Replace the scalar of the last key of keys, keeping the line's indentation."""
    def change(text):
        lines = text.split("\n")
        start, _ = block(lines, keys)
        prefix = re.match(r"^(\s*[^:]+:)", lines[start]).group(1)
        lines[start] = f"{prefix} {value}"
        return "\n".join(lines)
    return change


def py_entry(name, key, value):
    """test_render.py: one entry of the dict constant name."""
    text = read(TESTS)
    match = re.search(rf"^{name} = \{{\n(.*?)^\}}\n", text, re.M | re.S)
    if not match:
        fail(f"{TESTS} has no constant {name}")
    body = match.group(1)
    entry = re.compile(rf'^    "{re.escape(key)}": .*,$', re.M)
    if len(entry.findall(body)) != 1:
        fail(f"{name} has no single entry {key}")
    body = entry.sub(lambda _: f'    "{key}": {value},', body)
    changed[TESTS] = text[:match.start(1)] + body + text[match.end(1):]


def py_assign(name, value):
    """test_render.py: the top-level assignment of name, one or more lines."""
    text = read(TESTS)
    match = re.search(rf"^{name} = (\(\n.*?^\)|[^\n]*)\n", text, re.M | re.S)
    if not match or len(re.findall(rf"^{name} = ", text, re.M)) != 1:
        fail(f"{TESTS} has no single assignment {name}")
    changed[TESTS] = text[:match.start(1)] + value + text[match.end(1):]


def image_literal(image):
    repository, rest = image.split(":", 1)
    tag, digest = rest.split("@", 1)
    return f'(\n    "{repository}:{tag}"\n    "@{digest}"\n)'


def grant_chi(x):
    _, _, chi, _, _ = HOSTS[x]
    path = f"{D}/{chi}-source.yaml"

    def change(text):
        lines = text.split("\n")
        keys = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^\s*si_gateway/grants/query:\s*$", line)]
        if len(keys) != 1:
            fail(f"{path} has no single si_gateway/grants/query")
        i = keys[0]
        items = []
        for j in range(i + 1, len(lines)):
            if re.match(r"^\s*- ", lines[j]) and indent(lines[j]) in (indent(lines[i]), indent(lines[i]) + 2):
                items.append(j)
            else:
                break
        if not items:
            fail(f"{path}: si_gateway/grants/query lists nothing")
        last = lines[items[-1]]
        quote = '"' if last.lstrip()[2:].startswith('"') else ""
        lines.insert(items[-1] + 1, f"{' ' * indent(last)}- {quote}{GRANT}{quote}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def check(doc):
        grants = doc["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_gateway/grants/query"]
        if GRANT in grants:
            fail(f"{path} grants it already")
        grants.append(GRANT)
        return doc
    edit(path, change, check)
    py_entry("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", chi, "True")


def grant_network():
    path = f"{D}/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
    lines = [
        f"    # Stage 3 P3 ({runbook}",
        "    # §3.3): si_gateway reads its members' copies (GRANT SELECT ON",
        "    # hg_replica.*, its last grant; a users reload).",
        "    replicaReads: true",
    ]

    def check(doc):
        if "replicaReads" in doc["clickhouse"]["access"]:
            fail(f"{path} sets clickhouse.access.replicaReads already")
        doc["clickhouse"]["access"]["replicaReads"] = True
        return doc
    edit(path, insert_at_end(path, ["clickhouse", "access"], lines), check)
    py_entry("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", "storage-integrity-si-v2", "True")


def window_member(x):
    _, _, _, section, _ = HOSTS[x]
    path = f"{D}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
    text = read(path)
    old_image = yaml.safe_load(text)["siMember"]["image"]
    if old_image == host_image:
        fail(f"{path}: the member runs the P3 image already")

    def change(text):
        text = set_key(path, ["siMember", "image"], host_image)(text)
        lines = text.split("\n")
        start, _ = block(lines, ["siMember", "image"])
        lines[start:start] = [
            "  # The stage-3 P3 member image with its serving endpoint, serving off",
            f"  # ({runbook} §{section}).",
            "  # Rollback target:",
            f"  # {old_image}",
        ]
        return insert_at_end(path, ["siMember"], [
            "  # The serving endpoint on the status port (Plan S3-C4 contract §31.3).",
            "  serve:",
            "    endpoint: true",
        ])("\n".join(lines))

    def check(doc):
        if "serve" in doc["siMember"]:
            fail(f"{path} sets siMember.serve already")
        doc["siMember"]["image"] = host_image
        doc["siMember"]["serve"] = {"endpoint": True}
        return doc
    edit(path, change, check)


SOURCE_IMAGE_HEADER = """# Merged LAST into indexer-{x} by storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml: the
# multi-source stage-3 P3 host build, sentio-node {commit} on housegate
# {hg} and arbiter-core {core} (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §11): the table
# status Replica from this host's si-member (storage_integrity.replica_reads),
# the lease client, replica_hosts and replica_databases in
# sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo, and the si-member's serving endpoint. Every
# SI host runs it from {runbook} §4 on; test_render.py mirrors this pin as
# {constant} and lists it in REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES. Its startup probe
# needs rewriter-grpc v0.17.0 or later, pinned in
# sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml. Rollback target (only
# while no member serves, runbook §8.2):
# {old}.
"""


def source_image_text(x, old, constant, mirror=False):
    head = SOURCE_IMAGE_HEADER.format(x=x, commit=pins["SN_COMMIT_P3"], hg=pins["HG_TAG_P3"], core=pins["CORE_TAG_P3"],
                                      runbook=runbook, constant=constant, old=old)
    if mirror:
        head = ("# Merge LAST into a separately reviewed fresh-network sentio-node release.\n"
                "# This is not a deployment file for legacy devnet2. A copy of the verified\n"
                "# input in k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml;\n"
                "# keep the two identical (the render tests check it).\n") + head
    tag = host_image.split(":", 1)[1]
    return head + f'node:\n  image:\n    repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node\n    tag: "{tag}"\n    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent\n'


def window_host(x):
    own, _, _, section, _ = HOSTS[x]
    release = f"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-{x}"
    constant = {"a": "FRESH_SOURCE_IMAGE", "b": "INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE", "c": "INDEXER_C_SOURCE_IMAGE"}[x]
    pin = f"{D}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml"
    pinned = yaml.safe_load(read(pin))["node"]["image"]
    old = f'{pinned["repository"]}:{pinned["tag"]}'
    if old == host_image:
        fail(f"{pin}: the host runs the P3 image already")
    paths = [pin] + (["docs/examples/storage-integrity-fresh-source-image.yaml"] if x == "a" else [])
    for path in paths:
        mirror = path.startswith("docs/")
        edit(path, lambda _text, mirror=mirror: source_image_text(x, old, constant, mirror),
             lambda doc: {"node": {"image": {"repository": "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node", "tag": host_image.split(":", 1)[1], "pullPolicy": "IfNotPresent"}}})
    path = f"{D}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
    old_tag = yaml.safe_load(read(path))["housegateSidecar"]["image"]["tag"]
    url = f"http://{release}-si-member:9096"
    token = f"{release}-si-member-status-token"

    def change(text):
        lines = text.split("\n")
        start, _ = block(lines, ["housegateSidecar", "image", "tag"])
        top = start
        while top > 0 and lines[top - 1].lstrip().startswith("#") and indent(lines[top - 1]) == indent(lines[start]):
            top -= 1
        lines[top:start + 1] = [
            f"    # housegate {pins['HG_TAG_P3']}, the stage-3 P3 agent",
            f"    # ({runbook} §{section}): it",
            "    # reads the table status replica and fails reads, never writes, over to a",
            "    # replica host when the owner refuses them as quarantined or cannot be",
            "    # reached; lanes stay off. Rollback target (only while no member serves):",
            f"    # {old_tag}",
            f'    tag: "{sidecar_tag}"',
        ]
        return insert_at_end(path, ["storageIntegrity"], [
            "  # Stage 3 P3: this host's replica reads from its si-member's serving",
            "  # endpoint, the token only from its own Secret (decision D29;",
            f"  # {runbook} §{section}).",
            "  replicaReads:",
            f"    memberStatusURL: {url}",
            "    memberStatusTokenSecret:",
            f"      name: {token}",
            "      key: status-token",
        ])("\n".join(lines))

    def check(doc):
        if "replicaReads" in doc["storageIntegrity"]:
            fail(f"{path} sets storageIntegrity.replicaReads already")
        doc["housegateSidecar"]["image"]["tag"] = sidecar_tag
        doc["storageIntegrity"]["replicaReads"] = {"memberStatusURL": url, "memberStatusTokenSecret": {"name": token, "key": "status-token"}}
        return doc
    edit(path, change, check)
    py_assign(constant, image_literal(host_image))
    py_entry("DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES", release, "DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE")
    py_entry("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS", release, f'"{url}"')


def serve_on(x):
    own, _, _, _, section = HOSTS[x]
    path = f"{D}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
    owners = {key: value for key, value in OWNERS.items() if key != own}
    lines = [
        f"    # Serving on ({runbook}",
        f"    # §{section}), with the owner probe of every other SI indexer.",
        "    enabled: true",
        "    ownerHouseGate:",
    ]
    lines += [f'      "{key}": {value}' for key, value in sorted(owners.items(), key=lambda item: int(item[0]))]

    def check(doc):
        serve = doc["siMember"].get("serve") or {}
        if serve != {"endpoint": True}:
            fail(f"{path}: siMember.serve is {serve}, not the endpoint of runbook §4 alone")
        doc["siMember"]["serve"] = {"endpoint": True, "enabled": True, "ownerHouseGate": owners}
        return doc
    edit(path, insert_at_end(path, ["siMember", "serve"], lines), check)
    py_entry("DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE", f"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-{x}", "True")


def monitoring_on():
    path = f"{D}/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
    lines = [f"  # Stage 3 P3 ({runbook}", "  # §5.4): the replica-reads rules.", "  replicaReads:", "    enabled: true"]

    def check(doc):
        if "replicaReads" in doc["monitoring"]:
            fail(f"{path} sets monitoring.replicaReads already")
        doc["monitoring"]["replicaReads"] = {"enabled": True}
        return doc
    edit(path, insert_at_end(path, ["monitoring"], lines), check)
    py_assign("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING", "True")


match = re.fullmatch(r"(G-[bcn]|W-[abc]-[mh]|S-[abc]|M)", label)
if not match:
    sys.exit("usage: si_p3_edit G-b|G-c|G-n|W-<x>-m|W-<x>-h|S-<x>|M (x = a, b or c)")
if label == "G-n":
    grant_network()
elif label.startswith("G-"):
    grant_chi(label[2])
elif label.startswith("W-"):
    (window_member if label.endswith("-m") else window_host)(label[2])
elif label.startswith("S-"):
    serve_on(label[2])
else:
    monitoring_on()
for path, text in changed.items():
    Path(path).write_text(text)
print(" ".join(sorted(changed)))
PY
}
```

`si_member_serving` asks the member through its own host: `sentio-node storage-integrity member-serving` reads `storage_integrity.replica_reads.member_status_url` from the host's config and the bearer token from `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN` in the `sentio-node` container, and prints the member's serving view (`node_id` and, per database, `database`, `owner`, `serving`, `reason`, `snapshot_id`, `entry`, `frozen_since_unix_ms`, `owner_quarantined`, `owner_unreachable`, `tables`, `lease`). It therefore answers only once that host runs the P3 image with its replica reads (§4); before that, the member's own series (`si_member_metrics <x> '^sentio_node_si_member_serve_'`) show its endpoint. A view's not-serving `reason` is one of `owner_available`, `entry_unconfirmed`, `copy_behind`, `audit_unclean`, `table_foreign`, `table_diverged`, `table_excluded`, `table_missing`, `serving_disabled`, `feed_unavailable`, `installing`.

`si_p3_edit` writes the edits of one commit label and the matching mirrors in `charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py`, then prints the files it changed. Before writing anything it parses every file it touches as YAML before and after and stops unless the result is exactly the intended change (one grant appended last to `si_gateway`; `clickhouse.access.replicaReads`, `monitoring.replicaReads.enabled`, `siMember.serve` or `storageIntegrity.replicaReads` added; an image or tag replaced), so a file that moved since this runbook was written stops it instead of being edited blind. Every comment it writes names this runbook's section and the rollback target.

`si_replica_grant_probe` runs `charts/storage-integrity/tests/clickhouse_replica_grant_probe.tsv` as `si_gateway` over loopback in the installation's source ClickHouse pod, its password piped from the host's Secret by the lockdown runbook's `si_ch_exec`; `ok` is any answer but 497, `denied` is 497, and a login failure is an error. Its denied rows write nothing while the grant is only `SELECT`; should `si_gateway` ever be able to create `hg_replica.si_probe_denied`, the helper drops it as `default` and stops. It is a mutating helper, so every call sits in a confirmed block.

## 1. Preparation

### 1.1 Pins

| Component | Pin | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sentio-node, every SI host and every si-member | `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_COMMIT_P3>@<SN_DIGEST_P3>` (housegate `<HG_TAG_P3>`, arbiter-core `<CORE_TAG_P3>`) | sentio-node main CI `docker-push` (Plan S3-C4 Task 46); OCI revision equals `<SN_COMMIT_P3>`; index digest from `docker buildx imagetools inspect` |
| HouseGate agent sidecar, every SI host | `ghcr.io/housegate/housegate:<HG_TAG_P3>@<HG_DIGEST_P3>` | housegate release workflow (Plan S3-C4 Task 44); `docker buildx imagetools inspect` |
| The user's local agent | housegate `<HG_TAG_P3>` (`housegate -version`), upgraded by the user (D40) | §5 and §6.1 |
| In-pod rewriter, every SI host | unchanged, the pin of `sentio-node-indexer-<x>-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` (`housegate-rewriter` 0.17.0) | §2's parity run (`rewriter-parity.txt`) |
| Voters and verifiers | unchanged (Plan S3-A's `ARBITER_DIGEST`) | not touched |

Before this runbook every host runs the host image its `sentio-node-indexer-<x>-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml` names at `origin/main` with the `v0.15.0@sha256:1b51de76b7b7a15a8006d0ac06febb10012c74c92d4950d07e4e5a5b77b3570f` agent sidecar, and every si-member the P2 image: those are the rollback targets of §8, and each is the parent of a commit this runbook makes.

Set the two local clones (any clones with the release tags; the block only fetches and reads), then:

```bash
housegate_repo=/path/to/housegate; sentio_node_repo=/path/to/sentio-node
HG_TAG_P3='<HG_TAG_P3>'; HG_DIGEST_P3='<HG_DIGEST_P3>'; CORE_TAG_P3='<CORE_TAG_P3>'; SN_COMMIT_P3='<SN_COMMIT_P3>'; SN_DIGEST_P3='<SN_DIGEST_P3>'
INDEXER_C_ID='<INDEXER_C_ID>'; ARBITER_PIN_P2='<ARBITER_PIN_P2>'; P2_END='<P2_END>'
case "$HG_TAG_P3$HG_DIGEST_P3$CORE_TAG_P3$SN_COMMIT_P3$SN_DIGEST_P3$INDEXER_C_ID$ARBITER_PIN_P2$P2_END" in *'<'*) echo "pins are still placeholders; stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
for r in "$housegate_repo" "$sentio_node_repo"; do
  git -C "$r" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "set housegate_repo and sentio_node_repo to local clones first ($r is none)"; exit 1; }
done
if [ -e "$si_backup" ]; then
  # Created fresh for this run (mode 700): it may hold this run's pins, never an earlier run's evidence.
  [ -d "$si_backup" ] && [ -n "$(find "$si_backup" -maxdepth 0 -perm 700)" ] || { echo "$si_backup is not a directory of mode 700; stop"; exit 1; }
  [ -f "$si_backup/pins" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A "$si_backup")" ] || { echo "$si_backup holds files without pins: move it aside; stop"; exit 1; }
else
  mkdir -m 700 "$si_backup"
fi
git -C "$housegate_repo" fetch -q --tags origin; git -C "$sentio_node_repo" fetch -q origin
git -C "$housegate_repo" rev-parse -q --verify "$HG_TAG_P3^{commit}" > /dev/null || { echo "housegate has no tag $HG_TAG_P3; stop"; exit 1; }
deps() { awk '$1 == "github.com/housegate/housegate" || $1 == "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core" {print $1, $2}' | sort | tr '\n' ' '; }
want="github.com/housegate/housegate $HG_TAG_P3 github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core $CORE_TAG_P3 "
[ "$(git -C "$sentio_node_repo" show "$SN_COMMIT_P3:go.mod" | deps)" = "$want" ] || { echo "sentio-node $SN_COMMIT_P3 does not pin exactly $want; stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-$SN_COMMIT_P3" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' | jq -r .digest)" = "$SN_DIGEST_P3" ] || { echo "the sentio-node image digest is not $SN_DIGEST_P3; stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "ghcr.io/housegate/housegate:$HG_TAG_P3" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' | jq -r .digest)" = "$HG_DIGEST_P3" ] || { echo "the housegate image digest is not $HG_DIGEST_P3; stop"; exit 1; }
python3 -I -B - "$SN_COMMIT_P3" "$SN_DIGEST_P3" "$HG_TAG_P3" "$HG_DIGEST_P3" <<'EOF'
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("charts/storage-integrity/tests"))
import test_render as t
host = "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-%s@%s" % (sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
sidecar = "ghcr.io/housegate/housegate:%s@%s" % (sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4])
assert t.DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE == host, t.DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE
assert t.DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE == sidecar, t.DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE
assert host in t.REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES and host in t.MEMBER_IMAGES and host in t.WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES, "the P3 image is not reviewed"
assert sidecar in t.AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES, "the P3 agent is not reviewed"
print("test_render.py reviews the P3 host, member and agent images")
EOF
printf '%s\n' "HG_TAG_P3=$HG_TAG_P3" "HG_DIGEST_P3=$HG_DIGEST_P3" "CORE_TAG_P3=$CORE_TAG_P3" "SN_COMMIT_P3=$SN_COMMIT_P3" "SN_DIGEST_P3=$SN_DIGEST_P3" \
  "INDEXER_C_ID=$INDEXER_C_ID" "ARBITER_PIN_P2=$ARBITER_PIN_P2" "P2_END=$P2_END" "HOUSEGATE_REPO=$housegate_repo" "SENTIO_NODE_REPO=$sentio_node_repo" > "$si_backup/pins.new"
if [ -f "$si_backup/pins" ] && ! cmp -s "$si_backup/pins.new" "$si_backup/pins"; then echo "$si_backup/pins records other pins; stop"; exit 1; fi
mv "$si_backup/pins.new" "$si_backup/pins"
echo "pins resolve"

Expected: `test_render.py reviews the P3 host, member and agent images` and `pins resolve`. `$si_backup/pins` holds one `NAME=value` line each for `HG_TAG_P3`, `HG_DIGEST_P3`, `CORE_TAG_P3`, `SN_COMMIT_P3`, `SN_DIGEST_P3`, `INDEXER_C_ID`, `ARBITER_PIN_P2`, `P2_END` and the two clones.

### 1.2 Identities

| Host | Release | SI indexer | Member | HouseGate (owner probe) | Member Service (status port) | Token Secret (key `status-token`) | `si_member` password Secret | Source installation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| a | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a` | 0 | `member-a` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a:32001` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member:9096` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member-status-token` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-network` | `storage-integrity-si-v2` (network) |
| b | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b` | 1 | `member-b` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b:33001` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-member:9096` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-member-status-token` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-indexer-b` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b` |
| c | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c` | `<INDEXER_C_ID>` | `member-c` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c:34001` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-member:9096` | `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-member-status-token` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-indexer-c` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c` |

The drill table is `<acceptance-db>.s3e_e2e` (`si_acceptance_db`, the indexer-c runbook's `acceptance-db` file), owned by indexer-c and written by the `devuser1` owner through its own local agent. Read-only:

```bash
{
  for x in a b c; do echo "$x $(si_info "$x" | jq -c '{si_indexer_id, self_indexer_id, enrolled, quarantined}')"; done
  for x in a b c; do echo "$x member $(si_kubectl get pod "$(si_member_pod "$x")" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.storage-integrity\.sentio\.xyz/member-id} {.status.phase}')"; done
  echo "acceptance database $(si_acceptance_db)"
  si_status c "$(si_acceptance_db)" s3e_e2e
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/identities.txt"
```

Expected: `a {"si_indexer_id":0,"self_indexer_id":0,"enrolled":true,"quarantined":false}`, the same for `b` with `1` and for `c` with `<INDEXER_C_ID>`; `a member member-a Running`, `b member member-b Running`, `c member member-c Running`; the acceptance database's name; `s3e_e2e` `active` on indexer-c. Anything else: stop.

### 1.3 Preconditions and baseline

- The P2 runbook is done: `P2_END` (`<P2_END>`) is recorded on the ledger copy, every member has run for 24 hours with copies equal to the published entries, zero shadow mismatches and its member disk below 50 % (§2 checks the record and the copies).
- The P3 PR (stage 0) is merged and the checkout is a detached, freshly fetched `origin/main`; every host still runs its pre-P3 host image and the `v0.15.0` agent sidecar, and every member the P2 image.
- Every SI installation is in posture C (the lockdown runbook), and the lockdown records `$si_lockdown_dir/locked-network`, `locked-indexer-b` and `locked-indexer-c` exist.
- No drill is writing, no quarantine is in force (`si_tracks` lists none) and no track lists a rejected block.
- The user has the key file of the `devuser1` owner in their own terminal; the blocks of §6.1, §6.3 and §6.5 that use it run there.

The promotion budget (Plan S3-B runbook §13.4 as merged on housegate `main` in housegate#237, through the P2 runbook's helpers), read-only:

```bash
si_budget_capture
si_budget | tee "$si_backup/budget.txt"
cp "$si_backup/budget-live-seq" "$si_backup/budget-live-seq-start"
```

Expected: one line ending `a drill spends at most <h>` with `<h>` at least `4`; a line ending `stop`, or `<h>` below `4`, stops this runbook (§9.1).

## 2. Entry checks

Read-only:

```bash
{
  echo "== P2 exit record (Plan S3-C3, P2_END=$(si_p3_pin P2_END))"
  si_run_record s3c3 "P2 members, soak and exit (Task 41)" | tee "$si_backup/p2-end-record.md"
  grep -qF "$(si_p3_pin P2_END)" "$si_backup/p2-end-record.md" || { echo "the P2 exit record does not name P2_END $(si_p3_pin P2_END); stop"; exit 1; }
  echo "== rejected rows never reach a copy (Plan S3-C2 Task 36, ARBITER_PIN_P2=$(si_p3_pin ARBITER_PIN_P2))"
  si_run_record s3c2 "arbiter pin and integration run (Task 36)" > "$si_backup/arbiter-pin-record.txt"
  grep -qF "$(si_p3_pin ARBITER_PIN_P2)" "$si_backup/arbiter-pin-record.txt" || { echo "the Task 36 run record does not name ARBITER_PIN_P2; stop"; exit 1; }
  grep -E 'PASS:? +TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement' "$si_backup/arbiter-pin-record.txt" | tee "$si_backup/rejected-rows-test.txt"
  [ -s "$si_backup/rejected-rows-test.txt" ] || { echo "no PASS line of TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement at ARBITER_PIN_P2; stop"; exit 1; }
  echo "== token Secrets (key names only, D29)"
  for x in a b c; do
    keys="$(si_kubectl get secret "$(si_host_release "$x")-si-member-status-token" -o json | jq -c '.data | keys')"
    echo "$(si_host_release "$x")-si-member-status-token $keys"
    [ "$keys" = '["status-token"]' ] || { echo "the token Secret of host $x holds $keys, not exactly status-token; stop"; exit 1; }
  done | tee "$si_backup/token-secrets.txt"
  for inst in network indexer-b indexer-c; do
    keys="$(si_kubectl get secret "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$inst" -o json | jq -c '.data | keys')"
    echo "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$inst $keys"
    case "$keys" in *status-token*) echo "the si_member password Secret of $inst holds a status-token key; stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
  done | tee -a "$si_backup/token-secrets.txt"
  echo "== lockdown records (posture C on every SI installation)"
  for inst in network indexer-b indexer-c; do
    [ -e "$si_lockdown_dir/locked-$inst" ] || { echo "no lock record $si_lockdown_dir/locked-$inst: the lockdown runbook did not lock $inst; stop"; exit 1; }
    echo "locked-$inst present"
  done
  echo "== hosts and members"
  for x in a b c; do
    si_pod_state "$(si_host_release "$x")-0"
    echo "host $x sentio-node $(si_container_image "$(si_host_release "$x")-0" sentio-node)"
    echo "host $x housegate-sidecar $(si_container_image "$(si_host_release "$x")-0" housegate-sidecar)"
    si_pod_state "$(si_member_pod "$x")"
    echo "member $x $(si_container_image "$(si_member_pod "$x")" si-member)"
  done
  echo "== copies"
  si_copies_check
  for x in a b c; do si_member_metrics "$x" '^sentio_node_si_member_(shadow_mismatches_total|foreign_tables|installs_paused)'; done
  echo "== tracks"
  si_tracks | jq -c '[.indexers[] | {id: .indexer_id, published: .published.safe_block_seq, generation: .quarantine_generation, quarantined, rejected: (.rejected_blocks | length)}]'
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/entry-checks.txt"
```

Expected: the P2 exit record (also in `p2-end-record.md`) naming `P2_END`; one PASS line of `TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement` in `rejected-rows-test.txt`, from the release-path run of `ARBITER_PIN_P2` that also carries the full 500-blocks-per-owner soak (decision D38; a pull request's short soak never counts); each `<release>-si-member-status-token` with `["status-token"]` and each `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` without `status-token` (`token-secrets.txt`; key names only, never values); every host on its pre-P3 image with the `v0.15.0` sidecar, every member on the P2 image, all `Running`; `copies equal: <n> of <n>`, `shadow_mismatches_total` 0, `foreign_tables` 0, `installs_paused` 0; three tracks, none quarantined, no rejected block. Anything else: stop.

The engine order (Plan S3-C4 Task 43: both rewrite engines resolve SI tables before remote mapping, so a replica-served table reads `hg_replica.<copy>` while its database keeps its remote mapping), pinned for the devnet2 rewriter image. The image is private: if `docker image inspect` fails, the user pulls it in their own terminal (their Artifact Registry login), from the root of the same production checkout:

```fish
set IMG (python3 -I -c 'import sys, yaml; i = yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]))["rewriter"]["image"]; print(i["repository"] + ":" + i["tag"])' k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml)
docker pull $IMG
```

The block below runs that image as a local container and housegate `<HG_TAG_P3>`'s two env-gated parity tests from a `git archive` of that tag, with the native engine's library fetched as housegate's CI fetches it (`fetch-rewriter-lib` for the `rewriter-go` version the tag's `go.mod` pins); nothing reaches the cluster.

Confirm before running.

```bash
work="$si_backup/parity"
[ ! -e "$work" ] || { echo "$work exists: the parity run ran already; read rewriter-parity.txt"; exit 1; }
image="$(python3 -I -c 'import sys, yaml; i = yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]))["rewriter"]["image"]; print(i["repository"] + ":" + i["tag"])' k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml)"
docker image inspect "$image" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$image is not pulled: the user pulls it in their own terminal first; stop"; exit 1; }
mkdir -m 700 "$work"
git -C "$(si_p3_pin HOUSEGATE_REPO)" archive "$(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3)" | tar -x -C "$work"
rg_tag="$(awk '$1 == "github.com/housegate/rewriter-go" {print $2}' "$work/go.mod")"
[ -n "$rg_tag" ] || { echo "housegate $(si_p3_pin HG_TAG_P3)'s go.mod pins no rewriter-go; stop"; exit 1; }
docker rm -f si-p3-rewriter > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
trap 'docker rm -f si-p3-rewriter > /dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
{
  echo "rewriter-go $rg_tag, rewriter image $image"
  docker run -d --rm --name si-p3-rewriter -p 127.0.0.1:50551:50051 "$image" /clickhousegate_rewriter 50051 80
  for _ in $(seq 1 120); do docker logs si-p3-rewriter 2>&1 | grep -q 'Server listening on 0.0.0.0:50051 (gRPC)' && break; sleep 1; done
  docker logs si-p3-rewriter 2>&1 | head -n 3
  ffi="$(cd "$work" && bazel run //cmd:housegate -- fetch-rewriter-lib --tag "$rg_tag" | tail -n 1)"
  echo "native library $ffi"
  (cd "$work" && bazel test //pkg/rewriter:rewriter_test --test_filter='Test(Native|GRPC)EngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping' \
    --test_env=POLYGLOT_SQL_FFI_PATH="$ffi" --test_env=HOUSEGATE_TEST_REWRITER_GRPC_ADDR=127.0.0.1:50551 --test_output=all --test_arg=-test.v --nocache_test_results)
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/rewriter-parity.txt"
grep -cE -- '--- PASS: Test(Native|GRPC)EngineReplicaTableResolvesBeforeRemoteMapping' "$si_backup/rewriter-parity.txt"
```

Expected: the rewriter image of `sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` (`housegate-rewriter:0.17.0@sha256:…`); the rewriter's log with `Server listening on 0.0.0.0:50051 (gRPC)` (on Apple silicon the `linux/amd64` image runs emulated, and `docker run` warns about the platform); a native library path ending `libpolyglot_sql_ffi.dylib`; `native rewriter engine loaded` and `connected to rewriter service service_addr=127.0.0.1:50551` in the test log; both tests `--- PASS` (never `--- SKIP`: a skipped test means its address or library did not reach it), and `2`. The container is removed when the block ends. Anything else: stop; the rewriter pin moves only together with a sentio-node pin (stage-1 runbook §11), never in this runbook.

## 3. Grants

`si_gateway` (HouseGate's upstream login) gets `GRANT SELECT ON hg_replica.*` as its last grant on every installation that hosts a member, one installation per window: indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network installation (K48). Nothing else is granted: nothing on `hg_rstage` or `hg_member_unsafe`, and no write. A users change reloads in place; no ClickHouse pod restarts. The grant exists installation-wide, so on the network installation also on the verifier ClickHouses, whose `hg_replica` is empty (a residual Plan S3-C4 records). Each window: the snapshot before, the confirmed commit and apply, the snapshot after and the grant check, then the confirmed probe.

## 4. Agent window

One host per window, in the order indexer-b, indexer-c, indexer-a, each in two commits synced at once: first its member (`W-<x>-m`: the image `<SN_COMMIT_P3>` with its serving endpoint up and serving off; a member-pod restart only), then its host (`W-<x>-h`: the host image, the `<HG_TAG_P3>` agent sidecar and the host's replica reads in one commit; one host-pod restart). The sidecar pin never merges without its sync (stage-1 runbook §11 rule), and the window keeps the sidecar's lanes `off`. Until every window is over no member serves, so no host answers `replica` yet.

Commit `W-b-m`: in `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml`, `siMember.image` = `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_COMMIT_P3>@<SN_DIGEST_P3>` (its comment names the P2 image it replaces, the rollback target) and `siMember.serve.endpoint: true` (serving stays off). ## 5. Serving on

The user upgrades their local agent (the `housegate` on their `PATH`, which `si_agent_start` runs) to `<HG_TAG_P3>` in their own terminal (decision D40), with the Homebrew tap or with the release asset checked against its `SHA256SUMS`, or an equivalent the user prefers; this runbook never installs or replaces it. With the tap:

```fish
brew update
brew upgrade housegate/housegate/housegate
housegate -version
```

Or with the release asset, which the user then installs over the `housegate` on their `PATH` themselves:

```fish
set tag <HG_TAG_P3>
set d (mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL -o $d/housegate-$tag-darwin-arm64 https://github.com/housegate/housegate/releases/download/$tag/housegate-$tag-darwin-arm64
curl -fsSL -o $d/SHA256SUMS https://github.com/housegate/housegate/releases/download/$tag/SHA256SUMS
cd $d; and grep " housegate-$tag-darwin-arm64\$" SHA256SUMS | shasum -a 256 -c -
chmod +x $d/housegate-$tag-darwin-arm64; and $d/housegate-$tag-darwin-arm64 -version
```

The check, read-only:

```bash
si_local_agent_version | tee "$si_backup/local-agent-version.txt"
```

Expected: one line starting `housegate <HG_TAG_P3> ` (housegate `pkg/version.Info`). Anything else: stop until the user has upgraded. Then one member at a time, indexer-b's first; each commit is that member's only change (a member-pod restart; the host pod is not touched).

## 6. Drill

The P3 exit (spec §16 P3, Plan S3-C4 K49): a client of a quarantined indexer-c reads safe from a member through the user's upgraded local agent. indexer-c is quarantined with the stage-2 tracks runbook's §8 flow and released afterwards; the `t_unreach` trigger is not drilled live (the code's tests exercise it). The table is `<acceptance-db>.s3e_e2e`, which indexer-c owns and indexer-a's and indexer-b's members copy. The blocks of §6.1, §6.3 and §6.5 that start the agent are the user's: they run in the user's own terminal with the `devuser1` owner's key file, which never leaves it; the others run in this runbook's session. While indexer-c is quarantined `StorageIntegrityReplicaServing` fires (warning): that is the drill.

### 6.1 Baseline write

The budget and the state first, read-only:

```bash
h="$(sed -n 's/.*a drill spends at most \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "$si_backup/budget.txt")"
[ -n "$h" ] && [ "$h" -ge 4 ] || { echo "the drill needs at least 4 promotions of budget (budget.txt: ${h:-none}); stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(si_track "$(si_c_id)" | jq -r .quarantined)" = false ] || { echo "indexer-c is quarantined already; stop"; exit 1; }
echo "budget ok: at most $h promotions; the drill writes one row"
```

Then the `devuser1` owner writes row 4 and waits until both members' copies equal the new entry (the user's block):

Confirm before running.

```bash
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
db="$(si_acceptance_db)"
{
  si_local_agent_version
  si_agent_start "$key_file"
  basec="$(si_track_published "$(si_c_id)")"
  before="$(si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "SELECT count() FROM s3e_e2e SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='safe'")"
  printf '4,p3-6.1-4\n' | si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query 'INSERT INTO s3e_e2e FORMAT CSV'
  si_wait_track "$(si_c_id)" "$basec"
  after="$(si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "SELECT count() FROM s3e_e2e SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='safe'")"
  si_agent_stop
  echo "safe count: $before before, $after after"
  [ "$after" = "$((before + 1))" ] || { echo "the safe count did not grow by one; stop"; exit 1; }
  echo "$after" > "$si_backup/drill-count"
  for n in $(seq 1 30); do si_copies_check > "$si_backup/copies-after-baseline.txt" 2>&1; grep -qE '^copies equal: ([0-9]+) of \1$' "$si_backup/copies-after-baseline.txt" && break; sleep 10; done
  cat "$si_backup/copies-after-baseline.txt"
  echo "failover lines before the quarantine: $(si_failovers | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/drill-baseline.txt"
```

Expected: `housegate <HG_TAG_P3> …` twice (the check and `si_agent_start`'s own line: the user's agent is still the upgraded one); `track <INDEXER_C_ID> published <x> -> <y>`; `safe count: <n> before, <n+1> after` (`<n>` is 3 unless an earlier runbook wrote more), recorded in `drill-count`; `copies equal: <m> of <m>`; `failover lines before the quarantine: 0`. Only on a retryable 733 for the INSERT (an owner audit or activation after §4.2), wait 35 s and run this block once more; never a third time.

### 6.2 Quarantine indexer-c

`QuarantineIndexer` names indexer-c's current `quarantine_generation`, read right before signing; after an unknown outcome read it again instead of retrying (stage-2 tracks runbook §8).

Confirm before running.

```bash
c="$(si_c_id)"
[ "$(si_track "$c" | jq -r .quarantined)" = false ] || { echo "indexer $c is already quarantined; stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(si_track "$c" | jq -r '.rejected | length')" = 0 ] || { echo "indexer $c lists rejected blocks: no drill on a track with in-flight rejected work; stop"; exit 1; }
g="$(si_tracks | jq -r --arg id "$c" '.indexers[] | select(.indexer_id == $id) | .quarantine_generation')"
echo "$g" > "$si_backup/quarantine-generation-before"
leader="$(si_leader)"
si_arbiter "$leader" /usr/local/bin/arbiter-admin indexer quarantine --address "$(si_voter "$leader")" \
  --indexer "$c" --expected-generation "$g" --reason "devnet2 stage-3 P3 runbook §6.2: replica read drill" --timeout 20s 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/quarantine.out"
```

Then, read-only (the members need the quarantine in the registry, two polls of an unchanged entry and a lease; up to 5 minutes):

```bash
c="$(si_c_id)"; db="$(si_acceptance_db)"
{
  sleep 10
  si_track "$c"
  si_info c | jq -c '{si_indexer_id, quarantined}'
  si_refusal c "$db" s3e_e2e
  for x in a b; do si_wait_serving "$x" "$db" | tee "$si_backup/serving-quarantined-$x.json"; done
  sleep 10
  for x in a b; do si_replica_status "$x" "$db" s3e_e2e | tee "$si_backup/status-replica-$x.json"; done
  for x in a b c; do si_replica_hosts "$x" | tee "$si_backup/replica-hosts-$x.json"; done
  for x in a b; do si_host_replica_metrics "$x"; done
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/verify-quarantine.txt"
```

Expected: `quarantine.out` holds the committed answer naming indexer `<INDEXER_C_ID>` and the expected generation; track `<INDEXER_C_ID>` with `generation` one above `quarantine-generation-before`, `quarantined` `true` and the reason; `si_info c` `"quarantined":true`; indexer-c answers `{"status":"refused","refused_code":"indexer_quarantined",…}`; both members serve the database (`"serving":true`, `"owner_quarantined":true`, a `lease` with `"state":"held"`, `snapshot_id` and `entry` the published ones); hosts a and b answer `{"status":"replica","replica_of":<INDEXER_C_ID>,"served_from":"<snapshot id>","owner_entry":{"indexer_id":<INDEXER_C_ID>,…},"frozen_since":<ms>,…}`; every host's `replica_hosts` lists `[0,1]` for the database, and hosts a and b list it in `replica_databases`; `sentio_node_storage_integrity_replica_serving{database="<db>"} 1` and `sentio_node_storage_integrity_tables{status="replica"}` at least 1 on hosts a and b. A member that does not serve after 5 minutes: read its `reason` in the view and §9.1, then release indexer-c (§6.4).

### 6.3 Reads from members

Twelve sessions, each a new client connection through the user's local agent (`-network devnet2`), which dials the owner indexer-c first: indexer-c refuses the read as quarantined, the agent fails it over to a replica host (`replica_hosts` minus the owner, ascending), and the host answers from its member's copy. Every read sets `SQL_x_read_mode='safe'` itself, because the agent injects `unsafe_latest` by default and a copy refuses that mode. If no failover with reason `owner_quarantined` is logged, the twelve sessions run again, at most three rounds. The user's block:

Confirm before running.

```bash
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
db="$(si_acceptance_db)"
want="$(cat "$si_backup/drill-count")"
{
  si_local_agent_version
  si_agent_start "$key_file"
  ok="" good=0
  for round in 1 2 3; do
    good=0
    for n in $(seq 1 12); do
      got="$(si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "SELECT count() FROM s3e_e2e SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='safe'" 2>&1 | tail -n 1)" || true
      echo "round $round session $n: $got"
      [ "$got" = "$want" ] && good=$((good + 1))
    done
    echo "round $round: $good of 12 sessions answered $want"
    sleep 2
    if [ "$(si_failovers | grep -c owner_quarantined)" -ge 1 ]; then ok=1; break; fi
  done
  si_agent_stop
  si_failovers
  if [ -n "$ok" ] && [ "$good" = 12 ]; then echo "failover reason owner_quarantined seen; 12 of 12 sessions answered $want"; else echo "no failover with reason owner_quarantined in three rounds, or a session of the last round answered otherwise; stop"; fi
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/drill-reads.txt"
```

Expected: `housegate <HG_TAG_P3> …`; the last round with `12 of 12 sessions answered <n>`, `<n>` the count in `drill-count` (the count published before the quarantine); at least one `agent: replica failover` line with `database` the acceptance database, `owner` `<INDEXER_C_ID>`, `reason` `owner_quarantined`, `from` indexer-c's HouseGate and `to` indexer-a's or indexer-b's; `failover reason owner_quarantined seen; 12 of 12 sessions answered <n>`. The last line ending `stop`, or a session answering anything else: release indexer-c (§6.4) and report.

Then the refusals: a write is never failed over and is refused 392 by the owner, and `unsafe_latest` on a copy is refused with the safe-mode text. The user's block:

Confirm before running.

```bash
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
db="$(si_acceptance_db)"
c="$(si_c_id)"
{
  si_agent_start "$key_file"
  quarantine='was refused: indexer_quarantined: storage-integrity indexer [0-9]+ is quarantined|is not active; the signed lane admits only active tables|is quarantined; writes to it are refused until the indexer is released \(not retryable\)'
  if out="$(printf '5,p3-6.3-refused\n' | si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query 'INSERT INTO s3e_e2e FORMAT CSV' 2>&1)"; then si_agent_stop; echo "the INSERT was accepted while indexer-c is quarantined; stop"; exit 1; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 2
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'Code: 392' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qE "$quarantine" || { si_agent_stop; echo "not the quarantine refusal of the write; stop"; exit 1; }
  if out="$(si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "SELECT count() FROM s3e_e2e SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='unsafe_latest'" 2>&1)"; then si_agent_stop; echo "unsafe_latest was answered while indexer-c is quarantined; stop"; exit 1; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 2
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF "storage_integrity read mode unsafe_latest is not available for $db.s3e_e2e: it is served read-only from a copy of indexer $c's published data; read it with SQL_x_read_mode='safe'" || { si_agent_stop; echo "not the safe-mode refusal; stop"; exit 1; }
  si_agent_stop
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/drill-refusals.txt"
```

Nothing was written: the track's published frontier does not move (§6.4 reads it).

### 6.4 Release indexer-c

After a manual quarantine the track lists no rejected block, so no `--acknowledge-rejected` is given (stage-2 tracks runbook §8.3).

Read-only: both members stop serving with reason `owner_available` and release their leases, and the hosts answer the table `ordinary` again:
````
