## 9. Operating rules

### 9.1 Replica serving

`StorageIntegrityReplicaServing` fires while a host answers a peer owner's database `replica` from its member's copy, which happens only while that owner is quarantined (`owner_quarantined`) or its HouseGate has been unreachable from the member for `ownerUnreachableAfter` (60 s by default, `t_unreach`; `StorageIntegrityOwnerUnreachableFromMember` fires for the second). While it fires, clients of that database read safe data from the copy through an agent of `<HG_TAG_P3>` or later; writes, DDL and `unsafe_latest` on it are refused (392 naming the owner, and the safe-mode text), and ordinary tables of the database still go to the owner and fail while it is down. Find the owner's state first: `si_track <id>` (quarantined?), `si_info <owner>`, and the members' views (`si_member_serving <x>`: `reason`, `owner_quarantined`, `owner_unreachable`). An unreachable owner is a host or network fault (its pod, the gateway port, a network policy from stage 3 P4): restore the owner, and the members stop serving once the owner answers again and its entry moves; whether to quarantine an owner is the user's decision. A member serves a database only while every copy equals the latest published entry, unchanged over two polls, with clean audits and no Foreign, Diverged, excluded or missing table; any other `reason` explains why it does not. Turning a member's serving off is a revert of its serving commit (§8.2), never an edit on the cluster. Every agent of devnet2 (every SI host's sidecar and every user's local agent) must run `<HG_TAG_P3>` or later before any member serves: an older client refuses the status `replica`. A drill quarantine runs only with no in-flight rejected work on its track, and a release refused for good would hold that track (stage-2 tracks runbook §11). Every drill computes its budget with `si_budget` first and spends at most half.

### 9.2 Member status endpoint

`StorageIntegrityMemberStatusUnreachable` fires when a host with replica reads cannot poll its member's serving endpoint (`sentio_node_storage_integrity_member_status_up` 0 for 5 minutes). The host then drops every Replica entry at its lease deadline (fail closed) and serves nothing from copies; its own tables are unaffected. Check the member pod (`si_member_pod <x>`, its readiness and log), its Service port `status` (9096) and the token Secrets by key names only (`si_secret_keys <release>-si-member-status-token` must list exactly `status-token`): a 401 means the host's and the member's tokens differ, which they cannot while both read the same Secret. The token is rotated only by the user, in their own terminal (a new value in the same Secret, never printed or on argv), followed by one window that restarts the member and then the host; this runbook never reads or writes it. A host's queries already running may outlive its lease deadline when it loses the endpoint (K44's residual): each MergeTree read keeps its parts snapshot, so it reads the verified rows of one of two consecutive published entries.

### 9.3 Leases

`StorageIntegrityReplicaLeaseStuck` fires when a member has waited more than 2 minutes for its host to release a serving lease before an install (`sentio_node_si_member_serve_revoking_seconds`). The member revokes a served database's lease before installing any part of it; the host drops the database's Replica entries from its next snapshot and releases the lease only once that snapshot is published and its in-flight replica reads of the database are 0 (`sentio_node_storage_integrity_replica_reads_in_flight{database}`), or the lease expires after `leaseTTL` (30 s) without a renewal. A wait that does not end means a long-running read on the copy or a host that keeps renewing: read the host's in-flight series and its log, and let the read finish or end that client's session; installs of that database are paused meanwhile, so its copy falls behind and serving stops. `sentio_node_storage_integrity_replica_lease_releases_total{outcome="expired"}` rising means hosts that go silent mid-lease. Never shorten `leaseTTL` below 10 s or raise it to cover long queries; a query that must outlive an install is K44's residual. A member records every lease in `serve-leases.json` in its state directory (`/data/si-member`, its persistent volume) before it grants or renews one, and a restarted member restores the leases that have not expired, revoked, so it installs nothing of their databases before the host releases them or they expire; never delete that file or the member's volume while its host may answer `replica`. An si-member that fails to start with `serve: lease file …` has an unreadable lease record: report it; the user decides whether to move the file aside, and only once the host lists no `replica_databases` (`si_info <x>`) and one `leaseTTL` has passed.

### 9.4 Agent failover

The agent fails a read over only at hello (the dial to the owner or its handshake fails) or at the first answer of a `SELECT` or `WITH` on a session that has issued nothing else (the owner's read-side quarantine refusal, or a connection that broke before any packet reached the client). It never fails over a write, an `INSERT … SELECT`, DDL, a session after `SET`, or a query after its first packet. Candidates are `replica_hosts[database]` in ascending indexer id, minus the owner and any indexer without a HouseGate port, one attempt each; a candidate that takes the read but answers it with the owner's quarantine refusal (its member does not serve the database) or breaks before answering counts as failed, and the agent tries the next; when every candidate fails, the client gets the original error. The injected `SQL_x_read_mode` is kept, so a copy refuses an `unsafe_latest` read with the safe-mode text; clients that must read during an owner's outage set `SQL_x_read_mode='safe'`. Failovers are logged by the agent (`agent: replica failover`, with `database`, `owner`, `reason`, `from` and `to`); the agent sidecars expose no scraped metrics, so their logs and the local agent's are the only record. Until placement is on (stage 3 P5), `replica_hosts` is every enrolled SI indexer but the owner, computed by every host from the registry, so a host whose member does not serve a database is still tried and refuses; the agent moves on. The sidecars keep lanes `off` (stage-1 runbook §11 rule); moving them to `lanes: auto` is its own window. Never roll a sidecar or the local agent back below `<HG_TAG_P3>` while any member serves (§8.2's order).
````

```python
"""The §0 chain: the first bash block of each named runbook's §0 (decision D20),
in the order given, each under a "# --- §0 of docs/<runbook>" line, read by
parsing fences line by line (decision D24). A local tool of Plan S3-C4 Task
47, never committed.

usage: chain.py <docs dir> <runbook>... > helpers.sh
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

docs = Path(sys.argv[1])
out = []
for name in sys.argv[2:]:
    lines = (docs / name).read_text().splitlines()
    start = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("## 0."))
    fence, block = None, None
    for line in lines[start + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            if line.startswith("## "):
                break
            if line.startswith("```bash"):
                fence, block = line[: len(line) - len(line.lstrip("`"))], []
            continue
        if line.rstrip() == fence:
            break
        block.append(line)
    if block is None:
        sys.exit(f"{name}: no bash block in §0")
    out.append(f"# --- §0 of docs/{name}")
    out.extend(block)
print("\n".join(out))
```

    "## 9. Operating rules", "### 9.1 Replica serving", "### 9.2 Member status endpoint", "### 9.3 Leases", "### 9.4 Agent failover",
]
ANCHORS = ("91-replica-serving", "92-member-status-endpoint", "93-leases")
MUTATING = re.compile(

def fences():
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(lines):
        m = re.match(r"^(`{3,})([A-Za-z0-9_-]*)\s*$", lines[i])
        if not m:
            i += 1
            continue
        ticks, lang, j = m.group(1), m.group(2), i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() != ticks:
            j += 1
        assert j < len(lines), f"unterminated fence at line {i + 1}"
        out.append((i, lang, "\n".join(lines[i + 1:j]) + "\n"))
        i = j + 1
    return out


def slug(heading):
    title = heading.lstrip("#").strip().lower()
    title = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]", "", title)
    return title.replace(" ", "-")


blocks = fences()
in_block = set()
for start, _, body in blocks:
    in_block.update(range(start, start + body.count("\n") + 2))
got = [l for n, l in enumerate(lines) if n not in in_block and re.match(r"#{2,3} ", l)]
assert got == WANT, "headings differ:\n" + "\n".join(f"  {a!r} | {b!r}" for a, b in zip(got + [""] * 40, WANT + [""] * 40) if a != b)
anchors = [slug(h) for h in got]
assert len(anchors) == len(set(anchors)), "two headings share an anchor"
for a in ANCHORS:
    assert a in anchors, f"anchor #{a} is missing"
print(f"headings ok ({len(got)}), anchors {', '.join(ANCHORS)}")

s0 = lines.index("## 0. Session helpers")
s1 = lines.index("## 1. Preparation")
zero = [b for b in blocks if s0 < b[0] < s1]
assert [b[1] for b in zero] == ["bash"], f"§0 holds {[b[1] for b in zero]}, expected one bash block (decision D20)"
helpers = zero[0][2]
print("one bash block in §0")

bashes = [b for b in blocks if b[1] == "bash"]
fishes = [b for b in blocks if b[1] == "fish"]
others = sorted({b[1] for b in blocks} - {"bash", "fish"})
assert not others, f"blocks of other languages: {others}"
shells = [s for s in ("bash", "/bin/bash") if shutil.which(s) or os.path.exists(s)]
bad = []
for start, _, body in bashes:
    for shell in shells:
        r = subprocess.run([shell, "-n"], input=body, text=True, capture_output=True)
        if r.returncode:
            bad.append(f"line {start + 1} ({shell}): {r.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
for start, _, body in fishes:
    r = subprocess.run(["fish", "--no-execute"], input=body, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        bad.append(f"line {start + 1} (fish): {r.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
assert not bad, "blocks do not parse:\n" + "\n".join(bad)
print(f"blocks parse ({len(bashes)} bash under {', '.join(shells)}, {len(fishes)} fish under fish --no-execute)")

missing, confirmed = [], 0
for start, lang, body in bashes:
    if s0 < start < s1:
        continue
    hits = [l for l in body.splitlines() if MUTATING.search(l)]
    if not hits:
        continue
    previous = [l for l in lines[:start] if l.strip()][-1].strip()
    if previous != "Confirm before running.":
        missing.append(f"line {start + 1}: {hits[0].strip()[:90]}")
    else:
        confirmed += 1
assert not missing, "mutating blocks without 'Confirm before running.':\n" + "\n".join(missing)
unneeded = []
for start, lang, body in bashes:
    previous = [l for l in lines[:start] if l.strip()][-1].strip()
    if previous == "Confirm before running." and not any(MUTATING.search(l) for l in body.splitlines()):
        unneeded.append(start + 1)
print(f"mutating blocks confirmed ({confirmed}); confirmed blocks the pattern does not see as mutating: {unneeded}")

wrapped = []
prose = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z`(\[*]")
for n, l in enumerate(lines):
    if n in in_block or n == 0:
        continue
    if prose.match(l) and (n - 1) not in in_block and prose.match(lines[n - 1]):
        wrapped.append(n + 1)
assert not wrapped, f"hard-wrapped prose at lines {wrapped[:10]}"
print("no hard-wrapped prose")

defined_chain = set(re.findall(r"^(si_[a-z0-9_]+)\(\) *\{", chain, re.M))
defined_here = set(re.findall(r"^(si_[a-z0-9_]+)\(\) *\{", helpers, re.M))
clash = sorted(defined_here & defined_chain)
used = set()
for start, lang, body in bashes:
    used |= set(re.findall(r"(?:^|[;&|({]|\$\(|\b(?:then|do|else|if|until|while|!))\s*(si_[a-z0-9_]+)\b(?!=)", body, re.M))
variables = set(re.findall(r"^\s*(si_[a-z0-9_]+)=", chain + "\n" + helpers, re.M))
# si_indexer_id is a jq object key of sentio_getStorageIntegrityInfo, not a command.
undefined = sorted(used - defined_chain - defined_here - variables - {"si_indexer_id"})
unused = sorted(d for d in defined_here if not any(re.search(rf"(?<![\w$]){d}(?![\w])", b) for s, _, b in bashes if not (s0 < s < s1)) and helpers.count(d) == 1)
print(f"helpers: {len(defined_here)} defined in §0, redefining from the chain: {clash}; used but undefined: {undefined}; defined but used nowhere: {unused}")
assert not undefined, f"undefined helpers {undefined}"

findings = []
preamble = "# shellcheck shell=bash\n"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    for n, (start, _, body) in enumerate(bashes):
        f = os.path.join(d, f"block-{n}.bash")
        with open(f, "w") as out:
            out.write(preamble + chain + "\n" + (helpers if not (s0 < start < s1) else "") + "\n" + body)
        r = subprocess.run(["shellcheck", "-s", "bash", "-S", "warning", "-e", "SC2034", "-f", "gcc", f], capture_output=True, text=True)
        offset = len((preamble + chain + "\n" + (helpers if not (s0 < start < s1) else "") + "\n").splitlines())
        for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
            parts = line.split(":", 3)
            if int(parts[1]) > offset or (s0 < start < s1 and int(parts[1]) > len((preamble + chain).splitlines())):
                findings.append(f"block at line {start + 1}: +{int(parts[1]) - offset}: {parts[3].strip()}")
assert not findings, "shellcheck -S warning:\n" + "\n".join(sorted(set(findings))[:60])
print(f"shellcheck -S warning clean ({len(bashes)} blocks, the §0 chain and §0 prepended)")
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Rehearse the runbook's commits and reverts (local only)**

The runbook's own helpers make Task 48's 13 single-service commits against a local bare repository whose `main` is this branch's `HEAD`: `si_p3_commit` (with `si_p3_edit`), `si_render_diff_is` with the rendered objects §3 to §5 name, `si_p3_push` (the render tests, `si_head_is`, the record, the push); then a second push of a pushed commit, which must be refused; then `si_revert_p3` of all 13 in §8's order; then eight out-of-order sequences, which `si_p3_edit` or the render tests must refuse. `HOME` is a scratch directory, `si_sync`, `si_apply_chi` and `si_wait_chi` are stubs, and nothing reaches GitHub or a cluster. Write `$HOME/.cache/s3c4-task47/rehearse.sh` with the Write tool:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Rehearses the stage-3 P3 runbook's single-service commits (§3 to §5) and their
# reverts (§8) with the runbook's own §0 helpers, against a local bare origin
# whose main is this branch's HEAD, then the out-of-order commits the render
# tests must refuse. A local tool of Plan S3-C4 Task 47, never committed: HOME
# is a scratch directory, si_sync, si_apply_chi and si_wait_chi are stubs, and
# nothing reaches GitHub or a cluster.
#
# usage: rehearse.sh <production worktree> <ledger.env> <chain.py>
set -eo pipefail
W=$1 LEDGER=$2 CHAIN=$3
L="$(mktemp -d)"
echo "rehearsal directory $L"
git init -q --bare "$L/origin.git"
git -C "$W" push -q "$L/origin.git" HEAD:refs/heads/main
git clone -q "$L/origin.git" "$L/work"
cd "$L/work"
git config user.email rehearsal@localhost
git config user.name rehearsal
git checkout -q --detach origin/main
python3 -I "$CHAIN" docs storage-integrity-devnet2-dynamic-table-set.md storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md \
  storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source-tracks.md storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-lockdown.md \
  storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c.md storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md > "$L/chain.sh"
python3 -I "$CHAIN" docs storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md > "$L/p3.sh"
export HOME="$L/home"
mkdir -p "$HOME"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$L/chain.sh" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$L/p3.sh"
# shellcheck disable=SC2154 # si_backup is set by the runbook's §0 (p3.sh)
mkdir -m 700 "$si_backup"
{ cat "$LEDGER"; echo "HOUSEGATE_REPO=$L/none"; echo "SENTIO_NODE_REPO=$L/none"; } > "$si_backup/pins"
si_sync() { echo "(stub) helmfile sync --selector name=$1"; }
si_apply_chi() { echo "(stub) kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f $1; kubectl apply -f $1; wait for $2"; }
si_wait_chi() { echo "(stub) wait for $1"; }
step() { # $1 label, $2 commit record, $3 release or empty, then the objects its render must change
  local label="$1" record="$2" rel="$3" files
  shift 3
  files="$(si_p3_commit "$label")"
  if [ -n "$rel" ]; then si_render_diff_is "$rel" "$@" 2> "$L/diff-$label.err" | tail -n 1; fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  si_p3_push "$record" $files > "$L/push-$label.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 20 "$L/push-$label.log"; return 1; }
  echo "$label pushed ($(grep -E '^(OK|FAILED)' "$L/push-$label.log")): $(git log -1 --format=%s)"
}
step G-b grant-indexer-b-commit ""
step G-c grant-indexer-c-commit ""
step G-n grant-network-commit storage-integrity-si-v2 "changed ClickHouseInstallation/storage-integrity-si-v2"
for x in b c a; do
  step "W-$x-m" "window-$x-member-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x" \
    "changed ConfigMap/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-si-member-config" "changed StatefulSet/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-si-member"
  step "W-$x-h" "window-$x-host-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x" \
    "changed ConfigMap/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-node-config" "changed StatefulSet/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x"
done
for x in b c a; do
  step "S-$x" "serve-$x-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x" \
    "changed ConfigMap/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-si-member-config" "changed StatefulSet/sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-si-member"
done
step M monitoring-commit storage-integrity-si-v2 "changed VMRule/storage-integrity-si-v2"
if si_p3_push monitoring-commit k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml > "$L/repush.log" 2>&1; then
  echo "si_p3_push pushed a commit twice"; exit 1
fi
grep -o 'that commit was pushed already; never re-run a confirmed block' "$L/repush.log"
revert() { si_revert_p3 "$1" "$2" > "$L/revert-$1.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 20 "$L/revert-$1.log"; return 1; }; echo "reverted $1 ($(grep -E '^(OK|FAILED)' "$L/revert-$1.log"))"; }
revert monitoring-commit storage-integrity-si-v2
for x in a c b; do revert "serve-$x-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x"; done
for x in a c b; do
  revert "window-$x-host-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x"
  revert "window-$x-member-commit" "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x"
done
revert grant-network-commit storage-integrity-si-v2
revert grant-indexer-c-commit chi:k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source.yaml:storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c
revert grant-indexer-b-commit chi:k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source.yaml:storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b
git fetch -q origin main
git diff --quiet "$(git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD)" origin/main && echo "after the 13 reverts every file is the PR's again"
# Out of order: the last label of each sequence is refused by si_p3_edit or by the render tests.
for seq in "G-n" "W-b-m" "G-b G-c G-n W-b-h" "G-b G-c G-n W-c-m" "G-b G-c G-n W-b-m W-b-h W-a-m" "S-b" \
  "G-b G-c G-n W-b-m W-b-h W-c-m W-c-h W-a-m W-a-h S-c" "G-b G-c G-n W-b-m W-b-h W-c-m W-c-h W-a-m W-a-h S-b M"; do
  git checkout -q --detach "$(git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD)"
  last=${seq##* }
  for label in $seq; do
    if ! files="$(si_p3_edit "$label" 2> "$L/edit.err")"; then echo "[$seq] $label: refused by si_p3_edit: $(tail -n 1 "$L/edit.err")"; git checkout -q -- .; break; fi
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    git commit -q -m "$label" -- $files
    if [ "$label" = "$last" ]; then
      if python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py > "$L/negative.log" 2>&1; then echo "[$seq] $label: the render tests passed; stop"; exit 1; fi
      grep -qE '^FAILED' "$L/negative.log" || { echo "[$seq] $label: the render tests did not finish: $(tail -n 2 "$L/negative.log")"; exit 1; }
      echo "[$seq] $label: refused by the render tests ($(grep -E '^FAILED' "$L/negative.log"))"
    fi
  done
done

## Task 48: devnet2 — stage-3 P3 reads from members (live): entry checks, grants, the agent window, serving on, the quarantine drill of indexer-c, exit (S3-C4)

Contract §32.4–§32.7, as clarified by K44–K50 and decisions D19, D24, D29, D38 and D40. The task executes `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md` (Task 47, merged with `P3_PR`) §1 to §7 on devnet2, section by section and block by block, in K47's binding order: entry checks → the grants (indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network installation) → the agent window (indexer-b, indexer-c, indexer-a; per host the member commit with serving off, then the host commit with the `HG_TAG_P3` agent sidecar and `storage_integrity.replica_reads`, each synced at once) → the check of the user's own upgrade of their local agent to `HG_TAG_P3` (D40) → serving on, one member at a time, and the replica-read rules → the drill (one baseline row of `<acceptance-db>.s3e_e2e`, the quarantine of indexer-c, safe reads through the user's agent from both members, the refusals, the release, serving ends) → the exit record `P3_END`. The runbook is the source of truth for every check, helper, commit edit, value and evidence name (D19). This task adds:
- the session and its block files (D24), each runbook block copied byte for byte from the merged runbook by `p3_block`;
- an independent check of each of the runbook's thirteen commits before its push: `p3_preview` makes the commit with the runbook's own `si_p3_edit` on a throwaway clone at the same `origin/main` and checks it against `p3-edit.py`, which rebuilds contract §32.5 from the parsed files instead of trusting `si_p3_edit`, then runs the render tests and the render diff; after the runbook's confirmed block, `p3_pushed_is` checks that the pushed commit is the previewed one;
- a rehearsal of all thirteen commits and their reverts before any live change (Step 3);
- its own read-only checks around every window: pod restarts, the D29 token references of every container and volume of each host pod, the serving views, `replica_hosts`, the owner-probe targets, the alerts;
- the gates and confirmations, the user's four drill blocks as scripts the user runs in their own terminal, the outcome record PR, and the Appendix C record of `P3_END` with the run record `P3 run`.

Nothing here changes the consensus format, a voter, arbiter or arbiter-proto (contract §0, §7). The drill's quarantine and release of indexer-c (`INDEXER_C_ID`) are the only consensus writes: two authority-signed commands outside the consensus update, each confirmed, which leave indexer-c's `quarantine_generation` two higher for good (harmless). Every commit is undone by its own revert (runbook §8; "What rollback means here" at the end of this task), so no step is irreversible. What stays: indexer-a's acceptance value `5301` in `devnet101.swap_new2`, row `(4, 'p3-6.1-4')` of `<acceptance-db>.s3e_e2e` and their two promotions, spent within half of the promotion budget.

**Conventions for this task.**
- **Session and block files (D24, S3-B §15).** The agent runs every bash block of Steps 1–23, this task's and the runbook's, from a block file, never inside a heredoc: this task's blocks carry their own `<<'PY'` heredocs and the runbook's carry theirs. Block files are `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3-session/blocks/<nnn>-<what>.sh` (`<nnn>` counts up from `002` in the order the files are written, one numbering for both kinds; a file is never edited or reused once it ran). The agent writes this task's block files with the Write tool, the first three lines being

  ```bash
  source "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3-session/helpers.sh"
  source "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3-session/task48/task48.sh"
  cd "$P" || exit 1
  ```

  followed by the block. A runbook block's file is written by `p3_block <section> <n> <confirmed|read-only> [<old line> <new line>]…` (called from a block of this task) as the next numbered file `<nnn>-runbook-<section>-<n>.sh`, whose path it prints: the same three lines, then the `<n>`th bash block of that runbook section of the live checkout's runbook, byte for byte, after checking that it is of the kind the step names and that it parses; only the runtime placeholder lines a step names are replaced, whole (§1.1's clone line, §8.2's `x=a`). Each file runs with the Bash tool as `bash -eo pipefail "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3-session/blocks/<nnn>-<what>.sh" < /dev/null` (the Bash tool's own shell is zsh, so a block never runs in it directly, and no command of a block can read the tool's stdin). Step 1's first two blocks have no preamble and run from fresh files in the agent's session scratchpad; its third runs from `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p3-session/blocks/001-helpers.sh` without the preamble (it builds `helpers.sh`). A block that may wait longer than 10 minutes runs with `run_in_background: true`; read its output before the next step. A read-only block may run again from a new file; a confirmed block never does.
- **Runbook blocks (D19).** "Runbook §X block n" is the `n`th bash block of section §X of the merged runbook, counted as `p3_runbook_shape` counts them. A block preceded by `Confirm before running.` runs only after the step's gate has its yes. A confirmed block that stopped is never re-run as is: report its output (Commits below says what to do for a commit block). The runbook's checks are its own and bind; this task's checks come in addition, and a `stop` from either stops. If the runbook and this task disagree on what changes (a file, a value, a release, an order), stop and report before running either; never edit the runbook here (a runbook defect is Task 47's to fix in a reviewed PR).
- **Explicit user confirmation.** Every remote or live mutation waits for an explicit yes in chat, given for that block only, and each step says so in its own line: each push to production `main` with its apply or sync (the thirteen commit blocks), each probe as `si_gateway`, indexer-a's acceptance write, each drill script the user runs, the quarantine, the release, every revert, the parity run of Step 4 (a download and a local container), the record PR's push, creation and merge, and the housegate ledger push, PR and merge. Before asking, the agent states the step's Gate sentence, saying exactly what will change, and shows the runbook block that will run. Read-only blocks (`kubectl get`/`logs`/`describe`/`diff`, an `exec` that only reads, the `si_*` read helpers, `git fetch`, `gh pr view`, `helmfile template`, local files and the throwaway clones) need none.
- **The user's terminal (D40).** The user upgrades their local agent (Step 11) and runs the four drill scripts (Steps 16, 18 and 20) in their own fish terminal; the agent never installs or replaces the user's `housegate`, never runs a drill script and never sees the `devuser1` owner's key (its file's path is not the key; `si_agent_start` keeps it only in `HOUSEGATE_AGENT_KEY`). Each script is the runbook's user block verbatim but for its `key_file=` line, which takes the path from the script's one argument; it sources `helpers.sh` and runs in the live checkout, once, after the agent's marker for it (`p3_clear`). The scripts need `housegate`, `clickhouse-client`, `jq`, `kubectl` for `sentio-sea` and no `HOUSEGATE_*` variable. Commands handed to the user are fish.
- **Passwords and tokens (D29, K16).** No step reads, prints or passes a password or the member status token. Secrets are inspected only by their key names (the runbook's `kubectl get secret … | jq '.data | keys'`, `si_secret_keys`), pods only by the names of the Secrets and env variables their containers and volumes reference (`p3_secret_refs`), the serving view only through `si_member_serving` (which never prints the token), and ClickHouse passwords move only through `si_ch_admin` and `si_ch_exec`.
- **Windows and turns.** Each of Steps 5–10 and 12–15 holds its own windows: one installation, one member or one host, pushed and synced or applied at once; never two of them at once. After a window's last check, report it and end the turn; the next window starts when the user asks for it. The agent-sidecar pin never merges without its sync (stage-1 runbook §11 rule): a pushed host commit whose sync failed is synced again or reverted (its own confirmed step) before anything else. From Step 2 until Step 21 run no other sync, apply, restart or pod deletion against devnet2-si-v2's installations, hosts or members, no consensus update, no other write drill, and no helmfile on `k8s-sea/clickhouse` (K22).
- **Commits.** Before each commit block, `p3_fresh_main` holds the live checkout clean, detached and equal to a freshly fetched `origin/main`, and `p3_preview <label>` makes that commit on a throwaway clone of the same `origin/main` with the runbook's `si_p3_edit`, checks it with `p3-edit.py` (the files, the stage before and after, the content against contract §32.5) and the render tests, renders it and records its tree; the runbook's confirmed block then makes the same commit in the live checkout (`si_p3_commit` refuses unless the checkout is a clean `origin/main` after its own fetch) and pushes it; `p3_pushed_is <label>` checks the pushed commit against the preview. If the block stopped in `si_p3_commit` (main moved: nothing was committed), run `p3_fresh_main` and a new preview (each `p3_preview` makes a new clone `preview-<label>-<n>`), copy the block again and ask again. If it stopped after the local commit and before the push (the render tests or `si_head_is` failed), the commit was never pushed: report, and on the user's word drop it with `git switch -q --detach origin/main` after a fetch. If the push itself was refused, `si_p3_push` has already written the commit record: `p3_pushed_is` says the commit is not on `origin/main`; report, and only on the user's word move the record aside (`mv "$si_backup/<record>" "$si_backup/<record>.unpushed"`), drop the local commit as above, preview again and ask again. A push is never forced.
- **Stop rules.** Stop on any unexpected output and report it; never improvise a fix on the cluster, and never edit a test, a template or the runbook here (a failing render test or a runbook defect is Task 47's to fix in a reviewed PR). Above all: a member that reports an owner unreachable while it is up, or serves while every owner is available (ask at once for that member's serving revert, runbook §8.2, before its 60 s `ownerUnreachableAfter` plus two polls can let a wrong probe address serve); a host pod that restarts in a member window, or more than once in its own; a token or password reference outside what D29 allows; a `replica` answer before Step 17 or after Step 20; a write the drill did not plan; a release that is refused (case (b) of spec §2 belongs to Plan S3-D's settle: stop and ask); a preview whose check fails, or a pushed commit that is not the previewed one; and every check below that prints `stop`.

`p3-helpers.py`, which builds `helpers.sh` from the §0 chain of the P3 runbook and copies runbook blocks (the extractor of Plan S3-B Tasks 15, 18 and 21, with `map` and `block` added):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reads runbook blocks for Plan S3-C4 Task 48 (the extractor of Plan S3-B Tasks 15, 18 and 21,
with block and map added). A throwaway tool of the live task, never committed.

  p3-helpers.py chain DOCS_DIR RUNBOOK               the session helpers, earlier runbooks first
  p3-helpers.py map RUNBOOK                          per section, the kind of each bash block
  p3-helpers.py block RUNBOOK SECTION N KIND [OLD NEW]...
                                                     the Nth bash block of SECTION, verbatim

chain: a runbook's "## 0. Session helpers" names the earlier runbooks whose §0 helpers it builds
on (Markdown links before its first bash block) and holds its own in that first bash block
(decision D20); this prints them depth first, each runbook once, each behind a comment naming it.

map: one line "<section> <kinds>" for every section ("## <n>. ..." or "### <n>.<m> ...") that
holds a bash block, its blocks in order, "c" for a block preceded by the line "Confirm before
running." and "r" for any other.

block: prints the Nth (1 = first) bash block of SECTION, its lines between the headings of
SECTION and the next heading; KIND is "confirmed" or "read-only" and must match. Each OLD is a
whole line of the block that must occur exactly once and is replaced by NEW (only the runtime
placeholder lines a step names).

Blocks are found by their fences, line by line (decision D24): a fence closes only on a line of
at least as many backquotes and nothing else, so a Python string that holds three backquotes, or
a heredoc's EOF, never ends a block.
"""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FENCE = re.compile(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$")
HEADING = re.compile(r"^(?:## (\d+)\. |### (\d+\.\d+) )")
CONFIRM = "Confirm before running."


def blocks(path):
    """Every fenced block of the file: (section, language, kind, lines), in order."""
    lines = Path(path).read_text().split("\n")
    out, section, i = [], None, 0
    while i < len(lines):
        heading = HEADING.match(lines[i])
        if heading:
            section = heading.group(1) or heading.group(2)
            i += 1
            continue
        opening = FENCE.fullmatch(lines[i])
        if not opening:
            i += 1
            continue
        fence, language = opening.group(1), opening.group(2)
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and not re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", lines[j]):
            j += 1
        if j == len(lines):
            sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: {path}: the block at line {i + 1} never closes")
        k = i - 1
        while k >= 0 and not lines[k].strip():
            k -= 1
        kind = "confirmed" if k >= 0 and lines[k].strip() == CONFIRM else "read-only"
        out.append((section, language, kind, lines[i + 1:j]))
        i = j + 1
    return out


def section_zero(path):
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    if "## 0. Session helpers" not in lines:
        sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: {path} has no '## 0. Session helpers' section")
    intro, block, fence = [], None, None
    for line in lines[lines.index("## 0. Session helpers") + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            opening = FENCE.fullmatch(line)
            if opening:
                fence = opening.group(1)
                if opening.group(2) == "bash":
                    block = []
            elif line.startswith("## "):
                break
            else:
                intro.append(line)
        elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
            if block is not None:
                earlier = re.findall(r"\]\((storage-integrity-devnet2-[a-z0-9-]+\.md)\)", "\n".join(intro))
                return earlier, "\n".join(block) + "\n"
            fence = None
        elif block is not None:
            block.append(line)
    sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: {path}: no complete bash block in section 0")


def collect(docs, name, seen, out):
    if name in seen:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    earlier, block = section_zero(docs / name)
    for other in earlier:
        collect(docs, other, seen, out)
    out.append((name, block))


def chain(argv):
    if len(argv) != 2:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    out = []
    collect(Path(argv[0]), argv[1], set(), out)
    for name, block in out:
        print(f"# --- §0 of docs/{name}")
        print(block, end="")
    print("# --- end of runbook helpers: " + " ".join(name for name, _ in out), file=sys.stderr)


def shape(argv):
    if len(argv) != 1:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    kinds = {}
    for section, language, kind, _ in blocks(argv[0]):
        if language == "bash" and section is not None:
            kinds.setdefault(section, []).append("c" if kind == "confirmed" else "r")
    for section, ks in kinds.items():
        print(f"{section} {' '.join(ks)}")


def block(argv):
    if len(argv) < 4 or len(argv) % 2:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    path, section, n, want = argv[0], argv[1], int(argv[2]), argv[3]
    if want not in ("confirmed", "read-only"):
        sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: KIND is confirmed or read-only, not {want!r}")
    found = [b for b in blocks(path) if b[0] == section and b[1] == "bash"]
    if not 1 <= n <= len(found):
        sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: section {section} of {path} holds {len(found)} bash block(s), not a block {n}; stop")
    _, _, kind, lines = found[n - 1]
    if kind != want:
        sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: block {n} of section {section} is {kind}, not {want}; stop")
    lines = list(lines)
    pairs = argv[4:]
    for old, new in zip(pairs[0::2], pairs[1::2]):
        hits = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == old]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"p3-helpers: block {n} of section {section} holds the line {old!r} {len(hits)} times, not once; stop")
        lines[hits[0]] = new
    print("\n".join(lines))


def main(argv):
    if not argv:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    command = {"chain": chain, "map": shape, "block": block}.get(argv[0])
    if command is None:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    command(argv[1:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`p3-edit.py`, the independent check of the thirteen commits against contract §32.5 (it reads every stage's facts from the files and test constants, makes its own edit of a stage for comparison, and compares a checkout's files with that edit by content):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The independent check of the thirteen single-service commits of Plan S3-C4
Task 48 (contract §32.5), which the P3 runbook's si_p3_edit makes. A throwaway
tool of the live task, never committed.

  p3-edit.py LEDGER_ENV state            the stage the checkout is at
  p3-edit.py LEDGER_ENV check            the P3 PR's constants against the ledger
  p3-edit.py LEDGER_ENV apply STAGE      this tool's own edit of STAGE (nothing is committed)
  p3-edit.py LEDGER_ENV files STAGE      the files STAGE changes, sorted
  p3-edit.py LEDGER_ENV same DIR FILE... FILE has the content of DIR/FILE

Run from the root of a production checkout. LEDGER_ENV holds the NAME=VALUE
lines that s3-ledger.py get printed. The rollout is one sequence of stages,
each one single-service commit:

  pr -> G-b -> G-c -> G-n -> W-b-m -> W-b-h -> W-c-m -> W-c-h -> W-a-m -> W-a-h
     -> S-b -> S-c -> S-a -> M

state reads every stage's facts from the files and from the rollout constants
of test_render.py, refuses a stage whose files and constants disagree or a
set of done stages that is not a prefix of the sequence, prints one line per
stage and, last, "stage <name>" (the last done stage, "pr" when none is).
apply refuses unless the checkout is at the stage before STAGE, edits only
the lines of STAGE, and writes nothing unless every edited YAML file loads to
exactly the intended values; it then imports test_render.py again and
restores every file it wrote unless exactly the intended constants changed.
It prints "applied <STAGE>" and "files: <the changed files>". same compares
the runbook's edit with this tool's: equal YAML documents for a .yaml file,
an equal syntax tree for a .py file and equal bytes for any other, so their
comments may differ and their values may not.
"""

import ast
import copy
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

D = "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/"
TESTS = "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
NETWORK = D + "storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
EXAMPLE = "docs/examples/storage-integrity-fresh-source-image.yaml"
RUNBOOK = "docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md"
REPLICA_GRANT = "GRANT SELECT ON hg_replica.*"
OLD_SIDECAR_TAG = "v0.15.0@sha256:1b51de76b7b7a15a8006d0ac06febb10012c74c92d4950d07e4e5a5b77b3570f"
SIDECAR_REPOSITORY = "ghcr.io/housegate/housegate"
NODE_REPOSITORY = "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node"
STATUS_PORT = 9096
HOUSEGATE_PORTS = {"a": 32001, "b": 33001, "c": 34001}
SEQUENCE = ("pr", "G-b", "G-c", "G-n", "W-b-m", "W-b-h", "W-c-m", "W-c-h", "W-a-m", "W-a-h", "S-b", "S-c", "S-a", "M")
CHI = {"b": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "c": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c", "n": "storage-integrity-si-v2"}
SOURCE_CONSTANT = {"a": "FRESH_SOURCE_IMAGE", "b": "INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE", "c": "INDEXER_C_SOURCE_IMAGE"}
SECTION = {
    "G-b": "3.1", "G-c": "3.2", "G-n": "3.3", "W-b-m": "4.1", "W-b-h": "4.1", "W-c-m": "4.2", "W-c-h": "4.2",
    "W-a-m": "4.3", "W-a-h": "4.3", "S-b": "5.1", "S-c": "5.2", "S-a": "5.3", "M": "5.4",
}
LEDGER_FORMS = {
    "HG_TAG_P3": r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+",
    "HG_DIGEST_P3": r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",
    "CORE_TAG_P3": r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+",
    "SN_COMMIT_P3": r"[0-9a-f]{40}",
    "SN_DIGEST_P3": r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",
    "SN_COMMIT_P2": r"[0-9a-f]{40}",
    "SN_DIGEST_P2": r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",
    "INDEXER_C_ID": r"[0-9]+",
}


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p3-edit: {message}; stop")


def release(x):
    return f"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-{x}"


def overlay(x):
    return f"{D}sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"


def source_pin(x):
    return f"{D}sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml"


def chi_file(g):
    return f"{D}storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-{g}-source.yaml"


def member_url(x):
    return f"http://{release(x)}-si-member:{STATUS_PORT}"


def token_secret(x):
    return f"{release(x)}-si-member-status-token"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ ledger and pins


class Pins:
    def __init__(self, path):
        values = {}
        for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            name, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            if not sep:
                fail(f"{path}: {line!r} is not NAME=VALUE")
            values[name.strip()] = value.strip()
        for name, form in LEDGER_FORMS.items():
            if not re.fullmatch(form, values.get(name, "")):
                fail(f"{path}: {name} is {values.get(name)!r}, not of the form {form}")
        if values["INDEXER_C_ID"] in ("0", "1"):
            fail(f"INDEXER_C_ID {values['INDEXER_C_ID']} is indexer-a's or indexer-b's id")
        self.v = values
        self.p2_image = f"{NODE_REPOSITORY}:sha-{values['SN_COMMIT_P2']}@{values['SN_DIGEST_P2']}"
        self.p3_tag = f"sha-{values['SN_COMMIT_P3']}@{values['SN_DIGEST_P3']}"
        self.p3_image = f"{NODE_REPOSITORY}:{self.p3_tag}"
        self.sidecar_tag = f"{values['HG_TAG_P3']}@{values['HG_DIGEST_P3']}"
        self.sidecar = f"{SIDECAR_REPOSITORY}:{self.sidecar_tag}"
        self.old_sidecar = f"{SIDECAR_REPOSITORY}:{OLD_SIDECAR_TAG}"
        self.ids = {"a": "0", "b": "1", "c": values["INDEXER_C_ID"]}
        self.housegate = {self.ids[x]: f"{release(x)}:{HOUSEGATE_PORTS[x]}" for x in "abc"}

    def owner_housegate_without(self, x):
        return {k: v for k, v in sorted(self.housegate.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])) if k != self.ids[x]}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ test_render.py constants

IMPORT = r"""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
import test_render as t
def plain(v):
    if isinstance(v, (set, frozenset)):
        return sorted(plain(x) for x in v)
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [plain(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {str(k): plain(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    if v is None or isinstance(v, (bool, int, float, str)):
        return v
    return "<%s %r>" % (type(v).__name__, v)
print(json.dumps({n: plain(getattr(t, n)) for n in sorted(vars(t)) if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*", n)}))
"""


def constants():
    """Every module-level ALL_CAPS name of test_render.py, imported in a fresh, isolated interpreter."""
    run = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "-c", "import re\n" + IMPORT, str(Path(TESTS).parent.resolve())],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
    )
    if run.returncode != 0:
        tail = run.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1] if run.stderr.strip() else str(run.returncode)
        fail(f"cannot import {TESTS}: {tail}")
    return json.loads(run.stdout)


def need(consts, *names):
    missing = [n for n in names if n not in consts]
    if missing:
        fail(f"{TESTS} defines none of {missing} (the P3 PR, Task 47, adds them)")


class TestSource:
    """Edits of single module-level assignments in test_render.py."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.old = Path(TESTS).read_text()
        self.text = self.old
        self.edited = set()

    def _assignment(self, name):
        hits = [n for n in ast.parse(self.text).body
                if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
                and n.targets[0].id == name]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            fail(f"{TESTS} assigns {name} {len(hits)} times at module level; expected once")
        return hits[0]

    def _offset(self, lineno, col):
        lines = self.text.encode().splitlines(keepends=True)
        return len(b"".join(lines[:lineno - 1]).decode()) + len(lines[lineno - 1][:col].decode())

    def defined_before(self, name, other):
        """Whether NAME is assigned at module level on a line before OTHER's assignment."""
        line = self._assignment(other).lineno
        return any(isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == name for t in n.targets)
                   and n.lineno < line for n in ast.parse(self.text).body)

    def replace_statement(self, name, new_text, comment=None, replace_comment_if=None):
        """Replaces NAME's whole assignment by NEW_TEXT (whole lines); with COMMENT, the
        comment lines directly above it are replaced by COMMENT when they mention
        REPLACE_COMMENT_IF (else COMMENT goes above them)."""
        node = self._assignment(name)
        lines = self.text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        first, last = node.lineno - 1, node.end_lineno
        if node.col_offset != 0 or lines[last - 1].encode()[node.end_col_offset:].strip() not in (b"",):
            fail(f"{TESTS}: {name} does not occupy whole lines of its own")
        top = first
        if comment is not None:
            above = first
            while above > 0 and lines[above - 1].startswith("#"):
                above -= 1
            block = "".join(lines[above:first])
            if replace_comment_if and re.search(replace_comment_if, block, re.I):
                top = above
            new_text = "".join(f"{c}\n" for c in comment) + new_text
        lines[top:last] = [new_text]
        self.text = "".join(lines)
        self.edited.add(name)

    def replace_dict_value(self, name, key, new_source):
        node = self._assignment(name)
        if not isinstance(node.value, ast.Dict):
            fail(f"{TESTS}: {name} is not a dict literal")
        hits = [v for k, v in zip(node.value.keys, node.value.values)
                if k is not None and isinstance(k, ast.Constant) and k.value == key]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            fail(f"{TESTS}: {name} has {len(hits)} entries {key!r}; expected one")
        value = hits[0]
        start = self._offset(value.lineno, value.col_offset)
        end = self._offset(value.end_lineno, value.end_col_offset)
        self.text = self.text[:start] + new_source + self.text[end:]
        self.edited.add(name)

    def check_rest_unchanged(self):
        def rest(text):
            return [ast.dump(n) for n in ast.parse(text).body
                    if not (isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
                            and n.targets[0].id in self.edited)]
        if rest(self.old) != rest(self.text):
            fail(f"the edit changed {TESTS} beyond {sorted(self.edited)}")


def image_statement(name, image):
    head, at, digest = image.partition("@")
    return f"{name} = (\n    {json.dumps(head)}\n    {json.dumps(at + digest)}\n)\n"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ YAML line edits


def read_lines(path):
    return Path(path).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)


def indent_of(line):
    return len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))


def is_blank(line):
    return not line.strip()


def key_lines(lines, start, end, indent, key):
    pattern = re.compile(r"^ {%d}%s:(\s|$)" % (indent, re.escape(key)))
    return [i for i in range(start, end) if pattern.match(lines[i])]


def block_end(lines, start):
    """The index after the last line of the block that starts at lines[start]:
    every later line indented deeper, or a list item at its own indent; a blank
    line, a comment or a key at its indent or less ends it (that comment belongs
    to the next key)."""
    base = indent_of(lines[start])
    last = start
    for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)):
        line = lines[i]
        if is_blank(line):
            continue
        if indent_of(line) > base or (indent_of(line) == base and line.lstrip(" ").startswith("- ")):
            last = i
            continue
        break
    return last + 1


def one_key(lines, start, end, indent, key, where):
    hits = key_lines(lines, start, end, indent, key)
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one '{' ' * indent}{key}:' line, found {len(hits)}")
    return hits[0]


def top_key(lines, key, where):
    i = one_key(lines, 0, len(lines), 0, key, where)
    return i, block_end(lines, i)


def child_indent(lines, start, end, where):
    for i in range(start + 1, end):
        if not is_blank(lines[i]) and not lines[i].lstrip(" ").startswith("#"):
            return indent_of(lines[i])
    fail(f"{where}: the block at line {start + 1} is empty")


def set_scalar_line(lines, i, value, where):
    """Replaces the scalar of 'key: <scalar>' at lines[i], keeping its quoting style and a trailing comment."""
    m = re.match(r'^(\s*[A-Za-z0-9_]+:\s*)("?)([^"#\s]*)("?)(\s*(#.*)?)$', lines[i].rstrip("\n"))
    if not m or m.group(2) != m.group(4):
        fail(f"{where}: line {i + 1} is not a plain or double-quoted scalar: {lines[i].rstrip()!r}")
    lines[i] = f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}{value}{m.group(4)}{m.group(5)}\n"


def insert_at_block_end(lines, start, new_lines):
    end = block_end(lines, start)
    if not lines[end - 1].endswith("\n"):
        lines[end - 1] += "\n"
    lines[end:end] = new_lines
    return end


def replace_comment_above(lines, i, comment):
    """Replaces the comment lines directly above lines[i] (same indent) by COMMENT."""
    pad = " " * indent_of(lines[i])
    top = i
    while top > 0 and lines[top - 1].startswith(pad + "#"):
        top -= 1
    lines[top:i] = [f"{pad}{c}\n" if c else f"{pad.rstrip()}#\n" for c in comment]


def write_checked(path, lines, expected_doc, where):
    text = "".join(lines)
    try:
        got = yaml.safe_load(text)
    except yaml.YAMLError as e:
        fail(f"the edited {where} is not YAML: {e}")
    if got != expected_doc:
        fail(f"the edited {where} is not exactly the intended change")
    return text


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ facts per stage


def load(path):
    if not Path(path).is_file():
        fail(f"{path} is missing")
    return yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text())


def chi_doc(g):
    docs = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(Path(chi_file(g)).read_text()) if d]
    if [(d.get("kind"), d.get("metadata", {}).get("name")) for d in docs] != [("ClickHouseInstallation", CHI[g])]:
        fail(f"{chi_file(g)} is not the one ClickHouseInstallation {CHI[g]}")
    return docs[0]


def gateway_grants(g):
    users = chi_doc(g)["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]
    grants = users.get("si_gateway/grants/query")
    if not isinstance(grants, list) or not grants:
        fail(f"{chi_file(g)}: si_gateway/grants/query is not a non-empty list")
    return grants


def grant_done(g, consts):
    if g == "n":
        access = ((load(NETWORK).get("clickhouse") or {}).get("access") or {})
        if access.get("replicaReads") not in (None, False, True):
            fail(f"{NETWORK}: clickhouse.access.replicaReads is {access.get('replicaReads')!r}")
        done = access.get("replicaReads") is True
    else:
        grants = gateway_grants(g)
        count = grants.count(REPLICA_GRANT)
        if count > 1 or (count == 1 and grants[-1] != REPLICA_GRANT):
            fail(f"{chi_file(g)}: {REPLICA_GRANT} is not si_gateway's last grant, once")
        done = count == 1
    flag = consts["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS"].get(CHI[g])
    if flag is not done:
        fail(f"{CHI[g]}: the grant is {'in' if done else 'not in'} the manifest, DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS says {flag!r}")
    return done


def member_done(x, pins):
    m = load(overlay(x)).get("siMember")
    if not isinstance(m, dict) or m.get("enabled") is not True:
        fail(f"{overlay(x)}: siMember is not the enabled P2 member block")
    serve = m.get("serve") or {}
    if m.get("image") == pins.p3_image and serve.get("endpoint") is True:
        return True
    if m.get("image") == pins.p2_image and serve.get("endpoint") in (None, False) and serve.get("enabled") in (None, False):
        return False
    fail(f"{overlay(x)}: siMember.image {m.get('image')!r} with serve {serve!r} is neither the P2 member nor the P3 member")


def host_done(x, pins, consts):
    pin = load(source_pin(x))["node"]["image"]
    o = load(overlay(x))
    sidecar = o["housegateSidecar"]["image"]
    reads = (o.get("storageIntegrity") or {}).get("replicaReads")
    want_reads = {"memberStatusURL": member_url(x), "memberStatusTokenSecret": {"name": token_secret(x), "key": "status-token"}}
    facts = (pin.get("tag") == pins.p3_tag, sidecar.get("tag") == pins.sidecar_tag, reads == want_reads)
    if pin.get("repository") != NODE_REPOSITORY or sidecar.get("repository") != SIDECAR_REPOSITORY:
        fail(f"indexer-{x}: unexpected image repositories {pin.get('repository')!r}, {sidecar.get('repository')!r}")
    if all(facts):
        done = True
    elif not any(facts) and sidecar.get("tag") == OLD_SIDECAR_TAG and reads is None:
        done = False
    else:
        fail(f"indexer-{x}: host image P3 {facts[0]}, sidecar P3 {facts[1]}, replicaReads {reads!r}: one commit moves all three")
    r = release(x)
    image = f"{pin['repository']}:{pin['tag']}"
    if consts[SOURCE_CONSTANT[x]] != image:
        fail(f"{SOURCE_CONSTANT[x]} is {consts[SOURCE_CONSTANT[x]]!r}, the pin is {image!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES"].get(r) != (pins.sidecar if done else pins.old_sidecar):
        fail(f"DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES[{r!r}] is {consts['DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES'].get(r)!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS"].get(r, "missing") != (member_url(x) if done else None):
        fail(f"DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS[{r!r}] is {consts['DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS'].get(r, 'missing')!r}")
    if x == "a":
        ex = load(EXAMPLE)["node"]["image"]
        if (ex.get("repository"), ex.get("tag")) != (pin["repository"], pin["tag"]):
            fail(f"{EXAMPLE} pins {ex.get('repository')}:{ex.get('tag')}, indexer-a {image}: keep the two identical")
    return done


def serve_done(x, pins, consts):
    serve = load(overlay(x))["siMember"].get("serve") or {}
    if serve.get("enabled") is True and serve.get("ownerHouseGate") == pins.owner_housegate_without(x):
        done = True
    elif serve.get("enabled") in (None, False) and serve.get("ownerHouseGate") in (None, {}):
        done = False
    else:
        fail(f"{overlay(x)}: siMember.serve is {serve!r}")
    flag = consts["DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE"].get(release(x))
    if flag is not done:
        fail(f"member-{x}: serving is {'on' if done else 'off'} in the overlay, DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE says {flag!r}")
    return done


def monitoring_done(consts):
    mon = load(NETWORK).get("monitoring") or {}
    reads = mon.get("replicaReads")
    if reads in (None, {}) or reads == {"enabled": False}:
        done = False
    elif reads == {"enabled": True}:
        done = True
    else:
        fail(f"{NETWORK}: monitoring.replicaReads is {reads!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING"] is not done:
        fail(f"monitoring.replicaReads.enabled is {done}, DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING {consts['DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING']!r}")
    return done


def stage_facts(pins, consts):
    need(consts, "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", "DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES", "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS",
         "DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE", "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING", *SOURCE_CONSTANT.values())
    facts = {}
    for g in "bcn":
        facts[f"G-{g}"] = grant_done(g, consts)
    for x in "bca":
        facts[f"W-{x}-m"] = member_done(x, pins)
        facts[f"W-{x}-h"] = host_done(x, pins, consts)
    for x in "bca":
        facts[f"S-{x}"] = serve_done(x, pins, consts)
    facts["M"] = monitoring_done(consts)
    return facts


def current_stage(pins, consts, quiet=False):
    facts = stage_facts(pins, consts)
    done = [s for s in SEQUENCE[1:] if facts[s]]
    if done != list(SEQUENCE[1:1 + len(done)]):
        fail(f"done stages {done} are not a prefix of {list(SEQUENCE[1:])}")
    if not quiet:
        for s in SEQUENCE[1:]:
            print(f"{s} {'done' if facts[s] else 'not done'}")
    return done[-1] if done else "pr"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ edits


def edit_grant(g, pins, src):
    if g == "n":
        path = NETWORK
        lines = read_lines(path)
        before = load(path)
        c, c_end = top_key(lines, "clickhouse", path)
        a = one_key(lines, c + 1, c_end, child_indent(lines, c, c_end, path), "access", path)
        if "replicaReads" in (before["clickhouse"]["access"] or {}):
            i = one_key(lines, a + 1, block_end(lines, a), indent_of(lines[a]) + 2, "replicaReads", path)
            set_scalar_line(lines, i, "true", path)
        else:
            pad = " " * (indent_of(lines[a]) + 2)
            insert_at_block_end(lines, a, [
                f"{pad}# Stage 3 P3 ({RUNBOOK} §3.3;\n",
                f"{pad}# Plan S3-C4 K48): si_gateway reads the members' copies, GRANT SELECT ON\n",
                f"{pad}# hg_replica.* as its last grant and nothing else; a users reload. The grant\n",
                f"{pad}# also exists on the verifier ClickHouses, whose hg_replica is empty.\n",
                f"{pad}replicaReads: true\n",
            ])
        expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
        expected["clickhouse"]["access"]["replicaReads"] = True
        text = write_checked(path, lines, expected, path)
    else:
        path = chi_file(g)
        lines = read_lines(path)
        before = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all("".join(lines))]
        k = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^\s+si_gateway/grants/query:\s*$", line)]
        if len(k) != 1:
            fail(f"{path}: expected one 'si_gateway/grants/query:' line, found {len(k)}")
        end = block_end(lines, k[0])
        items = [i for i in range(k[0] + 1, end) if re.match(r"^\s+- ", lines[i])]
        if not items or items[-1] != end - 1:
            fail(f"{path}: si_gateway/grants/query does not end with a list item")
        m = re.match(r'^(\s+- )("?)', lines[items[0]])
        lines[end:end] = [f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}{REPLICA_GRANT}{m.group(2)}\n"]
        text = "".join(lines)
        after = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(text)]
        expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
        expected[0]["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_gateway/grants/query"].append(REPLICA_GRANT)
        if after != expected:
            fail(f"the edited {path} is not exactly the intended change")
    src.replace_dict_value("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS", CHI[g], "True")
    return {path: text}


def edit_member(x, pins, src):
    path = overlay(x)
    lines = read_lines(path)
    before = load(path)
    s, s_end = top_key(lines, "siMember", path)
    ci = child_indent(lines, s, s_end, path)
    i = one_key(lines, s + 1, s_end, ci, "image", path)
    set_scalar_line(lines, i, pins.p3_image, path)
    replace_comment_above(lines, i, [
        f"# sentio-node {pins.v['SN_COMMIT_P3']} (housegate {pins.v['HG_TAG_P3']}, arbiter-core",
        f"# {pins.v['CORE_TAG_P3']}): the stage-3 P3 member image, whose si-member serves its",
        "# view and leases on statusPort (Plan S3-C4 contract §31.3;",
        f"# {RUNBOOK} §{SECTION[f'W-{x}-m']}).",
        "# Rollback target: the P2 member image",
        f"# {pins.p2_image}.",
    ])
    s, s_end = top_key(lines, "siMember", path)
    serve = key_lines(lines, s + 1, s_end, ci, "serve")
    if serve:
        e = one_key(lines, serve[0] + 1, block_end(lines, serve[0]), ci + 2, "endpoint", path)
        set_scalar_line(lines, e, "true", path)
    else:
        pad = " " * ci
        insert_at_block_end(lines, s, [
            f"{pad}# The P3 serving endpoint (Plan S3-C4 contract §31.3, §32.1): the si-member\n",
            f"{pad}# answers its serving view and leases on statusPort with the bearer token\n",
            f"{pad}# of statusTokenSecret. Serving stays off until runbook §5 sets enabled.\n",
            f"{pad}serve:\n",
            f"{pad}  endpoint: true\n",
        ])
    expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
    expected["siMember"]["image"] = pins.p3_image
    expected["siMember"].setdefault("serve", {})
    expected["siMember"]["serve"] = dict(expected["siMember"]["serve"] or {}, endpoint=True)
    return {path: write_checked(path, lines, expected, path)}

def edit_pin_file(path, header, pins, where):
    lines = read_lines(path)
    before = load(path)
    n = one_key(lines, 0, len(lines), 0, "node", path)
    if any(not (is_blank(line) or line.startswith("#")) for line in lines[:n]):
        fail(f"{path}: something other than comments precedes 'node:'")
    old = f"{before['node']['image']['repository']}:{before['node']['image']['tag']}"
    lines[:n] = [h.format(c=pins.v["SN_COMMIT_P3"], h=pins.v["HG_TAG_P3"], k=pins.v["CORE_TAG_P3"], rb=RUNBOOK, old=old) + "\n"
                 for h in header]
    n = one_key(lines, 0, len(lines), 0, "node", path)
    n_end = block_end(lines, n)
    im = one_key(lines, n + 1, n_end, 2, "image", path)
    t = one_key(lines, im + 1, block_end(lines, im), 4, "tag", path)
    set_scalar_line(lines, t, pins.p3_tag, path)
    expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
    expected["node"]["image"]["tag"] = pins.p3_tag
    return write_checked(path, lines, expected, where), old


def edit_host(x, pins, src):
    out = {}
    text, old = edit_pin_file(source_pin(x), SOURCE_HEADER[x], pins, source_pin(x))
    out[source_pin(x)] = text
    if x == "a":
        text, _ = edit_pin_file(EXAMPLE, EXAMPLE_HEADER, pins, EXAMPLE)
        out[EXAMPLE] = text
    path = overlay(x)
    lines = read_lines(path)
    before = load(path)
    h, h_end = top_key(lines, "housegateSidecar", path)
    im = one_key(lines, h + 1, h_end, 2, "image", path)
    t = one_key(lines, im + 1, block_end(lines, im), 4, "tag", path)
    set_scalar_line(lines, t, pins.sidecar_tag, path)
    replace_comment_above(lines, t, [
        f"# housegate {pins.v['HG_TAG_P3']} (Plan S3-C4 K46, K47): the agent reads the table status",
        "# replica and fails reads, never writes, over to a replica host. Moved with",
        f"# this host's image by {RUNBOOK} §{SECTION[f'W-{x}-h']}; the pin never",
        "# merges without its sync. Rollback target, with that commit:",
        f"# {OLD_SIDECAR_TAG}",
    ])
    s, s_end = top_key(lines, "storageIntegrity", path)
    ci = child_indent(lines, s, s_end, path)
    if key_lines(lines, s + 1, s_end, ci, "replicaReads"):
        fail(f"{path}: storageIntegrity.replicaReads exists already")
    pad = " " * ci
    insert_at_block_end(lines, s, [
        f"{pad}# Stage 3 P3 replica reads (Plan S3-C4 contract §31.2, §32.1;\n",
        f"{pad}# {RUNBOOK} §{SECTION[f'W-{x}-h']}): the host polls its si-member's\n",
        f"{pad}# serving endpoint, holds a lease per database the member serves and answers\n",
        f"{pad}# those tables Replica. The bearer token comes from its own Secret (decision\n",
        f"{pad}# D29), into the sentio-node container only.\n",
        f"{pad}replicaReads:\n",
        f"{pad}  memberStatusURL: \"{member_url(x)}\"\n",
        f"{pad}  memberStatusTokenSecret:\n",
        f"{pad}    name: {token_secret(x)}\n",
        f"{pad}    key: status-token\n",
    ])
    expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
    expected["housegateSidecar"]["image"]["tag"] = pins.sidecar_tag
    expected["storageIntegrity"]["replicaReads"] = {
        "memberStatusURL": member_url(x),
        "memberStatusTokenSecret": {"name": token_secret(x), "key": "status-token"},
    }
    out[path] = write_checked(path, lines, expected, path)
    r = release(x)
    const = SOURCE_CONSTANT[x]
    src.replace_statement(const, image_statement(const, pins.p3_image), comment={
        "a": ["# indexer-a's source image pin (sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml",
              "# and its copy docs/examples/storage-integrity-fresh-source-image.yaml): the",
              f"# stage-3 P3 host build DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE since {RUNBOOK} §4.3."],
        "b": ["# The source image of indexer-b's SI release. Mirrors",
              "# sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml: the stage-3",
              f"# P3 host build DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE since {RUNBOOK} §4.1."],
        "c": ["# The source image of indexer-c's SI release. Mirrors",
              "# sentio-node-indexer-c-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml: the stage-3",
              f"# P3 host build DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE since {RUNBOOK} §4.2."],
    }[x], replace_comment_if=r"source.image")
    if src.defined_before("DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE", "DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES"):
        src.replace_dict_value("DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES", r, "DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE")
    else:
        src.replace_dict_value("DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES", r, json.dumps(pins.sidecar))
    src.replace_dict_value("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS", r, json.dumps(member_url(x)))
    return out


def edit_serve(x, pins, src):
    path = overlay(x)
    lines = read_lines(path)
    before = load(path)
    s, s_end = top_key(lines, "siMember", path)
    ci = child_indent(lines, s, s_end, path)
    v = one_key(lines, s + 1, s_end, ci, "serve", path)
    v_end = block_end(lines, v)
    e = one_key(lines, v + 1, v_end, ci + 2, "endpoint", path)
    if key_lines(lines, v + 1, v_end, ci + 2, "ownerHouseGate"):
        fail(f"{path}: siMember.serve.ownerHouseGate exists already")
    pad = " " * (ci + 2)
    owners = pins.owner_housegate_without(x)
    block = [
        f"{pad}# Serving on ({RUNBOOK} §{SECTION[f'S-{x}']}): member-{x} serves an owner's\n",
        f"{pad}# database while that owner is quarantined, or unreachable at its HouseGate\n",
        f"{pad}# address below for ownerUnreachableAfter (the chart default, 60s), and every\n",
        f"{pad}# copy of it equals the published entry over two polls.\n",
    ]
    enabled = key_lines(lines, v + 1, v_end, ci + 2, "enabled")
    if enabled:
        set_scalar_line(lines, enabled[0], "true", path)
        at = enabled[0] + 1
    else:
        block.append(f"{pad}enabled: true\n")
        at = e + 1
    block.append(f"{pad}ownerHouseGate:\n")
    block += [f"{pad}  \"{k}\": \"{owners[k]}\"\n" for k in owners]
    lines[at:at] = block
    expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
    expected["siMember"]["serve"]["enabled"] = True
    expected["siMember"]["serve"]["ownerHouseGate"] = owners
    out = {path: write_checked(path, lines, expected, path)}
    src.replace_dict_value("DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE", release(x), "True")
    return out


def edit_monitoring(pins, src):
    path = NETWORK
    lines = read_lines(path)
    before = load(path)
    m, m_end = top_key(lines, "monitoring", path)
    ci = child_indent(lines, m, m_end, path)
    existing = key_lines(lines, m + 1, m_end, ci, "replicaReads")
    if existing:
        e = one_key(lines, existing[0] + 1, block_end(lines, existing[0]), ci + 2, "enabled", path)
        set_scalar_line(lines, e, "true", path)
    else:
        pad = " " * ci
        insert_at_block_end(lines, m, [
            f"{pad}# Stage 3 P3's replica-read rules ({RUNBOOK}\n",
            f"{pad}# §5.4), turned on once every member serves.\n",
            f"{pad}replicaReads:\n",
            f"{pad}  enabled: true\n",
        ])
    expected = copy.deepcopy(before)
    expected["monitoring"]["replicaReads"] = dict(before["monitoring"].get("replicaReads") or {}, enabled=True)
    out = {path: write_checked(path, lines, expected, path)}
    src.replace_statement("DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING", "DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING = True\n")
    return out


def intended_constants(stage, pins, before):
    after = copy.deepcopy(before)
    kind, _, rest = stage.partition("-")
    if kind == "G":
        after["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_GRANTS"][CHI[rest]] = True
    elif kind == "W" and rest.endswith("-h"):
        x = rest[0]
        after[SOURCE_CONSTANT[x]] = pins.p3_image
        after["DEVNET2_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGES"][release(x)] = pins.sidecar
        after["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READS"][release(x)] = member_url(x)
    elif kind == "S":
        after["DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVE"][release(rest)] = True
    elif kind == "M":
        after["DEVNET2_REPLICA_READ_MONITORING"] = True
    return after


def apply(stage, pins):
    if stage not in SEQUENCE[1:]:
        fail(f"unknown stage {stage!r}; one of {', '.join(SEQUENCE[1:])}")
    before_consts = constants()
    now = current_stage(pins, before_consts, quiet=True)
    want = SEQUENCE[SEQUENCE.index(stage) - 1]
    if now != want:
        fail(f"the checkout is at stage {now}, {stage} needs stage {want}")
    src = TestSource()
    kind, _, rest = stage.partition("-")
    if kind == "G":
        out = edit_grant(rest, pins, src)
    elif kind == "W" and rest.endswith("-m"):
        out = edit_member(rest[0], pins, src)
    elif kind == "W":
        out = edit_host(rest[0], pins, src)
    elif kind == "S":
        out = edit_serve(rest, pins, src)
    else:
        out = edit_monitoring(pins, src)
    src.check_rest_unchanged()
    if src.text != src.old:
        out[TESTS] = src.text
    originals = {path: Path(path).read_text() for path in out}
    for path, text in out.items():
        Path(path).write_text(text)
    try:
        after_consts = constants()
        expected = intended_constants(stage, pins, before_consts)
        changed = sorted(n for n in set(before_consts) | set(after_consts) if before_consts.get(n) != after_consts.get(n))
        wrong = sorted(n for n in set(expected) | set(after_consts) if expected.get(n) != after_consts.get(n))
        if wrong:
            raise SystemExit(f"p3-edit: {stage} changed the constants {changed}; these differ from the intended values: {wrong}; restored; stop")
        if current_stage(pins, after_consts, quiet=True) != stage:
            raise SystemExit(f"p3-edit: after the edit the checkout does not read as stage {stage}; restored; stop")
    except SystemExit:
        for path, text in originals.items():
            Path(path).write_text(text)
        raise
    print(f"applied {stage}")
    print("files: " + " ".join(sorted(out)))


def files(stage, pins):
    kind, _, rest = stage.partition("-")
    if kind == "G":
        names = [NETWORK if rest == "n" else chi_file(rest), TESTS]
    elif kind == "W" and rest.endswith("-m"):
        names = [overlay(rest[0])]
    elif kind == "W":
        names = [source_pin(rest[0]), overlay(rest[0]), TESTS] + ([EXAMPLE] if rest[0] == "a" else [])
    elif kind == "S":
        names = [overlay(rest), TESTS]
    elif kind == "M":
        names = [NETWORK, TESTS]
    else:
        fail(f"unknown stage {stage!r}")
    print(" ".join(sorted(names)))


def same(expected_dir, names):
    """Each of NAMES in this checkout carries the content of its copy under EXPECTED_DIR."""
    if not names:
        fail("same: no files given")
    for name in names:
        want_path = Path(expected_dir) / name
        if not want_path.is_file():
            fail(f"{name} is not among the files of contract §32.5's edit")
        got, want = Path(name).read_text(), want_path.read_text()
        if name.endswith(".yaml"):
            equal = list(yaml.safe_load_all(got)) == list(yaml.safe_load_all(want))
        elif name.endswith(".py"):
            equal = ast.dump(ast.parse(got)) == ast.dump(ast.parse(want))
        else:
            equal = got == want
        if not equal:
            fail(f"{name} differs in content from contract §32.5's edit")
    print("same content as contract §32.5's edit: " + " ".join(names))


def check(pins):
    consts = constants()
    need(consts, "DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE", "DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE", "REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES", "STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES",
         "MEMBER_IMAGES", "WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES", "SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT", "DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE",
         "DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT", "DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS", "DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE",
         "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE", "MONITORING_ALERTS")
    wrong = []
    if consts["DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE"] != pins.p3_image:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE is {consts['DEVNET2_P3_HOST_IMAGE']!r}, the ledger gives {pins.p3_image!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE"] != pins.sidecar:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE is {consts['DEVNET2_P3_AGENT_SIDECAR_IMAGE']!r}, the ledger gives {pins.sidecar!r}")
    for name in ("REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES", "STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES", "MEMBER_IMAGES", "WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES"):
        if pins.p3_image not in consts[name]:
            wrong.append(f"{name} does not list the P3 image")
    if consts["DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE"] != pins.p2_image:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE is {consts['DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE']!r}, the ledger's P2 member image is {pins.p2_image!r}")
    if consts["SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT"] != REPLICA_GRANT:
        wrong.append(f"SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT is {consts['SI_GATEWAY_REPLICA_GRANT']!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE"] != pins.housegate:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE is {consts['DEVNET2_OWNER_HOUSEGATE']!r}, expected {pins.housegate!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT"] != STATUS_PORT:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT is {consts['DEVNET2_MEMBER_SERVING_PORT']!r}")
    if consts["DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS"] != {release(x): token_secret(x) for x in "abc"}:
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS is {consts['DEVNET2_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRETS']!r}")
    if set(consts["DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE"].values()) != {"C"} or set(consts["DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE"]) != set(CHI.values()):
        wrong.append(f"DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE is {consts['DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE']!r}, expected C for the three installations")
    alerts = sorted(consts["MONITORING_ALERTS"].get("replica-reads", []))
    if alerts != sorted(["StorageIntegrityReplicaServing", "StorageIntegrityMemberStatusUnreachable",
                         "StorageIntegrityReplicaLeaseStuck", "StorageIntegrityOwnerUnreachableFromMember"]):
        wrong.append(f"MONITORING_ALERTS['replica-reads'] is {alerts}")
    if wrong:
        fail("; ".join(wrong))
    stage = current_stage(pins, consts, quiet=True)
    print(f"P3 PR constants agree with the ledger: host and member image {pins.p3_image}, agent sidecar {pins.sidecar}, "
          f"owner HouseGate {json.dumps(pins.housegate, sort_keys=True)}")
    print(f"stage {stage}")


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) < 2:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    pins = Pins(argv[0])
    if argv[1:] == ["state"]:
        print(f"stage {current_stage(pins, constants())}")
    elif argv[1:] == ["check"]:
        check(pins)
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[1] == "apply":
        apply(argv[2], pins)
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[1] == "files":
        files(argv[2], pins)
    elif len(argv) >= 4 and argv[1] == "same":
        same(argv[2], argv[3:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
